papers.title: Gastrodin enhances the spleen immune function in erythroleukemia by regulating T-cell receptor signaling pathway.
papers.authors: Cheng, Sha; Xu, Yingjiang; Wang, Jianping; Yu, Jia; Hu, Liangliang; Liu, Jiming; Luo, Heng
papers.one_liner_zh: 研究天麻素通过TCR信号通路增强红白血病脾免疫功能，虽涉及Fli-1转录因子分子对接，但核心是药物免疫调节而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法以实验为主。
papers.abstract: Erythroleukemia is a malignant hematological disorder often accompanied by severe immunosuppression, with T cell dysfunction playing a central role. Gastrodin, which is derived from Gastrodia elata, has been proven to possess various pharmacological activities such as neuroprotection and immunomodulation. However, whether it can effectively improve the immune function in erythroleukemia has not been reported. Our results demonstrated that gastrodin treatment significantly alleviated splenomegaly and inhibited the malignant progression in erythroleukemia mice. Moreover, it markedly enhanced the proliferative capacity of splenic T cells and promoted the secretion of immune - related cytokines. Mechanistically, gastrodin upregulated the expression of key molecules in the T cell receptor signaling pathway, including LCK, ZAP-70, ITK, PKC, IKK, and NFkappaB, at both the mRNA and protein phosphorylation levels. Notably, through integrated bioinformatics analysis, molecular docking, and cellular thermal shift assays, we found that gastrodin exhibits moderate interaction with the transcription factor Fli-1 in erythroleukemia. Collectively, this study provides the first evidence that gastrodin enhances splenic immune function in erythroleukemia by modulating the T cell receptor (TCR) signaling pathway. Cellular thermal shift assay identified Fli-1 as a protein capable of physically interacting with gastrodin, although its functional contribution remains to be further explored. These findings highlight gastrodin as a promising immunotherapeutic candidate for erythroleukemia.
papers.abstract_zh: 红白血病是一种恶性血液系统疾病，常伴随严重的免疫抑制，其中T细胞功能障碍起核心作用。天麻素（Gastrodin）源自天麻（Gastrodia elata），已被证明具有多种药理活性，如神经保护和免疫调节。然而，其是否能有效改善红白血病中的免疫功能尚未见报道。我们的结果表明，天麻素治疗显著缓解了红白血病小鼠的脾肿大，并抑制了恶性进展。此外，它显著增强了脾脏T细胞的增殖能力，并促进了免疫相关细胞因子的分泌。机制上，天麻素在mRNA和蛋白磷酸化水平上调了T细胞受体信号通路中关键分子的表达，包括LCK、ZAP-70、ITK、PKC、IKK和NFkappaB。值得注意的是，通过整合生物信息学分析、分子对接（molecular docking）和细胞热位移分析（cellular thermal shift assay），我们发现天麻素在红白血病中与转录因子Fli-1表现出中等程度的相互作用。总体而言，本研究首次提供证据表明，天麻素通过调节T细胞受体（TCR）信号通路增强红白血病中的脾脏免疫功能。细胞热位移分析鉴定出Fli-1为能与天麻素物理相互作用的蛋白质，尽管其功能贡献仍有待进一步探索。这些发现凸显了天麻素作为红白血病有前景的免疫治疗候选药物的潜力。

papers.title: Accurate modeling of ion-protein binding in solution: molecular mechanics force field innovation and validation on Mg2+
papers.authors: Giorgio Schillaci; Julian Mélendez Delgado; Matthew Saunders; Irene Arias Gutierrez; Péter R. Nagy; Sameer Varma
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文聚焦离子-蛋白结合力场建模，虽涉及蛋白结合机制但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且方法为分子力学力场创新，与TF-DNA互作课题关联较弱。
papers.abstract: Multivalent ions bind to proteins to control many biological processes. Molecular simulations can effectively supplement experiments to resolve underlying mechanisms, but suffer from reliability and feasibility issues in describing ion-protein binding in the condensed phase. Here we present a molecular mechanics based generalizable solution to this long-standing challenge. Using the divalent Mg 2+ as a model, we demonstrate that our approach yields unprecedented accuracy in describing its binding to proteins in solution – compared to high level quantum mechanics, the mean error in local interaction energies is 0.5%, and the binding modes and binding free energies match experiment. Our study also shows that key to achieving this accuracy requires a delicate balance between the large repulsive and attractive forces at short distances near ions for which explicit modeling of polarization is essential. Overall, our work lays foundation for future development of molecular simulation methods for ions and opens the way to quantitatively study Mg-dependent mechanisms in hundreds of enzymes and proteins.
papers.abstract_zh: 多价离子与蛋白质结合以调控众多生物过程。分子模拟能有效补充实验以解析潜在机制，但在凝聚相中描述离子-蛋白质结合时面临可靠性和可行性问题。在此，我们提出一种基于分子力学的通用解决方案，以应对这一长期挑战。以二价Mg²⁺为模型，我们证明该方法在描述其与溶液中蛋白质结合时达到了前所未有的精度——与高水平量子力学相比，局部相互作用能的平均误差为0.5%，且结合模式和结合自由能与实验吻合。我们的研究还表明，实现这一精度的关键在于离子附近短距离内大排斥力和吸引力之间的微妙平衡，而显式建模极化对此至关重要。总体而言，我们的工作为未来离子分子模拟方法的发展奠定了基础，并为定量研究数百种酶和蛋白质中Mg依赖性机制开辟了道路。

papers.title: GenoME: a MoE-based generative model for individualized, multimodal prediction and perturbation of genomic profiles.
papers.authors: Wei, Jiachen; Xue, Yue; Chai, Hao; Gao, Yi Qin
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于MoE的生成模型GenoME，整合DNA序列与ATAC-seq预测多尺度基因组调控图谱，涵盖TF结合与增强子-启动子互作，虽非直接聚焦TF-DNA结合机制建模，但方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作预测与扰动分析。
papers.abstract: The non-coding genome operates through a complex, multiscale regulatory system where regulated gene expressions are closely associated with cell-type-specific histone modifications, transcription factor binding, and 3D conformation. Developing computational models that can integrate these patterns to predict and interpret the regulatory system remains challenging. Here, we present GenoME, a Mixture of Experts (MoE)-based generative model that uses DNA sequence and cell-type-specific ATAC-seq signals to predict a unified genomic profiles encompassing epigenomics, transcriptomics, and chromatin architecture at base-pair to kilobase resolutions. GenoME enables multiscale predictions for held-out genomic regions and, critically, generalizes to predict the full regulatory landscape of unseen or individualized cell types from a single ATAC-seq input. We equip GenoME with an in silico perturbation framework that accurately forecasts the multimodal consequences of genetic perturbations and identifies functional enhancer-promoter connections, outperforming specialized models like Activity-by-Contact. These predictions can also be used to decipher the transcription factor grammar of cell-type-specific enhancers. GenoME thus provides a versatile, all-in-one platform for generative modeling, cross-cell-type generalization, and causal mechanistic investigation of the multiscale regulatory genome.
papers.abstract_zh: 非编码基因组通过一个复杂的、多尺度的调控系统运作，其中受调控的基因表达与细胞类型特异性的组蛋白修饰、转录因子结合及三维构象密切相关。开发能够整合这些模式以预测和解释调控系统的计算模型仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出GenoME，一种基于混合专家（Mixture of Experts, MoE）的生成模型，利用DNA序列和细胞类型特异性的ATAC-seq信号，预测涵盖表观基因组学、转录组学及染色质构象的统一基因组图谱，分辨率从碱基对到千碱基。GenoME能够对未观测的基因组区域进行多尺度预测，并且关键的是，它能从单一的ATAC-seq输入泛化到预测未见或个体化细胞类型的完整调控景观。我们为GenoME配备了一个计算机模拟扰动框架，该框架能准确预测遗传扰动的多模态后果，并识别功能性增强子-启动子连接，优于如Activity-by-Contact等专门模型。这些预测还可用于解读细胞类型特异性增强子的转录因子语法。因此，GenoME为多尺度调控基因组的生成建模、跨细胞类型泛化及因果机制研究提供了一个多功能的一体化平台。

papers.title: BAN-SDBPred: Improving Single-Stranded and Double-Stranded DNA-Binding Protein Prediction Using an Attention Network with Bilinear Convolution and Adaptive Sampling Strategy.
papers.authors: Arshad, Kamran; Arif, Muhammad; Worachartcheewan, Apilak; Yu, Dong-Jun
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用双线性注意力网络结合蛋白语言模型特征预测单/双链DNA结合蛋白，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作分类预测，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合位点预测，但未聚焦TF-DNA特异性结合机制。
papers.abstract: DNA binding proteins play essential roles in numerous biological mechanisms. The DBPs can be either single-stranded binding (SSBs) or double-stranded binding (DSBs) to a DNA molecule. The in-depth identification of SSBs and DSBs has been a hot topic in bioinformatics and is involved in the drug discovery process. Traditional experimental methods failed to characterize the types of DBPs because of high cost and time constraints. While computational prediction of novel SSBs and DSBs has made significant progress, there are still challenges remaining in enhancing overall prediction performance. Methods: Here, we develop a novel BAN-SDBPred (Bilinear Attention Network for Single and Double Stranded DNA-Binding Protein Prediction) method. BAN-SDBPred leverages the evolutionary features by protein language model-based Evolutionary Scale Modeling 2 (ESM2), ProtT5, and a histogram of oriented gradient-based residue pairwise energy content matrix (RECM-HOG)-transformed energy estimation features from sequence alone. Then, the adaptive neighborhood-based sampling (ANBS) algorithm was adopted to solve the imbalance issue. Compared to other deep learning models, the bilinear attention network (BAN) learns the local and global enriched features from the sequences. Extensive experimental results anticipate that BAN-SDBPred outperforms the existing predictors in terms of all performance measures, such as Acc, F1, MCC, etc., on the training and independent test data. Our designed model has significant advantages in discriminating SSBs and DSBs from DBPs with an improved Acc of 2%, Precision of 4.5%, F1 of 21%, MCC of 9%, and area under curve (AUC) of 20%, respectively. We expect this research will help to predict large-scale novel SSBs and DSBs in particular and other binding problems in general. All data and models are available at 10.5281/zenodo.18718092.
papers.abstract_zh: DNA结合蛋白在众多生物机制中发挥着重要作用。DBPs可以是单链结合蛋白（SSBs）或双链结合蛋白（DSBs），与DNA分子结合。对SSBs和DSBs的深入识别一直是生物信息学领域的热点课题，并涉及药物发现过程。传统实验方法因成本高和时间限制，未能表征DBPs的类型。虽然新型SSBs和DSBs的计算预测已取得显著进展，但在提升整体预测性能方面仍存在挑战。方法：在此，我们开发了一种新颖的BAN-SDBPred（双线性注意力网络用于单链和双链DNA结合蛋白预测）方法。BAN-SDBPred利用基于蛋白质语言模型的进化尺度建模2（ESM2）、ProtT5的进化特征，以及基于方向梯度直方图的残基对能量含量矩阵（RECM-HOG）转换的能量估计特征，这些均仅从序列中获得。随后，采用自适应邻域采样（ANBS）算法解决不平衡问题。与其他深度学习模型相比，双线性注意力网络（BAN）从序列中学习局部和全局富集特征。大量实验结果表明，BAN-SDBPred在训练和独立测试数据上，在各项性能指标（如Acc、F1、MCC等）方面均优于现有预测器。我们设计的模型在区分DBPs中的SSBs和DSBs方面具有显著优势，分别提高了Acc 2%、Precision 4.5%、F1 21%、MCC 9%和曲线下面积（AUC）20%。我们期望这项研究将有助于预测大规模的新型SSBs和DSBs，并普遍适用于其他结合问题。所有数据和模型可在10.5281/zenodo.18718092获取。

papers.title: Pemetrexed increases BRCA1 protein stability and sensitizes TNBC cells to radiotherapy.
papers.authors: Jin, Hee; Jeon, Kyung-Hwa; Kang, Chaerin; Lee, Joohyun; Lee, Yeonjin; Kwon, Youngjoo; Lee, Yun-Sil
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物Pemetrexed通过稳定BRCA1蛋白增强三阴性乳腺癌放疗敏感性，虽涉及BRCA1蛋白稳定性与DNA损伤修复，但核心是药物-蛋白互作与细胞表型，无蛋白质-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模无关。
papers.abstract: BRCA1 is a multifunctional tumor suppressor that orchestrates homologous recombination repair, chromatin remodeling, cell cycle control and apoptosis. Although pathogenic BRCA1 mutations are relatively uncommon, decreased BRCA1 protein expression, which is typically driven by accelerated proteasomal degradation, is implicated in aggressive breast cancer (BC), particularly triple‑negative (TN)BC. These mutations may modulate therapeutic response to DNA‑damaging agents. Given the absence of clinically available strategies to restore BRCA1 stability, the present study evaluated whether pemetrexed (Peme), a multitargeted antifolate identified through an in silico US Food and Drug Administration‑approved drug screen, modulates BRCA1 protein homeostasis in TNBC models. BRCA1 protein abundance, ubiquitination and turnover were assessed using immunoblotting, ubiquitin pull‑down and cycloheximide chase analyses and BRCA1 domain mutants. Functional consequences of Peme treatment were measured by apoptosis assay and BRCA1‑dependent signaling readouts. The radiosensitizing effect of Peme was evaluated in vitro and validated in TNBC xenografts. Peme increased BRCA1 protein levels without altering BRCA1 mRNA, indicating post‑translational regulation. Mechanistically, in silico docking and BRCA1 deletion mutant analyses suggested that the BRCA1 C‑terminal domain may contribute to the effect of Peme on BRCA1 stability, suppressing ubiquitin‑mediated proteasomal degradation and resulting in protein stabilization. Stabilized BRCA1 enhanced apoptotic responses, whereas BRCA1 knockdown attenuated these effects. Combined Peme‑radiation treatment significantly potentiated cytotoxicity in vitro and inhibited tumor growth in vivo, demonstrating a radiosensitizing effect linked to BRCA1 stabilization. Collectively, these findings identified Peme as a BRCA1‑stabilizing agent that enhances therapeutic response to radiation in TNBC. Pharmacological restoration of BRCA1 stability represents a promising strategy to overcome therapeutic resistance in BRCA1‑deficient or functionally compromised BC.
papers.abstract_zh: BRCA1是一种多功能肿瘤抑制因子，协调同源重组修复、染色质重塑、细胞周期控制和凋亡。尽管致病性BRCA1突变相对罕见，但BRCA1蛋白表达降低（通常由加速的蛋白酶体降解驱动）与侵袭性乳腺癌（BC）相关，尤其是三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）。这些突变可能调节对DNA损伤剂的治疗反应。鉴于临床上缺乏恢复BRCA1稳定性的可用策略，本研究评估了培美曲塞（Peme）——一种通过计算机模拟美国食品药品监督管理局批准药物筛选鉴定出的多靶点抗叶酸药物——是否调节TNBC模型中的BRCA1蛋白稳态。使用免疫印迹、泛素pull-down和环己酰亚胺追踪分析以及BRCA1结构域突变体评估BRCA1蛋白丰度、泛素化和周转。通过凋亡实验和BRCA1依赖性信号读数测量Peme处理的功能后果。Peme的放射增敏效应在体外评估并在TNBC异种移植瘤中验证。Peme在不改变BRCA1 mRNA的情况下增加BRCA1蛋白水平，表明存在翻译后调控。机制上，计算机模拟对接和BRCA1缺失突变体分析提示BRCA1 C末端结构域可能有助于Peme对BRCA1稳定性的效应，抑制泛素介导的蛋白酶体降解并导致蛋白稳定化。稳定的BRCA1增强凋亡反应，而BRCA1敲低减弱这些效应。Peme联合放射治疗在体外显著增强细胞毒性并在体内抑制肿瘤生长，证明与BRCA1稳定化相关的放射增敏效应。总体而言，这些发现将Peme鉴定为一种BRCA1稳定化剂，增强TNBC对放射的治疗反应。药理学恢复BRCA1稳定性代表一种有前景的策略，以克服BRCA1缺陷或功能受损BC中的治疗耐药性。

papers.title: A tree-based kernel for densities and its applications in clustering DNase-seq profiles.
papers.authors: Xu, Yuliang; Luo, Kaixuan; Ma, Li
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用树状密度核聚类DNase-seq染色质可及性谱以检测TF结合足迹，虽涉及TF-DNA结合位点检测，但方法为贝叶斯统计聚类而非AI或物理模拟，且未建模三维互作机制。
papers.abstract: Modeling multiple sampling densities within a hierarchical framework enables borrowing of information across samples. These "density random effects" can act as kernels in latent variable models to represent exchangeable subgroups or clusters. A key feature of these kernels is the (functional) covariance they induce, which determines how densities are grouped in mixture models. Our motivating problem is clustering chromatin accessibility profiles from high-throughput DNase-seq experiments to detect transcription factor (TF) binding. TF binding typically produces footprint profiles with spatial patterns, creating long-range dependency across genomic locations. Existing nonparametric hierarchical models impose restrictive covariance assumptions and cannot accommodate such dependencies, often leading to biologically uninformative clusters. We propose a nonparametric density kernel that is flexible enough to capture diverse covariance structures and adapts to various spatial patterns of TF footprints. The kernel specifies dyadic tree splitting probabilities via a multivariate logit-normal model with a sparse precision matrix. Bayesian inference for latent variable models using this kernel is implemented through Gibbs sampling with Polya-Gamma augmentation. Extensive simulations show that our kernel substantially improves clustering accuracy. We apply the proposed mixture model to DNase-seq data from the Encyclopedia of DNA Elements project, which results in biologically meaningful clusters corresponding to binding events of two common TFs.
papers.abstract_zh: 在分层框架内对多个采样密度进行建模，能够实现跨样本的信息借用。这些“密度随机效应”可作为潜变量模型中的核，用以表示可交换的子组或聚类。这些核的一个关键特征是其诱导的（函数性）协方差，该协方差决定了在混合模型中密度如何分组。我们的动机问题是对来自高通量DNase-seq实验的染色质可及性图谱进行聚类，以检测转录因子（TF）结合。TF结合通常产生具有空间模式的足迹图谱，从而在基因组位置间形成长程依赖性。现有的非参数分层模型施加了限制性的协方差假设，无法适应此类依赖性，常常导致生物学上无信息的聚类。我们提出一种非参数密度核，其足够灵活以捕捉多样的协方差结构，并适应TF足迹的各种空间模式。该核通过具有稀疏精度矩阵的多元logit-normal模型指定二元树分裂概率。使用此核的潜变量模型的贝叶斯推断通过结合Polya-Gamma增广的Gibbs采样实现。广泛模拟表明，我们的核显著提高了聚类准确性。我们将所提出的混合模型应用于DNA元素百科全书项目中的DNase-seq数据，结果产生了与两种常见TF结合事件相对应的生物学上有意义的聚类。

papers.title: Molecular Rewiring and Compensatory Mechanisms Sustain DNA Recognition in the Mutant ZTA Transcription Factor: Insights from Molecular Dynamics Simulations.
papers.authors: Duraisamy, Boobalan; Pramanik, Debabrata
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过全原子分子动力学模拟和MM/PBSA方法，系统研究了突变ZTA转录因子与DNA复合物中相互作用网络的重组与补偿机制，核心聚焦TF-DNA结合识别与动态机理，方法为物理模拟，高度匹配本课题。
papers.abstract: Protein-DNA complexes are stabilized by various interactions through an interaction network between protein and DNA. Any change in the system horizontal line whether through mutations in protein/DNA, external factors, or protein conformational transitions horizontal line can alter the interaction network, affecting structural and functional aspects. Employing all-atom classical molecular dynamics, we investigated how the interaction network in ZTA-DNA is rewired, while key arginine residues in ZTA are mutated to oppositely charged glutamic acids. Using the MM/PBSA technique, we computed per-residue binding energies and correlated them with structural features. A detailed mechanistic study shows that mutations in key arginine residues form new interactions either around the mutation site and/or in the other ZTA monomer. Through load-sharing system attempts to counterbalance the interaction load, leading to reorganization of the existing interaction network. From single- to double-site mutations, the complex partially maintains its structural stability through additional interactions formed by lysine, particularly K178, while multisite mutations cannot sustain its structural stability, leading to system destabilization. Despite inherent structural symmetry in ZTA, an asymmetric monomer contribution is observed upon mutation. The binding affinity of the ZTA-DNA complex shows a good correlation with structural and interaction features, following the trend A > E  approximately  D > C >> B. Overall, our rigorous mechanistic study provides deeper insights into the interaction network reorganization mechanism in the ZTA-DNA system. Since ZTA is a key factor in the Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), this study will be central to understanding DNA recognition and developing drug therapeutics targeting viral transcription factors in EBV.
papers.abstract_zh: 蛋白-DNA复合物通过蛋白质与DNA之间的相互作用网络，由多种相互作用稳定。系统中任何变化——无论是蛋白质/DNA的突变、外部因素，还是蛋白质构象转变——都可能改变相互作用网络，影响结构和功能方面。采用全原子经典分子动力学，我们研究了当ZTA中的关键精氨酸残基被突变为带相反电荷的谷氨酸时，ZTA-DNA中的相互作用网络如何被重新布线。利用MM/PBSA技术，我们计算了每个残基的结合能，并将其与结构特征相关联。一项详细的机制研究表明，关键精氨酸残基的突变会在突变位点附近和/或另一个ZTA单体中形成新的相互作用。通过负载分担系统试图平衡相互作用负载，导致现有相互作用网络的重组。从单位点突变到双位点突变，复合物通过赖氨酸（特别是K178）形成的额外相互作用部分维持其结构稳定性，而多位点突变则无法维持其结构稳定性，导致系统失稳。尽管ZTA具有固有的结构对称性，但在突变时观察到不对称的单体贡献。ZTA-DNA复合物的结合亲和力与结构和相互作用特征显示出良好的相关性，遵循趋势A > E ≈ D > C >> B。总体而言，我们严谨的机制研究为ZTA-DNA系统中相互作用网络重组机制提供了更深入的见解。由于ZTA是爱泼斯坦-巴尔病毒（EBV）中的关键因子，这项研究将对理解DNA识别以及开发靶向EBV病毒转录因子的药物疗法至关重要。

papers.title: Regulatory-prior-guided attention preserves biological structure during unpaired single-cell RNA-ATAC integration.
papers.authors: Cheng, Zhenglong; Zhang, Jiao; Zhang, Shixiong
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用先验引导的Transformer整合单细胞RNA与ATAC数据，虽涉及基因-峰注意力与转录因子程序恢复，但核心是单细胞多模态整合而非TF-DNA结合建模，方法可迁移但非直接聚焦。
papers.abstract: MOTIVATION: Single-cell RNA sequencing and single-cell ATAC sequencing provide complementary views of transcriptional output and chromatin regulatory potential, but integrating unpaired profiles remains challenging because the modalities differ in feature space, sparsity and noise. Existing approaches often frame integration as distribution matching, which can over-align biologically distinct, condition-specific or modality-specific cell states. We present scHPGT, a single-cell Heterogeneous Prior-Guided Transformer for regulatory-prior-guided integration of unpaired RNA and chromatin accessibility profiles. scHPGT uses modality-specific encoders to model RNA and ATAC signals, a prior-guided cross-modal Transformer to constrain gene-peak attention using regulatory links, and a domain-adversarial objective to reduce modality-specific discrepancies in a shared latent space. RESULTS: Across PBMC3k, mouse spleen, CITE-seq/ASAP-seq PBMC and PBMC10k benchmarks, scHPGT improves clustering agreement, label transfer and biological structure preservation while maintaining effective modality alignment. In partial-overlap and condition-shift settings, scHPGT aligns shared populations without forcing unmatched or condition-specific states into inappropriate correspondence. Attention-derived links recover regulatory relationships, highlight marker-gene regulatory regions, recover transcription factor programs and produce regulatory activity profiles consistent with cell-type-specific transcriptional programs. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Code and datasets are released at https://github.com/zlCreator/scHPGT. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.
papers.abstract_zh: 动机：单细胞RNA测序和单细胞ATAC测序提供了转录输出和染色质调控潜力的互补视角，但整合未配对的图谱仍具挑战性，因为这两种模态在特征空间、稀疏性和噪声方面存在差异。现有方法通常将整合视为分布匹配，这可能会过度对齐生物学上不同、条件特异性或模态特异性的细胞状态。我们提出了scHPGT，一种用于调控先验引导整合未配对RNA和染色质可及性图谱的单细胞异质性先验引导Transformer。scHPGT使用模态特异性编码器来建模RNA和ATAC信号，一个先验引导的跨模态Transformer利用调控链接约束基因-峰注意力，以及一个域对抗目标来减少共享潜在空间中的模态特异性差异。结果：在PBMC3k、小鼠脾脏、CITE-seq/ASAP-seq PBMC和PBMC10k基准测试中，scHPGT在保持有效模态对齐的同时，提高了聚类一致性、标签转移和生物学结构保留。在部分重叠和条件偏移设置中，scHPGT对齐共享群体，而不强制不匹配或条件特异性状态进入不适当的对应关系。注意力衍生的链接恢复了调控关系，突出了标记基因调控区域，恢复了转录因子程序，并产生了与细胞类型特异性转录程序一致的调控活性图谱。可用性和实现：代码和数据集发布在https://github.com/zlCreator/scHPGT。补充信息：补充数据可在Bioinformatics在线获取。

papers.title: Structural conservation of the gabapentinoid binding site in human and Caenorhabditis elegans α2δ subunits: a docking and molecular dynamics perspective
papers.authors: Jabin Sultana; Lusine Mkrtchyan; Jesus D Castano; Jerome del Castillo; Francis Beaudry
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究加巴喷丁类药物与钙通道α2δ亚基的结合，属于蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或TF-DNA相关建模，仅用MD和对接，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: Pain is a global health burden, highlighting the need for effective therapeutic strategies. Gabapentin (GBP) and pregabalin (PGB), used for neuropathic pain, act primarily through α2δ auxiliary subunits of voltage-gated calcium channels. Caenorhabditis elegans expresses UNC-36, an ortholog of mammalian α2δ proteins involved in calcium-channel function and nocifensive behavior. However, whether UNC-36 preserves the molecular features required for gabapentinoid recognition remains unclear. We compared human α2δ-1 and UNC-36 using sequence and structural analyses, molecular docking, 500-ns molecular dynamics simulations, interaction profiling, principal component and free-energy landscape analyses, and MM/GBSA calculations. UNC-36 preserved the overall architecture of the mammalian gabapentinoid-binding region despite substantial sequence divergence, and both ligands remained associated with the modeled pockets. However, residue-level interaction networks differed between species. Human α2δ-1 showed greater contributions from aromatic interactions, whereas UNC-36 relied more prominently on cationic and hydrogen-bond donor interactions mediated by Arg501 and Arg503. The human α2δ-1-PGB complex maintained the most stable ligand pose, whereas α2δ-1-GBP showed greater positional variation. In UNC-36, PGB exhibited greater deviation from its initial binding pose than GBP. The first two principal components accounted for more conformational variance in UNC-36 complexes than in human complexes. MM/GBSA estimates showed that PGB was energetically favored over GBP in human α2δ-1, whereas GBP was favored over PGB in UNC-36. These findings show that conservation of the gabapentinoid-binding architecture is accompanied by species-specific differences in interaction chemistry, conformational dynamics, and estimated binding energetics, providing a molecular basis for interpreting C. elegans gabapentinoid responses in a translational context.
papers.abstract_zh: 疼痛是一个全球性的健康负担，凸显了对有效治疗策略的需求。加巴喷丁（GBP）和普瑞巴林（PGB）用于治疗神经病理性疼痛，主要通过电压门控钙通道的α2δ辅助亚基发挥作用。秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）表达UNC-36，这是哺乳动物α2δ蛋白的直系同源物，参与钙通道功能和伤害性行为。然而，UNC-36是否保留了加巴喷丁类药物识别所需的分子特征仍不清楚。我们通过序列和结构分析、分子对接、500纳秒分子动力学模拟、相互作用谱分析、主成分和自由能景观分析以及MM/GBSA计算，比较了人α2δ-1和UNC-36。尽管序列存在显著差异，UNC-36仍保留了哺乳动物加巴喷丁类药物结合区域的整体架构，且两种配体均与模拟的袋状结构保持关联。然而，残基水平的相互作用网络在物种间存在差异。人α2δ-1表现出芳香族相互作用的更大贡献，而UNC-36更显著地依赖由Arg501和Arg503介导的阳离子和氢键供体相互作用。人α2δ-1-PGB复合物维持了最稳定的配体姿态，而α2δ-1-GBP表现出更大的位置变异。在UNC-36中，PGB相比GBP从其初始结合姿态偏离更大。前两个主成分在UNC-36复合物中解释的构象方差大于人复合物。MM/GBSA估算显示，在人α2δ-1中PGB在能量上优于GBP，而在UNC-36中GBP优于PGB。这些发现表明，加巴喷丁类药物结合架构的保守性伴随着物种特异性的相互作用化学、构象动力学和估算结合能量差异，为在转化背景下解释秀丽隐杆线虫加巴喷丁类药物反应提供了分子基础。

papers.title: Development and validation of a machine learning clinicogenomic model to improve prognostic stratification in ER-positive/HER2-negative early breast cancer.
papers.authors: Sarafidis, Michail; Sifakis, Emmanouil G; Bergh, Jonas; Foukakis, Theodoros; Matikas, Alexios
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文开发机器学习临床基因组模型用于乳腺癌预后分层，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Several gene expression signatures (GESs) are used for risk stratification in estrogen receptor-positive/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (ER-positive/HER2-negative) early breast cancer. Recent integrative approaches combine tumour proliferation, estrogen receptor signalling, immune activity, and clinicopathologic features, yielding gains in prognostic accuracy. We therefore developed a machine-learning-based clinicogenomic prognostic model integrating a research-grade implementation of an established GES with immune-related and clinicopathologic features to improve prognostic stratification in ER-positive/HER2-negative early breast cancer. METHODS: This retrospective integrative analysis of publicly available and institutional microarray and RNA-sequencing data included four independent datasets of systemically untreated or endocrine-treated patients (n = 5132). One dataset was used for the development of a random survival forest (RSF) model, and three datasets were used for external validation. The RSF model incorporated a research-grade implementation of the 21-gene recurrence score (RS), the 14-gene immunoglobulin signature, and clinicopathologic features. Model performance was evaluated relative to the standalone research-grade implementation of the 21-gene RS using measures of risk stratification, discrimination, and prediction error. Feature contributions were examined using time-dependent explainability analyses. RESULTS: In external validation, the RSF model identified larger low-risk groups than the standalone 21-gene RS, with relative increases of 33.8 to 111.8%, while maintaining similar or higher horizon-specific survival estimates. The RSF model also improved discrimination over the standalone 21-gene RS across validation datasets, with absolute increases of 0.035 to 0.058 in the concordance index and 0.030 to 0.064 in the integrated area under the time-dependent receiver operating characteristic curve. Risk separation, measured by the difference in restricted mean survival time, was consistently greater for the RSF model, whereas prediction error was comparable or lower according to Cox-recalibrated integrated Brier score. Explainability analyses indicated time-dependent feature contributions, with the 21-gene RS and clinicopathologic variables driving early prognostic performance and the immune component contributing a smaller but more stable effect over time. CONCLUSIONS: This explainable clinicogenomic machine learning model integrates research-grade molecular, immune-related, and clinicopathologic features and improves prognostic stratification in retrospective ER-positive/HER2-negative early breast cancer datasets. These findings support its potential as a more informative and biologically grounded approach to early breast cancer risk assessment.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：在雌激素受体阳性/人表皮生长因子受体2阴性（ER阳性/HER2阴性）早期乳腺癌中，多种基因表达特征（GESs）被用于风险分层。近年来的整合方法结合了肿瘤增殖、雌激素受体信号、免疫活性及临床病理特征，从而提高了预后准确性。因此，我们开发了一种基于机器学习的临床基因组预后模型，将已确立的GES的研究级实现与免疫相关及临床病理特征相结合，以改善ER阳性/HER2阴性早期乳腺癌的预后分层。方法：这项回顾性整合分析使用了公开可用的及机构内部的微阵列和RNA测序数据，包括四个独立数据集，涉及未经系统治疗或接受内分泌治疗的患者（n = 5132）。其中一个数据集用于开发随机生存森林（RSF）模型，另外三个数据集用于外部验证。RSF模型纳入了21基因复发评分（RS）的研究级实现、14基因免疫球蛋白特征及临床病理特征。模型性能相对于独立的研究级21基因RS实现进行评估，使用风险分层、区分度和预测误差等指标。特征贡献通过时间依赖性可解释性分析进行检验。结果：在外部验证中，RSF模型识别出的低风险组比独立的21基因RS更大，相对增加33.8%至111.8%，同时保持相似或更高的时间点特定生存估计。RSF模型在验证数据集上的区分度也优于独立的21基因RS，一致性指数绝对增加0.035至0.058，时间依赖性受试者工作特征曲线下积分面积绝对增加0.030至0.064。通过限制平均生存时间差异测量的风险分离在RSF模型中始终更大，而根据Cox重校准的积分Brier评分，预测误差相当或更低。可解释性分析表明特征贡献具有时间依赖性，21基因RS和临床病理变量驱动早期预后性能，而免疫组分随时间贡献较小但更稳定。结论：这种可解释的临床基因组机器学习模型整合了研究级分子、免疫相关及临床病理特征，并在回顾性ER阳性/HER2阴性早期乳腺癌数据集中改善了预后分层。这些发现支持其作为早期乳腺癌风险评估中更具信息性和生物学基础的方法的潜力。

papers.title: [Effects and mechanisms of Jiawei Yigong San on the Th17/Treg balance in food allergy].
papers.authors: Lin, Xiaoxiao; Liang, Zixuan; Gong, Xuan; Liu, Hua
papers.journal: Xi bao yu fen zi mian yi xue za zhi = Chinese journal of cellular and molecular immunology
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究加味异功散对食物过敏小鼠Th17/Treg平衡的影响，核心为中药疗效与免疫细胞机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: Objective To explore the effects and mechanisms of Jiawei Yigong San (JWYGS) on the T helper type 17 (Th17)/regulatory T (Treg) cell balance in food allergy (FA). Methods Active components, action targets of JWYGS, and FA-related targets, were screened via network pharmacology. Overlapping targets between JWYGS and FA were used to construct a protein-protein interaction (PPI) network. Gene ontology (GO) and Kyoto encyclopedia of genes and genomes (KEGG) enrichment analyses were performed to predict key signaling pathways. Molecular docking was conducted to validate the binding affinity between the main active components and the predicted targets. Mice were randomly divided into control group, model group, JWYGS low-dose, medium-dose, and high-dose groups, and dexamethasone (DXM) group. An ovalbumin (OVA)-induced FA model was established. During the OVA challenge period, mice received daily intragastric administration, after which allergy and diarrhea scores were assessed. Small intestinal pathology was evaluated by HE staining. Serum ovalbumin-specific immunoglobulin E (OVA-sIgE), interleukin 6 (IL-6), IL-17, IL-2, and IL-10 were measured by ELISA. Small intestinal IL-6, IL-17, and IL-10 protein expression was detected by immunohistochemistry. Splenic Th17 and Treg cells were quantified by flow cytometry, and the Th17/Treg ratio was calculated. The mRNA expression of IL-6, retinoic acid receptor-related orphan receptor gammat (RORgammat), and forkhead box protein P3 (FOXP3) in the small intestine was detected by qPCR. Results Network pharmacology identified 235 active components of JWYGS and 136 common targets. GO and KEGG enrichment analyses highlighted cytokine response and Th17 differentiation. Molecular docking confirmed stable binding between core components and targets. Compared with the control group, the model group exhibited aggravated allergy and diarrhea scores, marked small intestinal inflammation and mucosal damage, elevated serum levels of OVA-sIgE, IL-6, IL-17 and IL-2, along with increased splenic Th17 cell frequency and Th17/Treg ratio. Intestinal IL-6 and IL-17 protein levels as well as IL-6 and RORgammat mRNA expression were upregulated, whereas serum IL-10 levels were decreased, and intestinal expression of IL-10 protein and FOXP3 mRNA was downregulated. After JWYGS treatment, allergy and diarrhea scores were significantly reduced. Small intestinal inflammation and mucosal damage were alleviated. Serum levels of OVA-sIgE, IL-17, IL-6 and IL-2, Th17 cell frequency and the Th17/Treg ratio, intestinal IL-6 and IL-17 protein levels were decreased. IL-6 and RORgammat mRNA expression was downregulated. Serum IL-10 levels were increased and intestinal expression of IL-10 protein and FOXP3 mRNA was upregulated. Moreover, the JWYGS high-dose group demonstrated comparable efficacy to the DXM group. Conclusion JWYGS can ameliorate symptoms and reverse the Th17/Treg imbalance in FA mice, potentially by inhibiting IL-6 transcription and regulating RORgammat/FOXP3 expression.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的 探讨加味异功散（JWYGS）对食物过敏（FA）中辅助性T细胞17（Th17）/调节性T细胞（Treg）平衡的影响及机制。方法 通过网络药理学筛选JWYGS的活性成分、作用靶点及FA相关靶点。利用JWYGS与FA的重叠靶点构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络。进行基因本体（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）富集分析以预测关键信号通路。采用分子对接验证主要活性成分与预测靶点之间的结合亲和力。小鼠随机分为对照组、模型组、JWYGS低剂量组、中剂量组、高剂量组和地塞米松（DXM）组。建立卵清蛋白（OVA）诱导的FA模型。在OVA激发期间，小鼠每日灌胃给药，随后评估过敏和腹泻评分。通过HE染色评估小肠病理。采用ELISA检测血清卵清蛋白特异性免疫球蛋白E（OVA-sIgE）、白细胞介素6（IL-6）、IL-17、IL-2和IL-10。通过免疫组化检测小肠IL-6、IL-17和IL-10蛋白表达。通过流式细胞术定量脾脏Th17和Treg细胞，并计算Th17/Treg比值。通过qPCR检测小肠中IL-6、维甲酸相关孤儿受体γt（RORγt）和叉头框蛋白P3（FOXP3）的mRNA表达。结果 网络药理学鉴定出JWYGS的235个活性成分和136个共同靶点。GO和KEGG富集分析突出显示了细胞因子反应和Th17分化。分子对接证实核心成分与靶点之间具有稳定结合。与对照组相比，模型组过敏和腹泻评分加重，小肠炎症和黏膜损伤明显，血清OVA-sIgE、IL-6、IL-17和IL-2水平升高，脾脏Th17细胞频率和Th17/Treg比值增加。肠道IL-6和IL-17蛋白水平以及IL-6和RORγt mRNA表达上调，而血清IL-10水平降低，肠道IL-10蛋白和FOXP3 mRNA表达下调。JWYGS治疗后，过敏和腹泻评分显著降低。小肠炎症和黏膜损伤得到缓解。血清OVA-sIgE、IL-17、IL-6和IL-2水平、Th17细胞频率和Th17/Treg比值、肠道IL-6和IL-17蛋白水平均降低。IL-6和RORγt mRNA表达下调。血清IL-10水平升高，肠道IL-10蛋白和FOXP3 mRNA表达上调。此外，JWYGS高剂量组显示出与DXM组相当的功效。结论 JWYGS可改善FA小鼠的症状并逆转Th17/Treg失衡，其机制可能通过抑制IL-6转录和调节RORγt/FOXP3表达实现。

papers.title: Calcitonin gene-related peptide promotes mast cell-mediated neuroimmune inflammation through the CALCRL/RAMP1-JAK3-STAT1 axis in rosacea.
papers.authors: Li, Xiaojin; Fan, Huiping; Sun, Rui; Ma, Qingsong; Liu, Jiayun; Liu, Chengqi; Zhang, Dong; Ma, Weiyuan
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究CGRP通过CALCRL/RAMP1-JAK3-STAT1轴促进肥大细胞介导的神经免疫炎症在玫瑰痤疮中的作用，属于皮肤炎症疾病机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Rosacea is a chronic inflammatory skin disorder characterized by neurovascular instability and dysregulated innate immunity. Although mast-cell activation is increasingly recognized as a central pathogenic feature, the neuroimmune mechanisms linking neuropeptide signaling to mast cell-mediated inflammation remain incompletely defined. This study investigated whether calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) promotes mast cell-mediated inflammation in rosacea and explored the underlying signaling mechanism. METHODS: Bioinformatic analyses of the GSE65914 dataset were performed to characterize rosacea-associated molecular pathways and mast-cell signatures. Serum and skin samples from patients with rosacea and healthy controls were analyzed by ELISA, histological staining, and immunofluorescence. In vitro, CGRP-induced mast-cell activation and CALCRL/RAMP1-JAK3-STAT1 signaling were investigated in LUVA cells using RT-qPCR, western blotting, immunofluorescence, degranulation assays, ELISA, and pharmacological approaches, while the potential CALCRL-JAK3 association was assessed by molecular docking and reciprocal co-immunoprecipitation. In vivo, ACK2-mediated mast-cell depletion and pharmacological blockade of the CGRP receptor or JAK3 were evaluated in CGRP-aggravated LL37-induced rosacea-like mouse models. RESULTS: Rosacea lesions showed enrichment of immune-inflammatory pathways, JAK-STAT signaling, and mast cell-associated signatures. Serum CGRP levels were elevated in patients with rosacea and positively correlated with flushing and erythema severity. Lesional skin showed increased CGRP expression and enhanced localization of CALCRL, RAMP1, phosphorylated JAK3, and phosphorylated STAT1 in dermal CD117+ mast cells. In LUVA mast cells, CGRP upregulated CALCRL/RAMP1 expression, activated JAK3-STAT1 signaling, and promoted degranulation, histamine release, and inflammatory mediator production. Molecular docking and reciprocal co-immunoprecipitation supported a potential association between CALCRL and JAK3. Rimegepant or ritlecitinib attenuated CGRP-induced JAK3-STAT1 activation and mast-cell responses. Modulation of the canonical Galphas-cAMP-PKA pathway did not abolish CGRP-induced JAK3-STAT1 phosphorylation, indicating that this response is not primarily mediated by the cAMP-PKA cascade. In vivo, mast-cell lineage depletion attenuated CGRP-driven exacerbation of LL37-induced rosacea-like inflammation, while rimegepant or ritlecitinib alleviated inflammatory changes and reduced JAK3-STAT1 activation and mast-cell responses. CONCLUSION: These findings identify a CGRP-associated neuroimmune pathway in rosacea in which CALCRL/RAMP1-linked JAK3-STAT1 signaling promotes mast cell-mediated inflammatory amplification. Targeting the CGRP-CALCRL/RAMP1-JAK3-STAT1 axis may provide a mechanism-based therapeutic strategy for neurovascular-dominant or treatment-refractory rosacea.
papers.abstract_zh: 引言：玫瑰痤疮是一种慢性炎症性皮肤病，其特征为神经血管不稳定和先天免疫失调。尽管肥大细胞活化日益被认为是核心致病特征，但将神经肽信号传导与肥大细胞介导的炎症联系起来的神经免疫机制仍未完全明确。本研究探讨了降钙素基因相关肽（calcitonin gene-related peptide, CGRP）是否促进玫瑰痤疮中肥大细胞介导的炎症，并探索了其潜在信号传导机制。方法：对GSE65914数据集进行生物信息学分析，以表征玫瑰痤疮相关的分子通路和肥大细胞特征。通过ELISA、组织学染色和免疫荧光分析玫瑰痤疮患者及健康对照者的血清和皮肤样本。体外实验中，使用RT-qPCR、western blotting、免疫荧光、脱颗粒测定、ELISA和药理学方法，在LUVA细胞中研究CGRP诱导的肥大细胞活化及CALCRL/RAMP1-JAK3-STAT1信号传导，同时通过分子对接和双向免疫共沉淀评估CALCRL-JAK3的潜在关联。体内实验中，在CGRP加重的LL37诱导的玫瑰痤疮样小鼠模型中，评估ACK2介导的肥大细胞耗竭以及CGRP受体或JAK3的药理学阻断效果。结果：玫瑰痤疮病变显示免疫炎症通路、JAK-STAT信号传导和肥大细胞相关特征的富集。玫瑰痤疮患者血清CGRP水平升高，并与潮红和红斑严重程度呈正相关。病变皮肤显示CGRP表达增加，且真皮CD117+肥大细胞中CALCRL、RAMP1、磷酸化JAK3和磷酸化STAT1的定位增强。在LUVA肥大细胞中，CGRP上调CALCRL/RAMP1表达，激活JAK3-STAT1信号传导，并促进脱颗粒、组胺释放和炎症介质产生。分子对接和双向免疫共沉淀支持CALCRL与JAK3之间的潜在关联。Rimegepant或ritlecitinib减弱了CGRP诱导的JAK3-STAT1激活和肥大细胞反应。调节经典Galphas-cAMP-PKA通路并未消除CGRP诱导的JAK3-STAT1磷酸化，表明该反应并非主要由cAMP-PKA级联介导。体内实验中，肥大细胞谱系耗竭减弱了CGRP驱动的LL37诱导玫瑰痤疮样炎症加重，而rimegepant或ritlecitinib缓解了炎症变化并减少了JAK3-STAT1激活和肥大细胞反应。结论：这些发现确定了玫瑰痤疮中一条CGRP相关的神经免疫通路，其中CALCRL/RAMP1关联的JAK3-STAT1信号传导促进肥大细胞介导的炎症放大。靶向CGRP-CALCRL/RAMP1-JAK3-STAT1轴可能为神经血管主导型或难治性玫瑰痤疮提供基于机制的治療策略。

papers.title: Computational screening of oncogenic genetic variations in tumor suppressor proteins driving gastric cancer pathogenesis.
papers.authors: Mim, Faria Ferdouse; Sumiya, Taslima Akter; Khanam, Roksana; Akter, Jannati; Arzu, Farhana; Haque, Samia; Miah, Md Roman; Islam, K M Tanjida; Mahmud, Shahin
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用图神经网络筛选胃癌肿瘤抑制基因及其致病突变，虽涉及TP53等蛋白与转录因子EZH2调控，但核心是基因表达与突变分析，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或结合机制研究，仅部分方法可借鉴。
papers.abstract: Gastric cancer (GC) is currently the fifth most common cancer globally, often driven by dysregulation of tumor suppressor pathways. While individual studies on genetic variations of proteins are common, a comprehensive systems-level analysis of proteins regulating GC pathways showing both expression dysregulation and high mutation frequency remains unexplored. Therefore, our study aimed to identify critical genes and their pathogenic variations disrupting the tumor-suppressive capacity of the GC pathway. We employed a deep learning-based graph neural network model to identify genes exhibiting both dysregulated expression and high mutation propensity in GC. Key tumor suppressor proteins (TP53, CDH1, and APC), their genetic variants, and molecular components were subjected to in-depth computational analyses, including evolutionary conservation profiling, biophysical energetics assessment, and unsupervised machine learning for conformational change detection. Variants were validated from the cBioPortal database and patient survival data. Our deep learning model demonstrated exceptional performance (MSE: 0.00482 +/- 0.00023 to 0.07108 +/- 0.00437; R(2): 0.85098 +/- 0.01903 to 0.85899 +/- 0.01987; AUC-ROC: 0.93095 +/- 0.01758 to 0.93309 +/- 0.00725) and identified 1,886 genes exhibiting both differential expression and mutation propensity. Graph neural network analysis revealed TP53 as the most prominent hub gene (47.6% mutation frequency), followed by ERBB2 (8.8%), CDH1 (8.2%), and APC (6.8%). Variants validation from cBioPortal confirmed the association of GC with 36 missense SNPs that critically affect post-translational modification (methylation and phosphorylation) sites and 60 nonsense SNPs. Furthermore, TP53, CDH1, and APC were significantly upregulated in GC tissues and associated with altered patient survival (p < 0.05). The transcription factor EZH2 and miRNA miR-129-5p were identified as key regulatory elements affecting all three tumor suppressors. Additionally, mutations trigger dysregulation of multiple common oncogenes, including CCNE1/2 and FGFR2. This systems-level analysis provides a molecular framework demonstrating how pathogenic variants fundamentally compromise tumor suppressor proteins in GC pathways, leading to the identification of potential biomarkers and precise therapeutic decisions for GC intervention.
papers.abstract_zh: 胃癌（GC）目前是全球第五大常见癌症，通常由肿瘤抑制通路失调驱动。虽然关于蛋白质遗传变异的个体研究较为普遍，但对调控GC通路的蛋白质进行系统级综合分析，同时显示表达失调和高突变频率的研究仍属空白。因此，本研究旨在识别关键基因及其致病性变异，这些变异破坏GC通路的肿瘤抑制能力。我们采用基于深度学习的图神经网络模型来识别在GC中同时表现出失调表达和高突变倾向的基因。关键肿瘤抑制蛋白（TP53、CDH1和APC）、其遗传变异及分子组分接受了深入的计算分析，包括进化保守性分析、生物物理能量学评估以及用于构象变化检测的无监督机器学习。变异从cBioPortal数据库和患者生存数据中得到验证。我们的深度学习模型表现出卓越性能（MSE：0.00482 ± 0.00023至0.07108 ± 0.00437；R²：0.85098 ± 0.01903至0.85899 ± 0.01987；AUC-ROC：0.93095 ± 0.01758至0.93309 ± 0.00725），并识别出1,886个同时表现出差异表达和突变倾向的基因。图神经网络分析揭示TP53是最显著的中心基因（突变频率47.6%），其次是ERBB2（8.8%）、CDH1（8.2%）和APC（6.8%）。来自cBioPortal的变异验证确认了GC与36个错义SNP和60个无义SNP的关联，这些SNP关键影响翻译后修饰（甲基化和磷酸化）位点。此外，TP53、CDH1和APC在GC组织中显著上调，并与患者生存期改变相关（p < 0.05）。转录因子EZH2和miRNA miR-129-5p被识别为影响所有三种肿瘤抑制因子的关键调控元件。此外，突变触发多个常见癌基因的失调，包括CCNE1/2和FGFR2。这项系统级分析提供了一个分子框架，展示了致病性变异如何从根本上损害GC通路中的肿瘤抑制蛋白，从而为GC干预识别潜在生物标志物和精准治疗决策奠定基础。

papers.title: Fused Azine Derivatives Mitigate Long-Term Paracetamol-Induced Liver Fibrosis in Mice: Role of JNK1/ASK1 and Nrf2/HO-1 Signaling Pathways.
papers.authors: Shawky, Ahmed Reda; Metwaly, Heba A; Ragab, Hanan M; Wahid, Ahmed
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究融合吖嗪衍生物对扑热息痛诱导小鼠肝纤维化的保护作用及JNK1/ASK1和Nrf2/HO-1信号通路机制，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: Liver fibrosis is a significant public health issue that necessitates an ongoing urge for efficient novel treatments. Our newly synthesized fused azine derivative compounds (1a, 1b, 2a, and 2b) were used in this study based on our promising results achieved by our team in previous studies on tacrine derivatives. This study investigated these compounds' hepatoprotective effect on mice with paracetamol (APAP) induced liver fibrosis and clarified their possible mechanisms. The administration of these compounds successfully reduced APAP-induced hepatic fibrosis through decreasing serum liver enzymes, as well as the hepatic pathological deterioration. Moreover, they increased hepatic antioxidants and countered oxidative stress caused by APAP. Furthermore, by lowering inflammatory cytokine levels and raising anti-inflammatory marker levels, these compounds effectively ameliorated the inflammatory response. Additionally, they decreased APAP induced levels of apoptosis-signal-regulating kinase-1 (ASK-1) and c-Jun-N-terminal kinase (JNK1). Additionally, they reduced caspase-3 and BCL2-associated X-protein (Bax) levels and promoted Nrf2 signaling pathway activation. Notably, the in-silico computer-assisted simulation docking results were consistent with the experimental measurements.
papers.abstract_zh: 肝纤维化是一个重要的公共卫生问题，迫切需要持续寻求高效的新型治疗方法。基于我们团队在先前对他克林衍生物研究中取得的令人鼓舞的成果，本研究使用了我们新合成的稠合吖嗪衍生物化合物（1a、1b、2a 和 2b）。本研究考察了这些化合物对对乙酰氨基酚（APAP）诱导的肝纤维化小鼠的保肝作用，并阐明了其可能的作用机制。给予这些化合物通过降低血清肝酶水平以及减轻肝脏病理恶化，成功减轻了APAP诱导的肝纤维化。此外，它们增加了肝脏抗氧化剂水平，并抵御了APAP引起的氧化应激。进一步地，通过降低炎症细胞因子水平并提高抗炎标志物水平，这些化合物有效改善了炎症反应。此外，它们降低了APAP诱导的凋亡信号调节激酶-1（ASK-1）和c-Jun N末端激酶（JNK1）水平。同时，它们降低了caspase-3和BCL2相关X蛋白（Bax）水平，并促进了Nrf2信号通路的激活。值得注意的是，计算机辅助模拟对接结果与实验测量结果一致。

papers.title: Martini 3 Coarse-Grained Model of DNA for Heterogeneous Molecular Systems
papers.authors: Rokas Dargis; Gaurav Arya
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文开发了Martini 3粗粒化DNA模型，通过贝叶斯优化和Wasserstein度量拟合全原子模拟，并展示其与转录因子结合等蛋白-DNA互作模拟，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系研究。
papers.abstract: DNA often functions in heterogeneous molecular systems containing proteins, lipids, polymers, and other materials. All-atom molecular dynamics simulations can be used to study DNA in these multicomponent systems, but computational cost limits the accessible system sizes and time scales. Coarse-grained models extend these scales, but existing DNA models are generally not designed for interactions with a broad range of other molecular species. To fill this gap, we develop a coarse-grained model of DNA designed for use with the Martini 3 force field. The model was parameterized through an iterative Bayesian optimization workflow, which used a scaled Wasserstein metric to compare distributions of local geometrical features and global structure from coarse-grained simulations against all-atom reference simulations. The optimized model captures key structural and mechanical properties of single- and double-stranded DNA across varying strand lengths and ionic conditions, while retaining compatibility with the broader Martini 3 ecosystem. This compatibility enables DNA to be integrated with a broad range of molecular systems, as we illustrate through simulations of double-stranded DNA bound to a transcription factor, cholesterol-tagged DNA duplex interacting with a lipid bilayer, a crossover-containing DNA nanostructure, and single-stranded DNA adsorbing onto graphene. Together, these results establish a transferable coarse-grained model of DNA for simulations of heterogeneous biomolecular and engineered systems.
papers.abstract_zh: DNA通常在含有蛋白质、脂质、聚合物及其他材料的异质分子系统中发挥功能。全原子分子动力学模拟可用于研究这些多组分系统中的DNA，但计算成本限制了可访问的系统规模和时间尺度。粗粒化模型扩展了这些尺度，但现有的DNA模型通常并非为与广泛的其他分子种类相互作用而设计。为填补这一空白，我们开发了一种专为与Martini 3力场配合使用的DNA粗粒化模型。该模型通过迭代贝叶斯优化工作流程进行参数化，该流程使用缩放Wasserstein度量，将粗粒化模拟中的局部几何特征和全局结构分布与全原子参考模拟进行比较。优化后的模型捕获了单链和双链DNA在不同链长和离子条件下的关键结构和机械特性，同时保持与更广泛的Martini 3生态系统的兼容性。这种兼容性使DNA能够与广泛的分子系统集成，我们通过模拟双链DNA与转录因子结合、胆固醇标记的DNA双链体与脂质双层相互作用、含交叉的DNA纳米结构以及单链DNA吸附在石墨烯上进行了说明。综合这些结果，我们建立了一个可转移的DNA粗粒化模型，用于异质生物分子和工程系统的模拟。

papers.title: Genomic foundation model-derived disruption profiling links somatic mutations to cancer biology and clinical outcomes
papers.authors: Nayak A; Lee T; Agarwal V; Georgakopoulos-Soares I
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文利用基因组基础模型AlphaGenome和AlphaMissense量化体细胞突变对转录因子结合、染色质可及性等基因调控功能的破坏，并关联临床结局，虽非直接建模TF-DNA互作机制，但方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合位点扰动预测，对课题有借鉴价值。
papers.abstract: Cancer genomics has concentrated on individual mutations, overlooking whether somatic mutations can accumulate to produce partial, gene-level disruption with biological and clinical consequences. Sequence-to-function models can quantify these effects directly from DNA sequence. Here, we use AlphaGenome and AlphaMissense to quantify the disruption imposed by somatic mutations across 8,800 patients and 33 cancer types from The Cancer Genome Atlas. At the individual-variant level, recurrent hotspot mutations showed substantially larger predicted protein-level effects, whereas non-hotspot mutations exhibited larger regulatory effects across most cancer types. We then aggregated the variant-level predictions to construct patient-gene disruption profiles capturing transcriptional activity, chromatin accessibility, transcription factor binding, and splicing. These profiles were gene- and modality-specific, and reflected tissue of origin, cancer type, and microsatellite-instability status while retaining information beyond tumor mutational burden. Among patients lacking recurrent hotspot mutations in a given cancer gene, higher predicted disruption was associated with overall survival, with the strongest and most consistent signal observed for chromatin accessibility. In an independent treatment-annotated cohort, gene-level disruption was also associated with survival within treatment-defined subgroups. Together, these findings show that recurrent hotspots are enriched for strong predicted protein-level effects, whereas regulatory consequences are distributed more broadly across other variants, supporting a continuous, multidimensional view of cancer-gene perturbation beyond discrete drivers.
papers.abstract_zh: 癌症基因组学一直聚焦于个体突变，忽视了体细胞突变能否累积产生部分性、基因水平的破坏，并带来生物学和临床后果。序列到功能模型可以直接从DNA序列量化这些效应。在此，我们使用AlphaGenome和AlphaMissense量化了来自癌症基因组图谱（The Cancer Genome Atlas）的8,800名患者和33种癌症类型中体细胞突变所施加的破坏。在个体变异水平上，复发性热点突变显示出显著更大的预测蛋白质水平效应，而大多数癌症类型中，非热点突变则表现出更大的调控效应。随后，我们聚合了变异水平的预测，构建了患者-基因破坏谱，涵盖转录活性、染色质可及性、转录因子结合和剪接。这些谱具有基因和模态特异性，并反映了组织来源、癌症类型和微卫星不稳定性状态，同时保留了超越肿瘤突变负荷的信息。在缺乏特定癌症基因复发性热点突变的患者中，较高的预测破坏与总生存期相关，其中染色质可及性观察到的信号最强且最一致。在一个独立的治疗注释队列中，基因水平破坏也与治疗定义亚组内的生存期相关。综合来看，这些发现表明复发性热点富集于强预测蛋白质水平效应，而调控后果则更广泛地分布在其他变异中，支持了超越离散驱动因子的癌症基因扰动的连续、多维视角。

papers.title: Mixed positive and negative feedback loops drive diverse single-cell gene expression dynamics.
papers.authors: Loman, Torkel E; Schwall, Christian P; Saez, Teresa; Liu, Yujia; Locke, James C W
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究基因调控网络中的混合正负反馈环动力学，虽涉及转录因子sigma(B)/sigma(V)但聚焦单细胞表达动态而非蛋白-DNA互作建模，且方法为随机建模与实验，无AI或物理模拟的TF-DNA结合机制研究。
papers.abstract: Genetic circuits with only a few components can generate complex gene regulatory dynamics. Here, we combine stochastic modelling and single-cell time-lapse microscopy to map how a common circuit motif, the mixed positive/negative feedback loop, gives rise to diverse single-cell behaviours. Our minimal stochastic model of this motif reveals ten distinct classes of dynamic output, including stochastic pulsing, oscillations, and bistability. We systematically map how the circuit's core parameters can be tuned to generate each of the behaviours. Experimental validation in two different mixed feedback circuits in the bacterium Bacillus subtilis, sigma(B) and sigma(V), confirms our model's predictive power. Guided by our simulations, we are able to transition between selected dynamic behaviours by modulating in vivo parameters. Together, these results establish a quantitative framework for how mixed feedback loops generate diverse single-cell dynamics, improving our understanding of this common biological network motif and informing our efforts to engineer them for synthetic biology applications.
papers.abstract_zh: 仅含少数组件的基因电路即可产生复杂的基因调控动态。在此，我们结合随机建模与单细胞延时显微镜技术，绘制了常见电路基序——混合正/负反馈环——如何引发多样化的单细胞行为。我们针对该基序的最小随机模型揭示了十种不同的动态输出类别，包括随机脉冲、振荡和双稳态。我们系统性地绘制了电路核心参数如何被调节以产生每种行为。在枯草芽孢杆菌（Bacillus subtilis）的sigma(B)和sigma(V)两种不同混合反馈电路中的实验验证，确认了我们模型的预测能力。在模拟的指导下，我们能够通过调节体内参数在选定的动态行为之间进行转换。综合这些结果，我们建立了一个定量框架，用以说明混合反馈环如何产生多样化的单细胞动态，增进了我们对这一常见生物网络基序的理解，并为合成生物学应用中的工程化努力提供了指导。

papers.title: Muscularis EGR1 Deficiency Impairs M2 Macrophage Polarization and Disrupts Gastric Motility in Diabetic Gastroparesis.
papers.authors: Xie, Ni; Su, Guanhao; Wu, Ying; Peng, Kui; Mei, Zhu; Chen, Wei; Xu, Kai; Li, Baiwen
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦糖尿病胃轻瘫中EGR1调控巨噬细胞极化与ICC损伤的机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Diabetic gastroparesis (DGP) is characterized by delayed gastric emptying and limited mechanism-based therapies. Pyloric dysfunction has been associated with loss of interstitial cells of Cajal (ICC) and altered muscularis macrophage polarization. This study examined whether early growth response 1 (EGR1) links macrophage polarization to ICC integrity in DGP. METHODS: Human full-thickness gastric body transcriptomic data (GSE115601) were analyzed using differential expression and exploratory machine learning, with validation in single-cell RNA sequencing data (GSE252126) and clinical pyloric muscularis biopsies. A streptozotocin-induced DGP rat model was used to test local pyloric adeno-associated virus 9 (AAV9)-mediated EGR1 restoration. Macrophage and primary ICC experiments included EGR1 knockdown, thioredoxin 2 (TXN2) rescue, mitochondrial respiration analysis, cytokine profiling, C-C motif chemokine ligand 5 (CCL5) neutralization, and C-C chemokine receptor 5 (CCR5) blockade. RESULTS: EGR1 was downregulated in DGP gastric body samples and subsequently validated in human pyloric muscularis biopsies, with enrichment in macrophages, particularly M2 macrophages. EGR1 loss reduced TXN2 transcription and mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS), impaired M2 polarization, and increased macrophage CCL5 secretion. Conditioned medium from EGR1-deficient macrophages induced Ca(2+) dysregulation, NLR family pyrin domain containing 3 (NLRP3) activation, and ICC marker loss; these effects were attenuated by CCL5 neutralization or CCR5 blockade. Local AAV9-EGR1 restoration increased M2 macrophage and ICC marker expression, improved gastric emptying, and regularized pyloric slow waves without improving systemic glucose control. CONCLUSIONS: Muscularis EGR1 deficiency may promote DGP by disrupting TXN2-dependent macrophage OXPHOS and triggering CCL5/CCR5/NLRP3-mediated ICC injury. Local EGR1 restoration improved gastric motility and may represent a therapeutic strategy.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：糖尿病胃轻瘫（DGP）以胃排空延迟为特征，且缺乏基于机制的疗法。幽门功能障碍与卡哈尔间质细胞（ICC）丢失及肌层巨噬细胞极化改变相关。本研究探讨了早期生长反应因子1（EGR1）是否在DGP中将巨噬细胞极化与ICC完整性联系起来。方法：利用差异表达和探索性机器学习分析人类全层胃体转录组数据（GSE115601），并在单细胞RNA测序数据（GSE252126）和临床幽门肌层活检中验证。使用链脲佐菌素诱导的DGP大鼠模型测试局部幽门腺相关病毒9（AAV9）介导的EGR1恢复。巨噬细胞和原代ICC实验包括EGR1敲低、硫氧还蛋白2（TXN2）拯救、线粒体呼吸分析、细胞因子谱分析、C-C基序趋化因子配体5（CCL5）中和及C-C趋化因子受体5（CCR5）阻断。结果：EGR1在DGP胃体样本中下调，并在人类幽门肌层活检中得到验证，且在巨噬细胞中富集，尤其是M2巨噬细胞。EGR1缺失降低了TXN2转录和线粒体氧化磷酸化（OXPHOS），损害M2极化，并增加巨噬细胞CCL5分泌。EGR1缺陷巨噬细胞的条件培养基诱导Ca(2+)失调、NLR家族含吡啶结构域3（NLRP3）激活及ICC标志物丢失；这些效应通过CCL5中和或CCR5阻断得到减弱。局部AAV9-EGR1恢复增加了M2巨噬细胞和ICC标志物表达，改善了胃排空，并规律化幽门慢波，但未改善全身血糖控制。结论：肌层EGR1缺陷可能通过破坏TXN2依赖性巨噬细胞OXPHOS并触发CCL5/CCR5/NLRP3介导的ICC损伤来促进DGP。局部EGR1恢复改善了胃动力，可能代表一种治疗策略。

papers.title: TMEM59L promotes neuroendocrine differentiation and enzalutamide resistance in prostate cancer by regulating MUC1/beta-catenin/MYC axis.
papers.authors: Guo, Xiuchen; Liu, Yifan; Huang, Jiacheng; Chen, Zhiwei; Liao, Haihong; Xu, Yulin; Cui, Xingang; Yu, Yongjiang
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究TMEM59L通过MUC1/beta-catenin/MYC轴促进前列腺癌神经内分泌分化与耐药，虽涉及分子对接但核心为肿瘤信号通路与湿实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Enzalutamide resistance in advanced prostate cancer often leads to treatment-induced neuroendocrine prostate cancer (t-NEPC), characterized by aggressive lineage plasticity. The molecular regulators governing neuroendocrine differentiation and phenotypic transition are not well understood. Here, we characterize the functional role of the transmembrane protein TMEM59L in driving PCa progression, lineage plasticity and therapeutic resistance. METHODS: We combined bulk RNA sequencing, single-cell RNA sequencing, and spatial transcriptomics datasets to assess TMEM59L expression patterns and their association with clinical features. We investigated the biological functions of TMEM59L using enzalutamide-resistant (EnzR) PCa cell lines in vitro and corresponding mouse xenograft models in vivo. Mechanistic interactions were elucidated through molecular assays, including co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP), GST pull-down and molecular docking. RESULTS: TMEM59L expression is negatively regulated by androgen receptor (AR) signalling and markedly elevated in EnzR PCa tissues. In PCa cells, ectopic TMEM59L expression induced a neuroendocrine-like phenotype, enhanced stemness, promoted epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) and conferred enzalutamide resistance. Conversely, TMEM59L depletion restored drug sensitivity and significantly suppressed EnzR tumour growth in vivo. Mechanistically, TMEM59L directly interacts with MUC1 to facilitate its nuclear accumulation, thereby activating the downstream beta-catenin/MYC signalling axis. Importantly, pharmacological inhibition or genetic silencing of MUC1 effectively reversed TMEM59L-induced neuroendocrine differentiation, stemness and enzalutamide resistance. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings uncover a previously unrecognized TMEM59L/MUC1/beta-catenin/MYC signalling cascade associated with neuroendocrine differentiation and enzalutamide resistance in PCa. Targeting this regulatory axis presents a promising therapeutic strategy to circumvent resistance to next-generation AR signalling inhibitors.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：晚期前列腺癌中的恩杂鲁胺耐药常导致治疗诱导的神经内分泌前列腺癌（t-NEPC），其特征为侵袭性谱系可塑性。调控神经内分泌分化和表型转变的分子调控因子尚不明确。在此，我们表征了跨膜蛋白TMEM59L在驱动前列腺癌进展、谱系可塑性和治疗耐药中的功能作用。方法：我们结合批量RNA测序、单细胞RNA测序和空间转录组数据集，评估TMEM59L表达模式及其与临床特征的关联。我们使用恩杂鲁胺耐药（EnzR）前列腺癌细胞系在体外及相应小鼠异种移植模型在体内研究了TMEM59L的生物学功能。通过分子实验（包括免疫共沉淀（Co-IP）、GST pull-down和分子对接）阐明了机制性相互作用。结果：TMEM59L表达受雄激素受体（AR）信号负调控，并在EnzR前列腺癌组织中显著升高。在前列腺癌细胞中，异位TMEM59L表达诱导神经内分泌样表型、增强干性、促进上皮-间质转化（EMT）并赋予恩杂鲁胺耐药性。相反，TMEM59L缺失恢复了药物敏感性，并在体内显著抑制EnzR肿瘤生长。机制上，TMEM59L直接与MUC1相互作用以促进其核积累，从而激活下游β-catenin/MYC信号轴。重要的是，MUC1的药理学抑制或基因沉默有效逆转了TMEM59L诱导的神经内分泌分化、干性和恩杂鲁胺耐药。结论：我们的发现揭示了一个先前未被识别的TMEM59L/MUC1/β-catenin/MYC信号级联，与前列腺癌中的神经内分泌分化和恩杂鲁胺耐药相关。靶向这一调控轴为规避下一代AR信号抑制剂耐药提供了一种有前景的治疗策略。

papers.title: Electronic structure, DNA-binding, and biological activity correlations in transition metal complexes of a tetradentate Schiff base: experimental and computational studies.
papers.authors: Michael, Samuel; Jeyaraman, Porkodi; Gnanamani, Lavanya; Raman, Natarajan; Tamilselvan, Silambarasan; Nagaraj, Karuppiah
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究过渡金属-Schiff碱配合物与小牛胸腺DNA的结合，使用光谱、电化学、DFT和分子对接，但对象为小分子金属配合物而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD模拟，仅部分方法可借鉴。
papers.abstract: A novel tetradentate Schiff base ligand (L), synthesized by the condensation of 2,6-diaminopyridine and 3,5-dichlorosalicylaldehyde, and its Cu(II), Ni(II), Co(II), Zn(II), and VO(IV) complexes were prepared and characterized by elemental analysis, FT-IR, UV-Vis, NMR, ESI-mass, magnetic susceptibility, thermal, and EPR studies. Spectroscopic evidence indicates coordination of the ligand through an N(2)O(2) donor set. Based on the available spectroscopic, magnetic, and analytical data, the Cu(II), Ni(II), and Co(II) complexes are proposed to adopt predominantly square-planar geometries, while the Zn(II) and VO(IV) complexes are proposed to possess distorted tetrahedral and square-pyramidal geometries, respectively. DNA-binding interactions with calf thymus DNA were investigated using UV-Vis absorption, viscosity, and electrochemical techniques. The observed hypochromism, minor bathochromic shifts, and viscosity changes suggest a predominantly intercalative binding mode, with intrinsic binding constants (K(b)) ranging from 3.59 x 10(4) to 6.43 x 10(4) M(-1); the Cu(II) complex exhibited the highest affinity. Electrochemical studies further supported complex-DNA interactions. Density functional theory and molecular electrostatic potential analyses revealed enhanced electronic stabilization, with the Cu(II) and VO(IV) complexes exhibiting the smallest HOMO-LUMO energy gaps. These findings are consistent with their stronger DNA-binding affinity and higher biological activity. Molecular docking provided supportive evidence for favorable biomolecular interactions, particularly for the Cu(II) complex. Metal coordination enhanced the antibacterial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory activities compared with the free ligand, with the Cu(II) and VO(IV) complexes showing the most promising overall performance. The results demonstrate correlations between electronic structure, DNA-binding behavior, and biological activity in this class of transition metal complexes.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过2,6-二氨基吡啶与3,5-二氯水杨醛缩合合成了一种新型四齿席夫碱配体（L），并制备了其Cu(II)、Ni(II)、Co(II)、Zn(II)和VO(IV)配合物，通过元素分析、FT-IR、UV-Vis、NMR、ESI-质谱、磁化率、热分析和EPR研究对其进行了表征。光谱证据表明，配体通过N(2)O(2)供体集进行配位。基于现有的光谱、磁性和分析数据，Cu(II)、Ni(II)和Co(II)配合物被认为主要采用平面正方形几何构型，而Zn(II)和VO(IV)配合物分别被认为具有畸变四面体和四方锥几何构型。使用UV-Vis吸收、粘度和电化学技术研究了与小牛胸腺DNA的DNA结合相互作用。观察到的减色效应、轻微红移和粘度变化表明主要为嵌入结合模式，固有结合常数（K(b)）范围为3.59 x 10(4)至6.43 x 10(4) M(-1)；其中Cu(II)配合物表现出最高的亲和力。电化学研究进一步支持了配合物-DNA相互作用。密度泛函理论和分子静电势分析揭示了增强的电子稳定性，其中Cu(II)和VO(IV)配合物表现出最小的HOMO-LUMO能隙。这些发现与其更强的DNA结合亲和力和更高的生物活性一致。分子对接为有利的生物分子相互作用提供了支持性证据，尤其是对Cu(II)配合物。与自由配体相比，金属配位增强了抗菌、抗氧化和抗炎活性，其中Cu(II)和VO(IV)配合物表现出最有前景的综合性能。结果表明，在这类过渡金属配合物中，电子结构、DNA结合行为和生物活性之间存在相关性。

papers.title: The chromokinesin Kid (KIF22) forms a homodimer, moves processively along microtubules, and transports double-stranded DNA.
papers.authors: Niwa, Shinsuke; Furusaki, Natsuki; Kita, Tomoki; Suzuki, Yuki; Chiba, Kyoko
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究染色体驱动蛋白Kid沿微管运输双链DNA的机制，涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，且方法以实验为主、仅用AlphaFold3辅助预测，与课题部分相关。
papers.abstract: During prometaphase in mitosis, chromosomes are pushed toward the spindle equator. The chromokinesin Kid, also known as KIF22, moves chromosomes along spindle microtubules during prometaphase. Kid has long been considered a monomeric and nonprocessive motor, different from typical kinesins. In this study, we demonstrate that the full-length Kid forms a homodimer and moves processively along microtubules. A conserved coiled-coil domain within the stalk region of Kid is sufficient for homodimer formation and is required for the processivity of Kid. Furthermore, the neck linker and coiled-coil domains of Kid could add processive activity to the motor domain of KIF1A, suggesting that Kid contains a functional neck linker and dimerization capability, a prerequisite for the processivity of kinesin motor domains. The full-length Kid, containing a helix-hairpin-helix domain, can transport double-stranded DNA along microtubules in vitro. AlphaFold3 prediction suggests that the dimerization of Kid stabilizes the association with DNA. These findings collectively suggest the reclassification of Kid as a processive and dimeric motor that transports DNA along microtubules.
papers.abstract_zh: 在有丝分裂的前中期，染色体被推向纺锤体赤道。染色体驱动蛋白Kid，也称为KIF22，在前中期沿纺锤体微管移动染色体。Kid长期以来被认为是一种单体且非持续性的马达蛋白，不同于典型的驱动蛋白。在本研究中，我们证明全长Kid形成同源二聚体，并沿微管进行持续性移动。Kid茎部区域内的一个保守卷曲螺旋结构域足以形成同源二聚体，并且是Kid持续移动所必需的。此外，Kid的颈部连接器和卷曲螺旋结构域可以为KIF1A的马达结构域增加持续性活性，表明Kid包含功能性颈部连接器和二聚化能力，这是驱动蛋白马达结构域持续移动的先决条件。含有螺旋-发夹-螺旋结构域的全长Kid，可以在体外沿微管运输双链DNA。AlphaFold3预测表明，Kid的二聚化稳定了与DNA的结合。这些发现共同表明，Kid应被重新分类为一种持续性和二聚体的马达蛋白，沿微管运输DNA。

papers.title: Active-site arginines differentially control Cas12a DNA cleavage and specificity.
papers.authors: Rostami, Saadi; Dos Santos, Alberto M; Van, Richard S; Long, Kole; Shao, Yihan; Rajan, Rakhi
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过生化实验与分子动力学模拟研究Cas12a活性位点精氨酸残基对DNA切割特异性的调控，属于蛋白质-DNA互作机制研究，但对象为CRISPR核酸酶而非典型TF-DNA体系，方法上MD模拟可借鉴。
papers.abstract: Cas12a is a CRISPR-Cas nuclease with biochemical features that make it useful for genome editing and nucleic acid diagnostics. However, its off-target and non-specific trans and CRISPR RNA-independent DNA cleavages can reduce the accuracy and limit applications requiring high fidelity. Here, we analyzed the role of two conserved arginine residues, R918 and R921, found in the RuvC active site pocket of Francisella novicida Cas12a. Through amino acid substitutions, biochemical assays, kinetic analysis, and computational study, we establish that a positive charge at 921 is required for CRISPR RNA-dependent DNA cleavage (cis cleavage), whereas R918 primarily enhances cleavage efficiency. Replacing R918 with lysine or alanine eliminates trans activity while retaining cis cleavage, whereas replacing R921 with lysine eliminates trans activity and replacing with alanine abolishes cis and trans cleavages. Furthermore, these changes significantly decrease RNA-independent cleavage and improve mismatch discrimination during cis cleavage, especially at PAM-distal sites. Structural analysis shows that R918 assists in the conversion of the lid covering the RuvC active site to an alpha helical form, while R921 stabilizes the DNA in the active site. Molecular dynamics simulations reveal that while R921 is critical in supporting the positioning of scissile phosphate, R918 is essential in maintaining catalytic-site organization through lid's conformational change as well as in positioning DNA through its role in stabilizing the active site framework. Together, our results highlight the importance of R918 and R921 in Cas12a's activity and the potential of modifying active pocket residues to reduce unwanted DNA cleavage while increasing on-target specificity.
papers.abstract_zh: Cas12a是一种CRISPR-Cas核酸酶，其生化特性使其在基因组编辑和核酸诊断中具有应用价值。然而，其脱靶效应以及非特异性的反式切割和CRISPR RNA非依赖性DNA切割可能降低准确性，并限制需要高保真度的应用。在此，我们分析了在Francisella novicida Cas12a的RuvC活性位点口袋中发现的两个保守精氨酸残基R918和R921的作用。通过氨基酸替换、生化实验、动力学分析和计算研究，我们确定921位点的正电荷是CRISPR RNA依赖性DNA切割（顺式切割）所必需的，而R918主要增强切割效率。将R918替换为赖氨酸或丙氨酸会消除反式活性，同时保留顺式切割，而将R921替换为赖氨酸会消除反式活性，替换为丙氨酸则会废除顺式和反式切割。此外，这些变化显著降低了RNA非依赖性切割，并改善了顺式切割过程中的错配识别，尤其是在PAM远端位点。结构分析表明，R918有助于将覆盖RuvC活性位点的盖子转化为α螺旋形式，而R921则稳定活性位点中的DNA。分子动力学模拟揭示，R921在支持可切割磷酸基团定位方面至关重要，而R918通过盖子的构象变化维持催化位点组织，并通过稳定活性位点框架来定位DNA。综合来看，我们的结果强调了R918和R921在Cas12a活性中的重要性，以及修饰活性口袋残基以减少非预期DNA切割并提高靶向特异性的潜力。

papers.title: Discovering potential key biomarkers and molecular mechanisms in Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease and rheumatoid arthritis using integrated bioinformatics and machine learning approaches.
papers.authors: Tasnim, Wahia; Mondal, M Rubaiyat Hossain
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用生物信息学与机器学习筛选COPD和RA共享生物标志物，虽涉及转录因子ETS1/YY1等，但核心是疾病标志物而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法无三维结构或结合机制研究，仅边缘相关。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) and Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) are among the leading causes of illness and mortality globally. Many studies claim that these diseases are interconnected. However, the underlying molecular processes and shared biomarkers between RA and COPD are still undiscovered. METHODS: This research is aimed at discovering the key potential biomarkers and mechanisms in RA and COPD, incorporating several Bioinformatics and Machine Learning (ML) approaches via R programming. Several validation methods are also applied to validate the key potential biomarkers. RESULTS: By performing the differential expression analysis, we have discovered 90 common Differentially Expressed Genes (DEGs) between RA and COPD. From the Gene Set Enrichment analysis, we get the top molecular mechanisms related to the common DEGs. From the Protein Protein Interaction analysis, we get the candidate hub genes among the common DEGs. Among all the ML approaches, ElasticNet outperforms with the highest accuracy of 91.52% with a set of important genes. By intersecting the candidate hub genes and the ElasticNet important genes, we get four candidate genes, ETS1, YY1, CREBP5, and GTF2H1. Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve and Expression analysis show robust discriminatory efficacy for all four genes, while nomogram modeling further validates their predictive correlations with RA and COPD. Finally, the candidate transcription factors, microRNAs and drugs related to the potential biomarkers are also suggested. CONCLUSION: In conclusion, this research identifies the key potential molecular mechanisms and four potential biomarkers between RA and COPD. These findings could potentially improve our understanding of the molecular mechanisms behind COPD and RA by providing a preliminary basis for future experimental and clinical studies.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）和类风湿关节炎（RA）是全球发病和死亡的主要原因之一。许多研究声称这些疾病相互关联。然而，RA与COPD之间的潜在分子过程和共享生物标志物仍未揭示。方法：本研究旨在通过R编程结合多种生物信息学和机器学习（ML）方法，发现RA和COPD中的关键潜在生物标志物及机制。同时应用多种验证方法来验证关键潜在生物标志物。结果：通过差异表达分析，我们发现了RA和COPD之间90个常见的差异表达基因（DEGs）。通过基因集富集分析，我们获得了与常见DEGs相关的顶级分子机制。通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用分析，我们在常见DEGs中获得了候选枢纽基因。在所有ML方法中，ElasticNet表现最佳，准确率最高达91.52%，并识别出一组重要基因。通过将候选枢纽基因与ElasticNet重要基因取交集，我们获得了四个候选基因：ETS1、YY1、CREBP5和GTF2H1。受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线和表达分析显示这四个基因均具有稳健的判别效能，而列线图建模进一步验证了它们与RA和COPD的预测相关性。最后，还提出了与潜在生物标志物相关的候选转录因子、microRNA和药物。结论：总之，本研究识别了RA和COPD之间的关键潜在分子机制及四个潜在生物标志物。这些发现可能通过为未来实验和临床研究提供初步基础，增进我们对COPD和RA背后分子机制的理解。

papers.title: Explainable machine learning and multimodal single cell analysis link NR4A2 to CD8(+) T-cell terminal exhaustion and a CD8-adjusted prognostic signature in hepatocellular carcinoma.
papers.authors: Faisal, Shah; Sammad, Abdul; Ejaz, Muhammad Adeel; Wang, Zhen-Bo
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文利用多模态单细胞与可解释机器学习分析NR4A2与CD8+T细胞终末耗竭的关联，虽涉及转录因子但未聚焦TF-DNA结合机制，且方法以表达分析为主，缺乏AI/物理模拟的互作建模。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Terminal exhaustion of CD8(+) tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes constrains the benefit of immune-checkpoint blockade in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The orphan nuclear receptor NR4A2 (Nurr1) belongs to a transcription-factor family implicated in murine T-cell exhaustion, yet its behaviour in the human HCC microenvironment has not been characterised across data modalities. We asked whether NR4A2 is specifically coupled to the terminal-exhaustion programme of human HCC CD8(+) T cells, and whether that coupling is reflected in chromatin, tissue topography and bulk-tumour outcome data. METHODS: We reanalysed publicly available human HCC datasets spanning four modalities: single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq; GSE149614, GSE98638, GSE151530, GSE125449), single-cell ATAC sequencing (scATAC-seq; GSE227265), imaging-based spatial transcriptomics (10x Xenium human liver-cancer section) and bulk RNA sequencing with overall-survival annotation (TCGA-LIHC). NR4A2 was profiled across cell compartments and, at higher resolution, across CD8(+) T-cell states defined from curated exhaustion, progenitor, effector and naive gene modules. We tested NR4A2-exhaustion coupling at single-cell and pseudobulk level, examined NR4A2 motif accessibility, traced NR4A2 along a diffusion-pseudotime exhaustion axis, evaluated spatial co-localisation of exhausted CD8(+) T cells with tumour-associated macrophages (TAMs), benchmarked machine-learning classifiers of the exhausted state, and compared the human NR4A2 co-expression direction with the published NR4A1/2-knockout phenotype. We additionally trained interpretable gradient-boosted-tree models with SHAP attribution to characterise the exhausted and NR4A2-high states, scored a NR4A2 co-expression regulon, related the programme to immunotherapy-relevant signatures, and modelled overall survival using a CD8-infiltration-adjusted exhaustion score. RESULTS: NR4A2 was broadly expressed across HCC compartments and was highest in myeloid cells rather than being T-cell restricted; at whole-compartment and bulk-tumour resolution it was not a clean exhaustion marker. At the resolution of CD8(+) T-cell states, however, NR4A2 was sharply enriched in terminally exhausted cells (mean 3.62 versus 1.05; Mann-Whitney p  approximately  3.4 x 10(-83)) and correlated with the exhaustion module (single-cell Spearman rho = 0.45) but not with the effector module (rho = 0.06), arguing that NR4A2 is not a generic activation gene. NR4A2 expression increased monotonically along a diffusion-pseudotime axis toward terminal exhaustion (rho = 0.37). In Xenium tissue, exhausted CD8(+) T cells were modestly but significantly enriched in the neighbourhood of TAMs relative to other CD8(+) T cells (permutation p = 0.005). The human NR4A2 co-expression direction was 83% concordant with the published NR4A1/2-knockout differential-expression direction. In bulk TCGA-LIHC, NR4A2 was lower in tumour than adjacent liver and only weakly exhaustion-correlated, consistent with hepatocyte-dominated bulk signal and reinforcing the need for compartment-resolved analysis. Interpretable machine learning attributed NR4A2-high status to an immediate-early/AP-1 activation programme, a NR4A2 co-expression regulon was selectively active in exhausted cells, and the programme tracked the T-cell-inflamed phenotype (rho = 0.87); although raw bulk NR4A2 was non-prognostic, a CD8-infiltration-adjusted exhaustion score independently predicted shorter overall survival (hazard ratio 1.42 per standard deviation, p < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: A NR4A2 co-expression regulon was most active in exhausted cells; explainable modelling linked NR4A2-high status to an immediate-early/AP-1 activation programme; the programme marked immune-hot tumours; and although bulk NR4A2 was non-prognostic, a CD8-infiltration-adjusted exhaustion score was independently associated with worse overall survival (HR 1.42 per SD, p < 0.001). Across four independent data modalities, NR4A2 behaves as a resolution-dependent marker of the terminal-exhaustion programme in HCC CD8(+) T cells that is spatially associated with the myeloid niche. The convergence supports NR4A2 as a candidate component of an HCC exhaustion signature and a hypothesis-generating target for functional study, while underscoring that its association is masked in bulk and whole-compartment data.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：CD8(+)肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞的终末耗竭限制了肝细胞癌（HCC）中免疫检查点阻断的获益。孤儿核受体NR4A2（Nurr1）属于一个与小鼠T细胞耗竭相关的转录因子家族，但其在人类HCC微环境中的行为尚未跨数据模态得到表征。我们探究了NR4A2是否特异性地与人类HCC CD8(+) T细胞的终末耗竭程序偶联，以及这种偶联是否反映在染色质、组织拓扑结构和 bulk 肿瘤结局数据中。方法：我们重新分析了公开可用的人类HCC数据集，涵盖四种模态：单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq；GSE149614、GSE98638、GSE151530、GSE125449）、单细胞ATAC测序（scATAC-seq；GSE227265）、基于成像的空间转录组学（10x Xenium 人类肝癌切片）以及带有总生存期注释的 bulk RNA测序（TCGA-LIHC）。我们在细胞区室层面，并在更高分辨率下，对由精选的耗竭、祖细胞、效应和初始基因模块定义的CD8(+) T细胞状态中，对NR4A2进行了分析。我们在单细胞和伪bulk水平测试了NR4A2-耗竭偶联，检查了NR4A2基序可及性，沿扩散伪时间耗竭轴追踪了NR4A2，评估了耗竭CD8(+) T细胞与肿瘤相关巨噬细胞（TAMs）的空间共定位，对耗竭状态的机器学习分类器进行了基准测试，并将人类NR4A2共表达方向与已发表的NR4A1/2敲除表型进行了比较。我们还训练了具有SHAP归因的可解释梯度提升树模型，以表征耗竭和NR4A2高表达状态，评分了NR4A2共表达调节子，将该程序与免疫治疗相关特征联系起来，并使用CD8浸润调整的耗竭评分对总生存期进行了建模。结果：NR4A2在HCC各区室中广泛表达，在髓系细胞中最高，而非局限于T细胞；在整体区室和bulk肿瘤分辨率下，它并非一个干净的耗竭标志物。然而，在CD8(+) T细胞状态的分辨率下，NR4A2在终末耗竭细胞中显著富集（均值3.62对1.05；Mann-Whitney p 约 3.4 x 10(-83)），并与耗竭模块相关（单细胞Spearman rho = 0.45），但与效应模块不相关（rho = 0.06），这表明NR4A2并非一个通用的激活基因。NR4A2表达沿扩散伪时间轴朝向终末耗竭单调增加（rho = 0.37）。在Xenium组织中，相对于其他CD8(+) T细胞，耗竭CD8(+) T细胞在TAMs邻近区域适度但显著富集（置换检验p = 0.005）。人类NR4A2共表达方向与已发表的NR4A1/2敲除差异表达方向有83%的一致性。在bulk TCGA-LIHC中，NR4A2在肿瘤中的表达低于邻近肝脏，且仅与耗竭弱相关，这与肝细胞主导的bulk信号一致，并强调了区室解析分析的必要性。可解释机器学习将NR4A2高表达状态归因于即时早期/AP-1激活程序，NR4A2共表达调节子在耗竭细胞中选择性活跃，且该程序追踪T细胞炎症表型（rho = 0.87）；尽管原始bulk NR4A2无预后价值，但CD8浸润调整的耗竭评分独立预测了较短的总生存期（风险比每标准差1.42，p < 0.001）。结论：NR4A2共表达调节子在耗竭细胞中活性最高；可解释建模将NR4A2高表达状态与即时早期/AP-1激活程序联系起来；该程序标记了免疫热肿瘤；尽管bulk NR4A2无预后价值，但CD8浸润调整的耗竭评分与较差的总生存期独立相关（HR每SD 1.42，p < 0.001）。在四个独立数据模态中，NR4A2表现为HCC CD8(+) T细胞终末耗竭程序的解析度依赖性标志物，并与髓系生态位空间相关。这种收敛性支持NR4A2作为HCC耗竭特征的一个候选组分和功能研究的假设生成靶点，同时强调其关联在bulk和整体区室数据中被掩盖。

papers.title: Integrative AOP-Based Mechanistic Profiling of Organic UV Filters Reveals Shared Endocrine-Metabolic and Stress-Response Pathways.
papers.authors: Accardi, Cristina; Al-Abdulraheem, Zeyad; Schaffert, Alexandra; Federico, Antonio; Del Giudice, Giusy; Serra, Angela; Greco, Dario
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文基于AOP框架整合转录因子下游靶基因与分子对接预测蛋白靶点，剖析有机UV滤光剂的毒理机制，虽涉及TF-DNA调控网络和分子对接，但核心是毒理学通路分析而非TF-DNA结合互作机制建模，方法可迁移性有限。
papers.abstract: Organic UV filters are widely used in personal care products and are increasingly detected in humans and the environment. Although several compounds exhibit systemic absorption and biological activity, their mechanisms of action remain poorly understood because comprehensive toxicogenomic data remain limited. Here, we developed an integrative Adverse Outcome Pathway (AOP)-based framework to support the mechanistic profiling of organic UV filters with sparse experimental evidence. Molecular evidence was integrated from experimentally supported bioassay target genes, transcription factor downstream target genes derived from a curated regulatory network, and predicted protein targets obtained through molecular docking using GalaxySagittarius-AF. Docking-derived targets were prioritized using prediction scores and refined according to protein-protein interaction network proximity to bioassay-confirmed targets. Chemical-specific gene sets were tested for enrichment against curated human Key Event gene sets and mapped onto the AOP network. ADMET descriptors and GTEx tissue-expression data were incorporated to assess skin absorption relevance and tissue-specific biological plausibility. Ten organic UV filters met the skin absorption criteria and underwent mechanistic analysis. Integrated evidence revealed recurring molecular signatures involving nuclear receptor signalling, lipid metabolism, oxidative stress, inflammation, and DNA damage responses. AOP mapping highlighted convergence on endocrine-metabolic key events, including androgen and estrogen receptor signalling, PPAR-mediated lipid regulation, and hepatobiliary nuclear receptor pathways. Additional subnetworks linked oxidative and inflammatory processes with AOP regions associated with liver, breast, and neurotoxicity, representing mechanistic enrichment rather than evidence of causality. This framework enables mechanistic profiling despite limited toxicogenomic data, identifies biologically plausible pathways and shared molecular domains across structurally diverse UV filters, and provides a foundation for hypothesis generation and prioritization of future experimental studies.
papers.abstract_zh: 有机紫外线吸收剂广泛用于个人护理产品中，并越来越多地在人类和环境中被检测到。尽管若干化合物表现出全身吸收和生物活性，但由于全面的毒理基因组学数据仍然有限，其作用机制仍知之甚少。在此，我们开发了一个基于整合性不良结局通路（Adverse Outcome Pathway, AOP）的框架，以支持对实验证据稀疏的有机紫外线吸收剂进行机制剖析。分子证据整合自实验支持的生物测定靶基因、源自精选调控网络的转录因子下游靶基因，以及通过使用GalaxySagittarius-AF进行分子对接获得的预测蛋白质靶标。对接衍生的靶标根据预测分数进行优先级排序，并根据与生物测定确认靶标的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络邻近性进行细化。化学特异性基因集针对精选的人类关键事件基因集进行富集测试，并映射到AOP网络上。ADMET描述符和GTEx组织表达数据被纳入，以评估皮肤吸收相关性和组织特异性生物学合理性。十种有机紫外线吸收剂满足皮肤吸收标准并进行了机制分析。整合证据揭示了涉及核受体信号传导、脂质代谢、氧化应激、炎症和DNA损伤反应的重复分子特征。AOP映射突出了内分泌-代谢关键事件的汇聚，包括雄激素和雌激素受体信号传导、PPAR介导的脂质调节以及肝胆核受体通路。额外的子网络将氧化和炎症过程与与肝脏、乳腺和神经毒性相关的AOP区域联系起来，这代表了机制富集而非因果证据。该框架能够在毒理基因组学数据有限的情况下实现机制剖析，识别跨结构多样的紫外线吸收剂的生物学合理通路和共享分子域，并为假设生成和未来实验研究的优先级排序提供基础。

papers.title: Deep Learning Based on Magnetic Resonance Imaging for Preoperative Prediction of Pituitary Neuroendocrine Tumors Subtypes.
papers.authors: Yang, Zhen; Xiong, Yang; Yu, Xiaohui; Ding, Guangkai; Li, Yanghui
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文利用MRI影像和深度学习预测垂体神经内分泌肿瘤亚型，仅以转录因子表达作为分类标签，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点或分子机制建模，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: RATIONALE AND OBJECTIVES: Molecular subtyping of pituitary neuroendocrine tumors (PitNETs [pituitary adenoma]) guides treatment but requires postoperative pathology. This study aimed to develop a deep learning model for preoperative noninvasive prediction of PitNET subtypes using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). MATERIALS AND METHODS: This study retrospectively enrolled patients with pathologically confirmed PitNETs from two centers. Patients were classified into four groups based on the expression of the SF1, PIT1, and TPIT transcription factors as follows: PIT1 lineage, TPIT lineage, SF1 lineage, and no distinct cell lineage. All patients underwent preoperative MRI examinations comprising coronal T1-weighted (T1WI), T2-weighted (T2W1), and contrast-enhanced T1WI sequences, as well as sagittal T1WI and contrast-enhanced T1WI sequences. The YOLOv11 model was trained using either single or combined sequences to achieve subtype classification. Performance was evaluated via internal, temporal external, and multicenter validation using mean average precision (mAP), precision, recall, and F1-score. RESULTS: This retrospective study included a total of 888 patients enrolled between January 2021 and December 2025, with a mean age of 54.32 years; 52.9% of the patients were female. The model performed robustly in the internal validation set, temporal external test set, and multicenter validation cohort, effectively distinguishing among the four molecular subtypes. Among these, sagittal contrast-enhanced T1WI sequences yielded the best predictive results (mAP50-95: 0.901), while coronal T2WI sequences performed relatively poorly (mAP50-95: 0.756). CONCLUSION: MRI-based deep learning enables accurate preoperative PitNET subtyping in retrospective cohorts, warranting investigation as a tool to aid personalized management following prospective validation.
papers.abstract_zh: RATIONALE AND OBJECTIVES：垂体神经内分泌肿瘤（PitNETs [垂体腺瘤]）的分子分型指导治疗，但需依赖术后病理。本研究旨在利用磁共振成像（MRI）开发一种深度学习模型，用于术前无创预测PitNET亚型。MATERIALS AND METHODS：本研究回顾性纳入来自两个中心的经病理确诊的PitNET患者。根据SF1、PIT1和TPIT转录因子的表达情况，将患者分为四组：PIT1谱系、TPIT谱系、SF1谱系和无明确细胞谱系。所有患者均接受术前MRI检查，包括冠状位T1加权（T1WI）、T2加权（T2WI）和增强T1WI序列，以及矢状位T1WI和增强T1WI序列。使用单一或联合序列训练YOLOv11模型以实现亚型分类。通过内部验证、时间外部验证和多中心验证，使用平均精度均值（mAP）、精确率、召回率和F1分数评估性能。RESULTS：本回顾性研究共纳入2021年1月至2025年12月期间入组的888例患者，平均年龄为54.32岁；其中52.9%为女性。该模型在内部验证集、时间外部测试集和多中心验证队列中均表现稳健，有效区分了四种分子亚型。其中，矢状位增强T1WI序列取得了最佳预测结果（mAP50-95：0.901），而冠状位T2WI序列表现相对较差（mAP50-95：0.756）。CONCLUSION：基于MRI的深度学习能够在回顾性队列中实现准确的术前PitNET分型，在前瞻性验证后，值得进一步研究作为辅助个性化管理的工具。

papers.title: Transcriptomic integration reveals immune heterogeneity in vascular dementia and identifies ELF2 as a candidate therapeutic target.
papers.authors: Liang, Li; Shen, Cuiqin; Huang, Shiren; Hu, Minglu; Zhu, Jian
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究整合转录组与单细胞数据分析血管性痴呆的免疫异质性，仅用分子对接初步评估ELF2与药物结合，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作体系与AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
papers.abstract: Vascular dementia (VaD) is the second most prevalent form of dementia after Alzheimer's disease and is primarily driven by chronic cerebral hypoperfusion and neurovascular dysfunction. Growing evidence indicates that immune dysregulation and neuroglial-vascular injury play critical roles in disease progression; however, the molecular regulators underlying these processes remain insufficiently characterized. This study aimed to delineate immune heterogeneity and neuroglial-vascular alterations in VaD and to identify key regulatory targets involved in disease pathogenesis. Bulk RNA sequencing data (GSE122063) and single-cell transcriptomic data (GSE282111) were retrieved from the Gene Expression Omnibus database and integratively analyzed to characterize immune infiltration patterns and cellular dysregulation. Immune profiling was performed using CIBERSORT and single-sample gene set enrichment analysis. Disease-associated cell subsets and hub genes were identified using Seurat, Scissor, and high-dimensional weighted gene co-expression network analysis (hdWGCNA). Pseudotime trajectory analysis and molecular docking were subsequently applied to investigate gene expression dynamics and potential therapeutic relevance.
