Using ENCODE registry of candidate cis-regulatory elements (cCREs), we curated a benchmark dataset, consisting of 21,926 enhancers of 201 bp length and 46,159 enhancers of 350 bp length, as positive instances. The best fine-tuned model achieved 88.05% accuracy and a Matthews correlation coefficient of 76% on an independent dataset. Genome-wide application identified 1,684,595 enhancer regions covering 26.65% of the human genome. By performing integrative analyses with DNABERT-based transcription factor models, we identify 2,681 statistically significant loss-of-function and 1,917 gain-of-function enhancer variants, which respectively alter the function of 1,623 and 1,247 ENCODE-cCRE enhancers. Similarly, we identify 4,057 candidate de novo enhancers, created by 5,464 gain-of-function variants. These genome-wide enhancer annotations and candidate genetic variants predicted by DNABERT-Enhancer provide valuable resources for genome interpretation in functional and clinical genomics studies. AVAILABILITY: DNABERT-Enhancer is freely available at https://github.com/DavuluriLab/DNABERT-Enhancer; Trained model predictions can be explored interactively via the web application at https://dnabert-enhancer-datarepo.streamlit.app/. The fine-tuned models are archived and citable through Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19157566). SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.
papers.abstract_zh: 动机：由于增强子（enhancer）复杂的序列特征以及缺乏一致的遗传或表观遗传标记将其与其他基因组区域区分开来，预测和解读增强子的调控逻辑仍然是一个重大挑战。现有的机器学习方法能够捕获核苷酸组成，但通常无法有效建模序列上下文。结果：我们提出了DNABERT-Enhancer，一种新颖的增强子预测方法，通过将DNABERT预训练语言模型应用于人类基因组。利用ENCODE候选顺式调控元件（cCRE）注册表，我们整理了一个基准数据集，包含21,926个长度为201 bp的增强子和46,159个长度为350 bp的增强子作为正例。最佳微调模型在独立数据集上达到了88.05%的准确率和76%的马修斯相关系数（Matthews correlation coefficient）。全基因组应用识别了1,684,595个增强子区域，覆盖人类基因组的26.65%。通过与基于DNABERT的转录因子模型进行整合分析，我们识别了2,681个统计显著的功能丧失型（loss-of-function）和1,917个功能获得型（gain-of-function）增强子变异，这些变异分别改变了1,623个和1,247个ENCODE-cCRE增强子的功能。类似地，我们识别了4,057个候选从头增强子（de novo enhancer），由5,464个功能获得型变异产生。这些由DNABERT-Enhancer预测的全基因组增强子注释和候选遗传变异为功能和临床基因组学研究中的基因组解读提供了宝贵资源。可用性：DNABERT-Enhancer可在https://github.com/DavuluriLab/DNABERT-Enhancer免费获取；训练模型预测可通过网络应用程序https://dnabert-enhancer-datarepo.streamlit.app/交互式探索。微调模型已存档并通过Zenodo（https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19157566）可引用。补充信息：补充数据可在Bioinformatics在线获取。

papers.title: Single-cell and machine learning identify a trihydroxybutyrylation-related prognostic signature in esophageal cancer.
papers.authors: Zhang, Qun; Li, Duojie; Yin, Hongmei; Zhu, Chaomang; Huang, Jie; Zhou, Shixiang
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究利用单细胞转录组和机器学习构建食管癌预后模型，虽涉及转录因子SOX11，但核心是预后标志物而非TF-DNA互作机制，且无AI/物理模拟方法用于蛋白-DNA结合建模。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) is a highly aggressive malignancy with a poor prognosis. This study identifies malignant epithelial subtypes and establishes prognostic biomarkers through single-cell transcriptomics and integrative machine learning approaches. METHODS: We re-analyzed the single-cell RNA sequencing data (GSE188900) and identified malignant epithelial cells using inferCNV. Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) among malignant epithelial subtypes were identified and intersected with lysine beta-hydroxybutyrylation (Kbhb)-related genes. Candidate genes were screened using Cox, least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO), and extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) to construct a random survival forest (RSF) prognostic model. Model performance was validated in GSE53625, TCGA-ESCC, and GSE53624 cohorts. Finally, the expression of prognostic genes was detected by quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR). RESULTS: Single-cell RNA sequencing identified three distinct malignant epithelial cells in ESCC. Among them, the Malignant2 subtype exhibited stemness-related characteristics, initiated tumor differentiation, and was potentially regulated by the transcription factor (TF) SOX11. There were 659 genes identified by intersecting Malignant2-related DEGs with Kbhb-related genes. Based on these genes, a seven-gene prognostic model was constructed, and a corresponding risk score was calculated. Correlation analysis showed that the risk score was positively associated with tumor stage. qPCR results confirmed that the expression patterns of the prognostic genes were consistent with the computational analysis. The enrichment of Kbhb-related genes in the Malignant2 subtype suggests a potential link between metabolic reprogramming and epigenetic regulation in ESCC progression. CONCLUSIONS: We identified distinct malignant epithelial subtypes in ESCC and developed a seven-gene prognostic signature based on Kbhb-related genes. This model demonstrated robust predictive performance and was significantly associated with tumor stages.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：食管鳞状细胞癌（ESCC）是一种高度侵袭性的恶性肿瘤，预后不良。本研究通过单细胞转录组学和整合机器学习方法，识别恶性上皮细胞亚型并建立预后生物标志物。方法：我们重新分析了单细胞RNA测序数据（GSE188900），并使用inferCNV识别恶性上皮细胞。在恶性上皮细胞亚型中鉴定差异表达基因（DEGs），并与赖氨酸β-羟基丁酰化（Kbhb）相关基因取交集。通过Cox、最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）以及极端梯度提升（XGBoost）筛选候选基因，构建随机生存森林（RSF）预后模型。在GSE53625、TCGA-ESCC和GSE53624队列中验证模型性能。最后，通过定量聚合酶链反应（qPCR）检测预后基因的表达。结果：单细胞RNA测序在ESCC中识别出三种不同的恶性上皮细胞。其中，Malignant2亚型表现出干性相关特征，启动肿瘤分化，并可能受转录因子（TF）SOX11调控。通过将Malignant2相关DEGs与Kbhb相关基因取交集，鉴定出659个基因。基于这些基因，构建了一个七基因预后模型，并计算相应的风险评分。相关性分析显示，风险评分与肿瘤分期呈正相关。qPCR结果证实，预后基因的表达模式与计算分析一致。Kbhb相关基因在Malignant2亚型中的富集提示，代谢重编程与表观遗传调控在ESCC进展中可能存在潜在联系。结论：我们在ESCC中识别出不同的恶性上皮细胞亚型，并基于Kbhb相关基因开发了一个七基因预后特征。该模型表现出稳健的预测性能，并与肿瘤分期显著相关。

papers.title: Exploring the Mechanism of Action of Danggui Buxue Decoction in Treating Chronic Glomerulonephritis Based on UPLC-MS/MS and Network Pharmacology.
papers.authors: Liu, Qiao; Wang, Yinghang; Wang, Xinyue; Yang, Hongmei; Pan, Zhi; Guo, Di
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究当归补血汤治疗慢性肾小球肾炎的机制，涉及分子对接但核心是网络药理学和湿实验验证，不聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: According to Chinese medicine theory, chronic glomerulonephritis (CGN) is characterized by dampness-heat and blood stasis. Danggui Buxue Decoction (DBD) has shown good efficacy in the treatment of diseases associated with qi deficiency and blood stasis (such as CGN). However, the molecular mechanisms behind its therapeutic effects are unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aims to elucidate the role and mechanism of action of DBD in the treatment of CGN. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The chemical composition of DBD was identified using UPLC-MS/MS, and network pharmacology, bioinformatics, and molecular-docking techniques were employed to predict the core targets and key signaling pathways of DBD in the treatment of CGN. At the same time, we established an LPS-induced rat glomerular mesangial (HBZY-1) cell model and a CGN rat model for in vitro and in vivo validation. We used MTT and Transwell assays to assess the viability, migration, and invasion capabilities of HBZY-1 cells, and also measured inflammatory cytokine levels via ELISA. A preliminary evaluation of the regulatory effects of DBD on key proteins in the TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway in HBZY-1 cells using immunofluorescence. Biochemical analyses of urine and serum were performed to measure 24-h urinary protein, Serum Creatinine (SCr), Blood Urea Nitrogen (BUN), and levels of inflammatory factors in rats. Pathological changes in kidney tissue were examined using HE, Masson, and PAS staining. The extent of apoptosis in kidney tissue cells was assessed using TUNEL and JC-1 staining assays. Immunohistochemistry, immunofluorescence, RT-qPCR, and Western blotting were used to detect the expression of relevant mRNAs and proteins in kidney tissue. RESULTS: The UPLC-MS/MS method was used to identify 104 chemical components and 499 potential targets of action in DBD. The 166 potential target genes in DBD are associated with the therapeutic mechanism of CGN. Results from network pharmacology and bioinformatics suggest that the NF-kappaB signaling pathway may be a potential mechanism underlying the treatment of CGN with DBD. In vitro experiments demonstrated that DBD suppressed the survival rate of HBZY-1 cells, upregulated the secretion of Interleukin- 4 (IL-4) and Interleukin- 10 (IL-10), and downregulated the expression of Toll-Like Receptor 4 (TLR4) and Nuclear Factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB) proteins. In vivo, DBD downregulated 24-h urinary protein, SCr, BUN, Tumor Necrosis Factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), and Interleukin- 6 (IL-6) levels in CGN rats, while upregulating IL-4 and IL-10 levels. At the same time, DBD exerts its therapeutic effect on CGN by inducing apoptosis through a reduction in mitochondrial membrane potential and by alleviating the inflammatory response via inhibition of the TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway. CONCLUSIONS: In summary, DBD may exert a therapeutic effect on CGN by regulating the TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway, thereby suppressing the inflammatory response and modulating apoptosis.
papers.abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：根据中医理论，慢性肾小球肾炎（CGN）以湿热和血瘀为特征。当归补血汤（DBD）在治疗与气虚血瘀相关的疾病（如CGN）中显示出良好疗效。然而，其治疗作用的分子机制尚不清楚。研究目的：本研究旨在阐明DBD在治疗CGN中的作用及作用机制。材料与方法：采用UPLC-MS/MS鉴定DBD的化学成分，并运用网络药理学、生物信息学和分子对接技术预测DBD治疗CGN的核心靶点和关键信号通路。同时，我们建立了LPS诱导的大鼠肾小球系膜（HBZY-1）细胞模型和CGN大鼠模型，用于体外和体内验证。我们使用MTT和Transwell实验评估HBZY-1细胞的活力、迁移和侵袭能力，并通过ELISA测量炎症细胞因子水平。采用免疫荧光初步评估DBD对HBZY-1细胞中TLR4/NF-kappaB信号通路关键蛋白的调节作用。对尿液和血清进行生化分析，测量24小时尿蛋白、血清肌酐（SCr）、血尿素氮（BUN）及大鼠炎症因子水平。使用HE、Masson和PAS染色检查肾组织的病理变化。通过TUNEL和JC-1染色实验评估肾组织细胞的凋亡程度。采用免疫组化、免疫荧光、RT-qPCR和Western blotting检测肾组织中相关mRNA和蛋白的表达。结果：UPLC-MS/MS方法鉴定出DBD中104种化学成分和499个潜在作用靶点。DBD中的166个潜在靶基因与CGN的治疗机制相关。网络药理学和生物信息学结果表明，NF-kappaB信号通路可能是DBD治疗CGN的潜在机制。体外实验表明，DBD抑制HBZY-1细胞的存活率，上调白细胞介素-4（IL-4）和白细胞介素-10（IL-10）的分泌，并下调Toll样受体4（TLR4）和核因子kappa-B（NF-kappaB）蛋白的表达。在体内，DBD下调CGN大鼠的24小时尿蛋白、SCr、BUN、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）和白细胞介素-6（IL-6）水平，同时上调IL-4和IL-10水平。同时，DBD通过降低线粒体膜电位诱导凋亡，并通过抑制TLR4/NF-kappaB通路减轻炎症反应，从而发挥其对CGN的治疗作用。结论：总之，DBD可能通过调节TLR4/NF-kappaB信号通路，抑制炎症反应并调节凋亡，从而对CGN发挥治疗作用。

papers.title: Stage-specific evolutionary dynamics in pediatric leukemia inferred using Bayesian stochastic modeling.
papers.authors: Kim, Seung-Hwan
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文使用贝叶斯随机模型研究儿童白血病的肿瘤进化动态，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: Tumor evolution in pediatric leukemia is shaped by stochastic fluctuations and constraints imposed by developmental programs and therapeutic pressure. However, quantitative characterization of these dynamics remains challenging because of sparse longitudinal sampling and measurement noise in clinical data. In this study, we applied Bayesian calibration of stochastic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) models to characterize patient-specific tumor evolution trajectories in pediatric leukemia. Using a longitudinal cohort of KMT2A-rearranged leukemias (52 patients, 311 longitudinal observations corresponding to 294 unique patient-time points), we estimated parameters governing mean reversion and stochastic variability and assessed the stability and uncertainty of these estimates through simulation-based validation under empirically derived sampling conditions. A representative single-patient trajectory further illustrated patient-level evolutionary dynamics. Across the cohort, inferred OU parameters showed stage-associated tendencies, including higher average diffusion in refractory and very-early disease groups, although posterior intervals overlapped substantially and did not support sharply separated dynamical regimes. Simulation analyses indicated that Bayesian calibration provided stable posterior computation and interpretable uncertainty quantification under sparse sampling, although recovery remained parameter- and schedule-dependent and predictive performance was limited. These findings show that Bayesian-calibrated stochastic models provide a useful framework for interpreting longitudinal tumor evolution in pediatric leukemia. While not intended for clinical prediction, this approach offers a quantitative perspective on stage-dependent disease dynamics and highlights the importance of uncertainty-aware modeling in sparse clinical datasets.
papers.abstract_zh: 儿童白血病中的肿瘤进化受随机波动以及发育程序和治疗压力所施加的约束共同塑造。然而，由于临床数据中纵向采样稀疏且存在测量噪声，对这些动态的定量表征仍具挑战性。在本研究中，我们应用随机Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU)模型的贝叶斯校准来表征儿童白血病中患者特异性的肿瘤进化轨迹。利用KMT2A重排白血病的纵向队列（52名患者，311次纵向观察，对应294个独特的患者时间点），我们估计了控制均值回归和随机变异性的参数，并通过基于经验推导采样条件下的模拟验证评估了这些估计的稳定性和不确定性。一个代表性的单患者轨迹进一步展示了患者层面的进化动态。在整个队列中，推断的OU参数显示出与阶段相关的趋势，包括难治性和极早期疾病组中较高的平均扩散性，尽管后验区间大幅重叠，并未支持截然分离的动态机制。模拟分析表明，贝叶斯校准在稀疏采样下提供了稳定的后验计算和可解释的不确定性量化，尽管恢复效果仍依赖于参数和采样计划，且预测性能有限。这些发现表明，贝叶斯校准的随机模型为解释儿童白血病中的纵向肿瘤进化提供了有用框架。虽然不用于临床预测，但该方法为阶段依赖性疾病动态提供了定量视角，并强调了在稀疏临床数据集中进行不确定性感知建模的重要性。

papers.title: Uncovering hub genes and key pathways responsive to drought stress in rice via meta-analysis of transcriptomic data.
papers.authors: Joshi, Sachin; Chaudhary, Parneeta; Mrinal, Rishi; Chauhan, Ankita; Pandey, Niharika; Gautam, Sneh; Lohani, Pushpa
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过转录组元分析挖掘水稻干旱响应关键基因与通路，虽涉及转录因子但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题核心方向不匹配。
papers.abstract: Drought stress presents a formidable threat to global rice cultivation, triggering complex molecular responses that impact plant growth and productivity. To decipher the underlying gene expression dynamics, we performed a comprehensive meta-analysis of transcriptomic datasets derived from drought-tolerant rice genotypes. Via microarray data from three independent studies, we identified a set of consistently expressed differentially expressed genes (DEGs) under drought conditions. Integration of functional annotation tools, including GO and KEGG pathway enrichment, revealed key biological processes and signaling cascades involved in stress mitigation, such as ABA signaling, protein folding, and photosynthesis suppression. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) network construction, followed by hub gene identification via maximal clique centrality (MCC), highlighted pivotal regulators including LEA proteins, dehydrins, HSP70, and several transcription factors. Machine learning approaches further prioritize potential biomarkers, with Random Forest models achieving high classification accuracy and pinpointing key predictive genes. Chromosomal localization analysis provided spatial insights into the distribution of these hub genes, whose expression patterns were further compared against qRT-PCR data from previously published studies. This integrative approach identifies candidate genomic markers and mechanistic insights that may support future breeding strategies for drought-tolerant rice, pending experimental validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 干旱胁迫对全球水稻种植构成严峻威胁，触发复杂的分子响应，影响植物生长与生产力。为解析潜在的基因表达动态，我们对源自耐旱水稻基因型的转录组数据集进行了全面的荟萃分析。通过来自三项独立研究的微阵列数据，我们鉴定出一组在干旱条件下稳定表达的差异表达基因（DEGs）。整合功能注释工具（包括GO和KEGG通路富集分析）揭示了参与胁迫缓解的关键生物学过程和信号级联反应，如ABA信号传导、蛋白质折叠和光合作用抑制。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络构建，随后通过最大团中心性（MCC）进行枢纽基因鉴定，突出了关键调控因子，包括LEA蛋白、脱水素、HSP70及若干转录因子。机器学习方法进一步优先筛选潜在生物标志物，其中随机森林模型实现了高分类精度，并精准定位了关键预测基因。染色体定位分析提供了这些枢纽基因分布的空间信息，其表达模式进一步与已发表研究中的qRT-PCR数据进行了比较。这种整合方法识别出候选基因组标记和机制性见解，可能为未来耐旱水稻育种策略提供支持，但尚需实验验证。

papers.title: A C-repeat binding factor-salicylic acid (CBF-SA) module links wound-induced evaporative cooling to tissue repair in plants.
papers.authors: Balem, Joseph Michael; Tan, Chenjiao; Dias, Nathalia Cassia Ferreira; Arnold, Mariah; Tran, Sorrel; Severns, Paul M; Teixeira, Paulo Jose Pereira Lima; Li, Changying; Yang, Li
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物伤口修复中CBF转录因子与SA信号模块的调控机制，虽涉及TF-DNA互作但未聚焦结合位点预测或分子建模，方法上仅用深度学习辅助热成像分析而非AI/物理模拟建模TF-DNA互作，与课题核心方向关联较弱。
papers.abstract: Repairing damaged tissues is essential for the survival of all organisms. In plants, tissue injury rapidly triggers defense and repair programs. However, the molecular mechanisms linking early injury cues to the later stage of wound repair remain unclear. Here, we show that wounding of Arabidopsis leaves induces localized low temperature at the injury site, likely caused by evaporative cooling, which is accompanied by an activation of cold-responsive genes. Using thermal imaging combined with computer vision and deep learning, we developed a workflow to monitor the dynamics of wound healing in a quantitative, non-invasive, and real-time manner. Mechanistically, we show that C-repeat Binding Factor (CBF) transcription factors are required for the activation of the injury-associated cold response and downstream salicylic acid (SA) signaling. Our findings suggest that the CBF-SA pathway acts coordinately to promote lignin and callose deposition, thereby facilitating wound repair. Together, these findings reveal a link between a wound-induced biophysical cue and the tissue repair program.
papers.abstract_zh: 修复受损组织对所有生物的生存至关重要。在植物中，组织损伤迅速触发防御和修复程序。然而，连接早期损伤信号与后期伤口修复阶段的分子机制仍不清楚。在此，我们展示拟南芥叶片受伤会在损伤部位诱导局部低温，这可能是由蒸发冷却引起的，并伴随冷响应基因的激活。利用热成像结合计算机视觉和深度学习，我们开发了一种工作流程，以定量、非侵入性和实时的方式监测伤口愈合的动态过程。在机制上，我们表明C-重复结合因子（CBF）转录因子对于损伤相关冷响应及下游水杨酸（SA）信号传导的激活是必需的。我们的发现表明，CBF-SA通路协同作用，促进木质素和胼胝质沉积，从而促进伤口修复。综合来看，这些发现揭示了伤口诱导的生物物理信号与组织修复程序之间的联系。

papers.title: Secoisolariciresinol diglucoside alleviates inflammatory injury in osteoarthritis chondrocytes through ERBB2-associated JAK2/STAT3 signaling: network pharmacology and experimental validation.
papers.authors: Hu, Haibei; Li, Gaoshan; Wang, Yangxu; Xie, Suyu; Cao, Feng; Li, Huanyu; Gao, Xubin
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物化合物SDG通过ERBB2/JAK2/STAT3信号通路缓解骨关节炎软骨细胞炎症损伤，涉及分子对接但核心是细胞实验与信号通路验证，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Cartilage injury is a hallmark of osteoarthritis (OA). erb-B2 receptor tyrosine kinase 2 (ERBB2) has been reported to be involved in mediating the therapeutic effects of polyphenols in orthopedic diseases. This study aimed to investigate the protective effects and underlying mechanisms of action of ERBB2 in OA chondrocytes. METHODS: Bioinformatics analysis and molecular docking were used to predict the binding relationship between ERBB2 and the polyphenolic compound, secoisolariciresinol diglucoside (SDG). ATDC5 cells were induced with insulin-transferrin-selenium (ITS), followed by lipopolysaccharide (LPS) exposure to mimic OA inflammation, and treated with SDG. Cell viability, collagen II expression, apoptosis, interleukin 6 (IL-6)/Tumor Necrosis Factor-alpha (TNF-alpha) secretion, and malondialdehyde (MDA)/superoxide dismutase (SOD) levels were evaluated using cell counting kit-8 (CCK-8), immunofluorescence, flow cytometry, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), and commercial kits. Matrix metalloproteinase 13 (MMP13) and ERBB2 mRNA levels were assessed by quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR). Extracellular matrix integrity was assessed by toluidine blue staining. The predicted SDG-ERBB2 interaction was validated using a cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA). Western blotting was performed to assess the expression of ERBB2 and JAK2/STAT3. Rescue experiments with ERBB2 overexpression or colivelin (a JAK/STAT activator) treatment confirmed the involvement of this pathway. RESULTS: SDG dose-dependently reversed the LPS-induced reduction in cell viability and collagen II expression, while suppressing apoptosis, IL-6/TNF-alpha secretion, and MDA levels, and increasing SOD activity. SDG significantly reduced MMP13 mRNA levels and enhanced extracellular matrix proteoglycan deposition, indicating the preservation of matrix integrity. ERBB2 has been identified as a candidate target for SDG. SDG inhibits ERBB2 protein expression and reduces JAK2 and STAT3 phosphorylation ERBB2 overexpression and colivelin treatment abrogated the protective effects of SDG on cell viability, collagen II expression, apoptosis, inflammation, and oxidative stress, as well as its suppression of MMP13 and preservation of matrix integrity. CONCLUSION: SDG protects chondrocytes against LPS-induced inflammatory injury by targeting ERBB2 and suppressing the downstream JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway. These findings provide mechanistic evidence supporting the chondroprotective potential of SDG under inflammatory conditions and suggest that ERBB2/JAK2/STAT3 signaling may represent a potential therapeutic target in OA.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：软骨损伤是骨关节炎（osteoarthritis, OA）的标志性特征。erb-B2受体酪氨酸激酶2（ERBB2）已被报道参与介导多酚类化合物在骨科疾病中的治疗效果。本研究旨在探讨ERBB2在OA软骨细胞中的保护作用及其潜在作用机制。方法：采用生物信息学分析和分子对接（molecular docking）预测ERBB2与多酚类化合物开环异落叶松树脂酚二葡萄糖苷（secoisolariciresinol diglucoside, SDG）之间的结合关系。用胰岛素-转铁蛋白-硒（insulin-transferrin-selenium, ITS）诱导ATDC5细胞，随后用脂多糖（lipopolysaccharide, LPS）暴露以模拟OA炎症，并用SDG处理。使用细胞计数试剂盒-8（CCK-8）、免疫荧光、流式细胞术、酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）和商业试剂盒评估细胞活力、II型胶原表达、凋亡、白细胞介素6（IL-6）/肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）分泌以及丙二醛（MDA）/超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）水平。通过定量实时聚合酶链反应（qRT-PCR）评估基质金属蛋白酶13（MMP13）和ERBB2 mRNA水平。通过甲苯胺蓝染色评估细胞外基质完整性。使用细胞热转变分析（cellular thermal shift assay, CETSA）验证预测的SDG-ERBB2相互作用。通过蛋白质印迹法评估ERBB2及JAK2/STAT3的表达。通过ERBB2过表达或colivelin（一种JAK/STAT激活剂）处理的拯救实验确认该通路的参与。结果：SDG剂量依赖性地逆转了LPS诱导的细胞活力和II型胶原表达降低，同时抑制凋亡、IL-6/TNF-alpha分泌和MDA水平，并增加SOD活性。SDG显著降低MMP13 mRNA水平并增强细胞外基质蛋白聚糖沉积，表明基质完整性得以保持。ERBB2被确定为SDG的候选靶点。SDG抑制ERBB2蛋白表达并减少JAK2和STAT3磷酸化。ERBB2过表达和colivelin处理消除了SDG对细胞活力、II型胶原表达、凋亡、炎症和氧化应激的保护作用，以及其对MMP13的抑制和基质完整性的维持。结论：SDG通过靶向ERBB2并抑制下游JAK2/STAT3信号通路，保护软骨细胞免受LPS诱导的炎症损伤。这些发现为SDG在炎症条件下的软骨保护潜力提供了机制性证据，并提示ERBB2/JAK2/STAT3信号可能代表OA中的一个潜在治疗靶点。

papers.title: In silico Identification of Key Genes and Repurposable Drugs for Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
papers.authors: Zarin, Nazia; Tanha, Tasnim Hosen; Nishad, Mimuna; Parvin, Rehana; Ashad, Redwan; Islam, Md Sajedul; Haque, Shaila
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过转录组和网络分析识别三阴性乳腺癌关键基因，并利用分子对接和MD模拟筛选药物，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，仅涉及转录因子调控网络分析，与课题聚焦的TF-DNA互作机制建模关联较弱。
papers.abstract: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is a highly aggressive and treatment-resistant subtype, lacking HER2, progesterone, and estrogen receptors. Systemic chemotherapy remains the primary treatment due to the absence of molecular targets, often leading to poor prognosis and high recurrence. This study used an integrated in silico transcriptomic and network-based bioinformatics approach to identify TNBC key genes (TKGs) and explore potential therapeutic candidates. Four TNBC microarray datasets (GSE36295, GSE38959, GSE45827, and GSE65194) were analyzed with the LIMMA algorithm in GEO2R, revealing 315 TNBC-shared differentially expressed genes (TSDEGs). Eight strongly connected TKGs were identified via topological analysis and protein-protein interaction (PPI) network construction across the STRING and IMEx databases from TSDEGs: CDK1, TOP2A, CCNB1, CDK2, FN1, UBC, PRKDC, and PARP1. Enrichment analysis of biological processes, molecular functions, cellular components, and KEGG pathways, combined with regulatory network analysis involving transcription factors and microRNAs, identified pathogenic roles of these genes. CDK1 and CDK2 were identified as the top pharmacological targets for molecular docking studies. Finally, TKG-guided top-ranked two drug molecules (Alsterpaullone and BLU-222) emerged as promising repurposed therapeutic candidates for TNBC. The absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) and drug-likeness analyses showed these molecules have favorable pharmacokinetic properties. Molecular dynamics simulations over 100 nanoseconds demonstrated stable binding interactions and favorable behavior for the complexes CDK1-Alsterpaullone and CDK2-BLU-222, as indicated by root mean square deviation, fluctuation, and molecular interactions generalized Born surface area. Overall, these findings may aid in diagnosing and treating TNBC, providing valuable resources for future therapeutic strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）是一种高度侵袭性且难治的亚型，缺乏HER2、孕激素和雌激素受体。由于缺乏分子靶点，系统性化疗仍是主要治疗手段，但常导致预后不良和高复发率。本研究采用整合的计算机模拟转录组学和基于网络的生物信息学方法，以识别TNBC关键基因（TKGs）并探索潜在的治疗候选药物。通过GEO2R中的LIMMA算法分析了四个TNBC微阵列数据集（GSE36295、GSE38959、GSE45827和GSE65194），共揭示315个TNBC共享差异表达基因（TSDEGs）。通过跨STRING和IMEx数据库的拓扑分析及蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络构建，从TSDEGs中鉴定出八个强连接的关键基因：CDK1、TOP2A、CCNB1、CDK2、FN1、UBC、PRKDC和PARP1。对生物学过程、分子功能、细胞组分及KEGG通路的富集分析，结合涉及转录因子和microRNA的调控网络分析，确定了这些基因的致病作用。CDK1和CDK2被确定为分子对接研究的首要药理学靶点。最终，基于TKG引导的排名前两位的药物分子（Alsterpaullone和BLU-222）成为TNBC有前景的药物重定位治疗候选物。吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）及药物相似性分析显示，这些分子具有良好的药代动力学特性。超过100纳秒的分子动力学模拟表明，CDK1-Alsterpaullone和CDK2-BLU-222复合物具有稳定的结合相互作用和有利行为，这由均方根偏差、波动及广义Born表面积分子相互作用所指示。总体而言，这些发现可能有助于TNBC的诊断和治疗，为未来的治疗策略提供宝贵资源。

papers.title: Matrine Alleviates Sepsis-Induced Acute Lung Injury by Reinforcing NQO1/SLC7A11/GPX4-Associated Anti-Ferroptotic Defenses and Attenuating NF-kappaB-Driven Inflammation.
papers.authors: Chen, Xue; Yuan, Min; Huang, Ting; Wang, Yuxuan; Lei, Zihan; Qing, Jingxue; Gong, Hailong; Aidebaike, Delida; Zhang, Zhengyu; Wu, Xiaojing
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究苦参碱通过NQO1/SLC7A11/GPX4抗铁死亡和NF-κB抗炎通路缓解脓毒症肺损伤，虽涉及分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物机制而非TF-DNA互作，对象和方法与本课题关联较弱。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Sepsis triggers dysregulated systemic inflammation and multiple-organ dysfunction, with the lungs being particularly susceptible to injury. Sepsis-induced acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) is mainly driven by TLR4/NF-kappaB-mediated hyperinflammation and alveolar macrophage activation. Matrine, a bioactive alkaloid derived from Sophora flavescens, has been reported to modulate redox homeostasis and ferroptosis-associated lipid peroxidation. However, the target-specific mechanisms underlying its effects on ferroptosis and inflammatory signaling in sepsis-induced acute lung injury (SALI) remain incompletely understood. PURPOSE: This study aimed to evaluate the therapeutic effects of matrine in a cecal ligation and puncture (CLP)-induced SALI model and to determine whether its protective effects involve reinforcement of NQO1/SLC7A11/GPX4-associated anti-ferroptotic defenses and suppression of NF-kappaB-driven inflammation. METHODS: We analyzed the single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) dataset GSE273924 to characterize CD45-enriched pulmonary immune-cell subsets in sham mice and mice with intratracheal Escherichia coli-induced pneumonia. Network pharmacology and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analyses were performed to predict Kushen (KS)-related targets and pathways associated with SALI. Differential expression analysis and weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) of GSE245013 were used to identify candidate targets. Matrine-NQO1 binding and intracellular target engagement were evaluated using molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, surface plasmon resonance (SPR), and the cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA). The therapeutic effects of matrine were assessed in mice with CLP-induced SALI and in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-stimulated MH-S cells. Lung histopathology, inflammatory cytokine production, target protein expression, ferroptosis-associated indicators, and NF-kappaB activation were evaluated using molecular, biochemical, and histological assays. The functional contribution of NQO1 was further examined using the NQO1 inhibitor ES936. RESULTS: scRNA-seq analysis of GSE273924 revealed substantial remodeling of the CD45-enriched pulmonary immune-cell landscape in mice with intratracheal E. coli-induced pneumonia, including macrophage transcriptional programs associated with ferroptosis and inflammatory signaling. Integrated network pharmacology and bioinformatics analyses prioritized NQO1 as a candidate target of matrine and identified NF-kappaB signaling as a potentially relevant pathway. Molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, SPR, and CETSA supported matrine-NQO1 binding and intracellular target engagement. Functionally, matrine improved survival, attenuated lung injury, reinforced NQO1/SLC7A11/GPX4-associated anti-ferroptotic defenses, and suppressed NF-kappaB activation in CLP mice. Similar protective effects were observed in LPS-stimulated MH-S cells. ES936 partially attenuated the matrine-mediated improvements in cell viability, redox homeostasis, ferroptosis-associated indicators, and NF-kappaB p65 phosphorylation, supporting a functional contribution of NQO1 to the protective effects of matrine. CONCLUSION: Matrine alleviates SALI by reinforcing NQO1/SLC7A11/GPX4-associated anti-ferroptotic defenses and attenuating NF-kappaB-driven inflammation.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：脓毒症引发失调的全身性炎症和多器官功能障碍，其中肺尤其易受损伤。脓毒症诱导的急性呼吸窘迫综合征（ARDS）主要由TLR4/NF-kappaB介导的过度炎症和肺泡巨噬细胞活化驱动。苦参碱（matrine）是从苦参（Sophora flavescens）中提取的一种生物活性生物碱，已被报道可调节氧化还原稳态和铁死亡相关的脂质过氧化。然而，其在脓毒症诱导的急性肺损伤（SALI）中对铁死亡和炎症信号传导的靶点特异性机制仍未完全阐明。目的：本研究旨在评估苦参碱在盲肠结扎穿刺（CLP）诱导的SALI模型中的治疗效果，并确定其保护作用是否涉及增强NQO1/SLC7A11/GPX4相关的抗铁死亡防御和抑制NF-kappaB驱动的炎症。方法：我们分析了单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据集GSE273924，以表征假手术小鼠和气管内大肠杆菌诱导肺炎小鼠中CD45富集的肺免疫细胞亚群。进行了网络药理学和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）富集分析，以预测与SALI相关的苦参（KS）靶点和通路。利用GSE245013的差异表达分析和加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）来识别候选靶点。通过分子对接、分子动力学模拟、表面等离子体共振（SPR）和细胞热位移分析（CETSA）评估了苦参碱-NQO1结合及细胞内靶点参与。在CLP诱导的SALI小鼠和脂多糖（LPS）刺激的MH-S细胞中评估了苦参碱的治疗效果。使用分子、生化和组织学检测评估了肺组织病理学、炎症细胞因子产生、靶蛋白表达、铁死亡相关指标和NF-kappaB活化。进一步使用NQO1抑制剂ES936检查了NQO1的功能贡献。结果：GSE273924的scRNA-seq分析显示，在气管内大肠杆菌诱导肺炎的小鼠中，CD45富集的肺免疫细胞景观发生了显著重塑，包括与铁死亡和炎症信号传导相关的巨噬细胞转录程序。综合网络药理学和生物信息学分析将NQO1优先列为苦参碱的候选靶点，并确定NF-kappaB信号传导为潜在相关通路。分子对接、分子动力学模拟、SPR和CETSA支持苦参碱-NQO1结合及细胞内靶点参与。功能上，苦参碱改善了CLP小鼠的存活率，减轻了肺损伤，增强了NQO1/SLC7A11/GPX4相关的抗铁死亡防御，并抑制了NF-kappaB活化。在LPS刺激的MH-S细胞中观察到类似的保护效果。ES936部分减弱了苦参碱介导的细胞活力、氧化还原稳态、铁死亡相关指标和NF-kappaB p65磷酸化的改善，支持NQO1对苦参碱保护作用的功能贡献。结论：苦参碱通过增强NQO1/SLC7A11/GPX4相关的抗铁死亡防御和减弱NF-kappaB驱动的炎症来缓解SALI。

papers.title: PTM-Driven Reshaping of the Peptide Translocation Landscape in Bilayer Graphene Nanopores.
papers.authors: Upadhyaya, Anurag; Sur, Pranjal; Varma, Manoj; Maiti, Prabal K
papers.journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文利用全原子分子动力学模拟研究PTM修饰对p53肽段在双层石墨烯纳米孔中易位行为的影响，虽涉及蛋白质-纳米孔互作和分子动力学方法，但核心是肽段易位而非TF-DNA结合与互作机制，仅方法可迁移至蛋白质-DNA互作研究。
papers.abstract: Post-translational modifications (PTMs) underpin much of protein regulation, yet their single-molecule readout remains a challenge in nanopore proteomics. While biological nanopores have shown exquisite PTM sensitivity, the microscopic mechanisms by which PTMs perturb signals in solid-state nanopores are largely unexplored. Here, we use all-atom molecular dynamics to investigate how three common PTMs, acetylation, phosphorylation, and methylation, modulate the translocation of a cancer-relevant p53 peptide fragment through a bilayer graphene nanopore. We find that PTMs remodel the translocation landscape far more strongly at the level of dwell-time statistics than at the level of mean current blockade. Acetylation enhances peptide-graphene adhesion and substantially slows transport, with adjacent acetylations producing the longest residence times due to cooperative interfacial interactions, while remotely spaced acetylations yield broader, heterogeneous dynamics. Phosphorylation introduces a negative charge that increases dwell time through an electrostatic tug-of-war. In contrast, methylation minimally perturbs translocation due to weak pore interactions and preserved charge. Combining dwell time with relative blockade features enables a simple linear SVM classifier to reliably distinguish unmodified, acetylated, and phosphorylated states. These results establish mechanistic design principles for PTM detection using solid-state nanopores and delineate which classes of PTMs are the most amenable to single-molecule detection with these devices.
papers.abstract_zh: 翻译后修饰（PTMs）是蛋白质调控的重要基础，然而在纳米孔蛋白质组学中，其单分子读出仍是一项挑战。尽管生物纳米孔已展现出对PTM的精细敏感性，但PTM在固态纳米孔中扰动信号的微观机制在很大程度上尚未被探索。在此，我们利用全原子分子动力学（all-atom molecular dynamics）研究三种常见PTM——乙酰化（acetylation）、磷酸化（phosphorylation）和甲基化（methylation）——如何调控一个癌症相关的p53肽段片段通过双层石墨烯纳米孔的易位过程。我们发现，PTM在停留时间统计层面重塑易位景观的强度远大于在平均电流阻断层面。乙酰化增强肽段与石墨烯的粘附并显著减缓运输，相邻乙酰化因协同界面相互作用产生最长的停留时间，而间隔较远的乙酰化则导致更宽泛、异质的动力学行为。磷酸化引入负电荷，通过静电拉锯战增加停留时间。相比之下，甲基化因与孔相互作用弱且电荷保持不变，对易位的扰动最小。将停留时间与相对阻断特征相结合，可使一个简单的线性SVM分类器可靠地区分未修饰、乙酰化和磷酸化状态。这些结果为利用固态纳米孔检测PTM建立了机制性设计原则，并阐明了哪些类别的PTM最适用于这些器件的单分子检测。

papers.title: Production of Anti-melanogenic Glucosides via Molecular Docking-guided Biotransformation of p-hydroxyphenethyl anisate.
papers.authors: Chang, Te-Sheng; Wu, Jiumn-Yih; Ding, Hsiou-Yu; Cho, Shu-Chi; Wang, Tzi-Yuan; Tsao, Che-Chia; Chen, Jou-Yi; Wu, Chien-Yu; Ting, Huei-Ju
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究对羟基苯乙基茴香酸酯的酶法糖基化及产物抗黑色素生成活性，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: p-Hydroxyphenethyl anisate (HP) has been identified as a natural compound with whitening activity in melanoma cells and zebrafish. Considering that glycosylation can enhance the solubility, stability, and bioactivity of natural products, we investigated whether HP could serve as a substrate for glycosylation enzymes. Molecular docking predicted favorable interactions between HP and amylosucrase as well as glycosyltransferases, suggesting the potential formation of alpha- and beta-glucosides. Enzymatic reactions confirmed the production of phenethylanisate-4'-O-alpha-glucoside (HP-alpha-glc) and phenethylanisate-4'-O-beta-glucoside (HP-beta-glc). The structures were validated by mass spectrometry, enzymatic digestion (HP-alpha-glc), or nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy (HP-beta-glc). Biological evaluation revealed that both glucosides suppressed melanogenesis in murine B16-F1 melanoma cells at non-cytotoxic concentrations. Mechanistic studies demonstrated that HP-beta-glc not only inhibited tyrosinase activity but also downregulated the expression of the microphthalmia-associated transcription factor (MITF) and tyrosinase at both the protein and mRNA levels, thereby attenuating melanogenesis through transcriptional regulation. Consistently, in vivo assays demonstrated that HP-beta-glc effectively inhibited pigmentation in zebrafish embryos without inducing developmental toxicity, and its effect was comparable to that of the positive control, raspberry ketone. These findings highlight the enzymatic glycosylation of HP as a viable strategy to generate bioactive derivatives with improved functional properties. In particular, HP-beta-glc retains the anti-melanogenic activity of HP, providing mechanistic evidence and preclinical validation for its potential application as a safe and effective skin-whitening agent.
papers.abstract_zh: p-Hydroxyphenethyl anisate (HP) 已被鉴定为一种在黑色素瘤细胞和斑马鱼中具有美白活性的天然化合物。考虑到糖基化可以增强天然产物的溶解度、稳定性和生物活性，我们研究了HP是否可作为糖基化酶的底物。分子对接预测了HP与amylosucrase以及glycosyltransferases之间的有利相互作用，提示可能形成alpha-和beta-葡萄糖苷。酶促反应证实了phenethylanisate-4'-O-alpha-glucoside (HP-alpha-glc) 和 phenethylanisate-4'-O-beta-glucoside (HP-beta-glc) 的生成。结构通过质谱、酶解（HP-alpha-glc）或核磁共振波谱（HP-beta-glc）得到验证。生物学评价显示，两种葡萄糖苷在非细胞毒性浓度下均抑制了小鼠B16-F1黑色素瘤细胞中的黑色素生成。机制研究表明，HP-beta-glc不仅抑制了tyrosinase活性，还在蛋白质和mRNA水平上下调了microphthalmia-associated transcription factor (MITF) 和tyrosinase的表达，从而通过转录调控减弱黑色素生成。一致地，体内实验表明，HP-beta-glc有效抑制了斑马鱼胚胎中的色素沉着，且未诱导发育毒性，其效果与阳性对照raspberry ketone相当。这些发现强调了HP的酶促糖基化是生成具有改善功能特性的生物活性衍生物的可行策略。特别是，HP-beta-glc保留了HP的抗黑色素生成活性，为其作为安全有效的皮肤美白剂的潜在应用提供了机制证据和临床前验证。

papers.title: DMGRN: Enhancing Diffusion Models for Gene Regulatory Network Inference.
papers.authors: Li, Rongyuan; Wu, Jingli; Chen, Chunfeng; Li, Gaoshi; Liu, Jiafei; Hu, Haize; Xuan, Junbo; Liu, Jinlu; Deng, Zheng; Gong, Daoqing
papers.journal: IEEE transactions on computational biology and bioinformatics
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文利用扩散模型从scRNA-seq数据推断基因调控网络，虽涉及TF-靶基因关系，但核心是表达数据降噪与网络推断，而非TF-DNA分子互作建模或结合位点预测，方法上无三维结构或物理模拟，属于间接相关。
papers.abstract: Gene regulatory networks (GRNs) encode the intricate interactions between transcription factors (TFs) and their target genes, playing a pivotal role in orchestrating cellular metabolism, proliferation, and differentiation, thereby illuminating the molecular mechanisms underlying disease onset and progression. The increasing availability of single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data offers unprecedented opportunities for computational GRN inference. However, the inherent high noise and sparsity of scRNA-seq data considerably impair the performance of existing inference methods. To overcome these limitations, we propose DMGRN, a novel GRN inference frame work built upon an improved Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM). Our approach first applies a forward diffusion process to progressively introduce Gaussian noise into the raw expression data, and subsequently employs a reverse process integrated with a structural equation model (SEM) to predict the noise, thereby accurately recovering gene regulatory relationships. To further enhance inference fidelity, we introduce a gene similarity alignment loss that encourages correlation consistency between the predicted noise and the perturbed data at the gene level, enabling the model to simultaneously capture cellular-level noise residuals and gene-level regulatory co-expression patterns. Experimental results on 28 BEELINE benchmark datasets demonstrate that DMGRN achieves the highest Early Precision Ratio (EPR) on 18 out of 28 BEELINE benchmark configurations, demonstrating superior stability and computational efficiency compared to state-of-the-art methods.
papers.abstract_zh: 基因调控网络（Gene Regulatory Networks, GRNs）编码了转录因子（Transcription Factors, TFs）与其靶基因之间的复杂相互作用，在协调细胞代谢、增殖和分化中发挥关键作用，从而揭示疾病发生与进展的分子机制。单细胞RNA测序（single-cell RNA sequencing, scRNA-seq）数据日益丰富的可用性为计算GRN推断提供了前所未有的机遇。然而，scRNA-seq数据固有的高噪声和稀疏性显著削弱了现有推断方法的性能。为克服这些局限，我们提出DMGRN，一种基于改进去噪扩散概率模型（Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model, DDPM）的新型GRN推断框架。我们的方法首先应用前向扩散过程逐步向原始表达数据引入高斯噪声，随后采用结合结构方程模型（Structural Equation Model, SEM）的反向过程预测噪声，从而准确恢复基因调控关系。为进一步提升推断保真度，我们引入基因相似性对齐损失，促使预测噪声与扰动数据在基因水平上的相关性一致性，使模型能够同时捕获细胞水平的噪声残差和基因水平的调控共表达模式。在28个BEELINE基准数据集上的实验结果表明，DMGRN在28个BEELINE基准配置中的18个上取得了最高的早期精确率（Early Precision Ratio, EPR），与最先进方法相比展现出卓越的稳定性和计算效率。

papers.title: A HUWE1 regulatory helix gates ASCL1 degradation through its C-terminal phospho-degron in small cell lung cancer.
papers.authors: Masuzawa, Keita; Dong, Kevin D; XiaoYang Hu, Calvin; Peng, Ting; Myung, Yoochan; Singh, Shilpa; Li, Xinyue; Wang, Tianchu; Jin, Cyrus; Paulo, Joao A; Yang, Ka; Schmid, Ernst W; Booker, Matthew A; Li, Yixiang; Hong, Deli; Lazo, Suzan; Tolstorukov, Michael Y; Doench, John G; Duplaquet, Leslie; Donovan, Katherine A; Iqbal, Sumaiya; Fischer, Eric S; Liau, Brian B; Gygi, Steven P; Oser, Matthew G
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过CRISPR筛选研究转录因子ASCL1的降解机制，但未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题核心方向无关。
papers.abstract: Lineage-defining transcription factors are key oncogenic drivers but remain difficult to target pharmacologically due to the absence of ligandable pockets. The molecular rules governing substrate recognition by large HECT ubiquitin ligases also remain incompletely understood, limiting efforts to exploit these enzymes for targeted protein degradation. Here we combine genome-wide CRISPR knockout screening with base editor tiling screens at amino acid resolution, both coupled to an endogenous knock-in reporter of the SCLC lineage oncogenic transcription factor ASCL1, to systematically interrogate the mechanisms governing its degradation. These complementary screens unbiasedly identify the HECT ubiquitin ligase HUWE1 as the dominant regulator of ASCL1 stability in small cell lung cancer (SCLC) and resolve a conserved C-terminal phospho-degron centered on Ser207 and terminal Trp/Phe residues that are required for HUWE1 docking and ubiquitin-mediated degradation. Unexpectedly, base editor screening further uncovers a previously unrecognized regulatory module within HUWE1: a short negatively charged helix that functions as an autoinhibitory gate controlling access of phospho-degron substrates to HUWE1. Charge-flipping mutations within this regulatory helix relieve autoinhibition and accelerate degradation of multiple HUWE1 phospho-degron substrates, including ASCL1 and the canonical HUWE1 substrate DDIT4. Stabilization of ASCL1 through degron disruption paradoxically impairs SCLC proliferation, revealing that dynamic proteasome-coupled turnover is required for transcription factor function. Together, these findings reveal molecular rules governing HUWE1 phospho-degron recognition and identify a regulatory gate controlling substrate engagement. They also illustrate a generalizable strategy for resolving degradation mechanisms of undruggable transcription factors in their endogenous cellular context.
papers.abstract_zh: 谱系定义转录因子是关键的致癌驱动因子，但由于缺乏可配体结合的pocket，仍难以通过药理学手段靶向。大HECT泛素连接酶底物识别的分子规则也尚未完全阐明，这限制了利用这些酶进行靶向蛋白降解的努力。在此，我们结合全基因组CRISPR敲除筛选与氨基酸分辨率的碱基编辑器tiling筛选，两者均耦合至SCLC谱系致癌转录因子ASCL1的内源性knock-in报告基因，以系统性地探究调控其降解的机制。这些互补筛选无偏地鉴定出HECT泛素连接酶HUWE1是小细胞肺癌（SCLC）中ASCL1稳定性的主要调控因子，并解析了一个以Ser207和末端Trp/Phe残基为中心的保守C端磷酸化degron，该degron是HUWE1对接和泛素介导降解所必需的。出乎意料的是，碱基编辑器筛选进一步揭示了HUWE1内一个先前未被识别的调控模块：一个短负电荷螺旋，它作为自抑制门控，控制磷酸化degron底物对HUWE1的访问。该调控螺旋内的电荷翻转突变解除自抑制，并加速多个HUWE1磷酸化degron底物的降解，包括ASCL1和经典HUWE1底物DDIT4。通过degron破坏稳定ASCL1反而会损害SCLC增殖，揭示动态的蛋白酶体偶联转换是转录因子功能所必需的。总之，这些发现揭示了调控HUWE1磷酸化degron识别的分子规则，并鉴定了一个控制底物结合的门控。它们还阐明了一种在细胞内源性环境中解析不可成药转录因子降解机制的通用策略。

papers.title: Plasma Protein Binding Prediction under Scaffold Split: Tree Models, ChemBERTa, Graph Networks, and Late Fusion
papers.authors: Pradyumna Kumar Pradhan
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子血浆蛋白结合预测，使用图神经网络和ChemBERTa等模型，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或转录因子结合，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: From idea generation to testing, drug discovery is a lengthy and expensive process. Rather than chasing all of their molecule ideas, scientists prioritize certain molecules that are more likely to be successful, from synthesis to safety to therapeutic use. Machine learning and AI enable researchers to narrow their candidate choices by predicting important properties such as ADMET (Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion, and Toxicity). This study uses the Plasma Protein Binding (PPB) dataset from DeepChem’s MoleculeNet, with several graph neural networks (GNNs), ChemBERTa (a language model for SMILES strings of molecules), and fusions of these models. The performance of these neural models is compared against two standard tree-based models: Random Forest (RF) and XGBoost. Instead of random splitting of the dataset, this study evaluates the models based on scaffold splitting that separates molecules by the Bemis–Murcko scaffold and puts the entire group into only the training, validation, or test set. This study demonstrates that for the PPB dataset, GNNs and ChemBERTa models perform better than the tree models. On a mean basis, the fusion models perform better than the individual GNNs or ChemBERTa-only models. Random splitting on the RF model exhibits a better R2 score than on a scaffold-split dataset. Because under scaffold splitting the model predicts on unseen cores, the task becomes more difficult than under regular random splitting.
papers.abstract_zh: 从想法生成到测试，药物发现是一个漫长且昂贵的过程。科学家们并非追逐所有分子想法，而是优先选择那些从合成、安全性到治疗用途更可能成功的特定分子。机器学习和人工智能使研究人员能够通过预测重要性质（如ADMET（吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性））来缩小候选范围。本研究使用来自DeepChem的MoleculeNet的血浆蛋白结合（PPB）数据集，结合多种图神经网络（GNNs）、ChemBERTa（一种用于分子SMILES字符串的语言模型）以及这些模型的融合。这些神经模型的性能与两种基于树的基准模型——随机森林（RF）和XGBoost——进行了比较。本研究未采用数据集的随机划分，而是基于支架划分（scaffold splitting）评估模型，该划分根据Bemis–Murcko支架分离分子，并将整个组仅放入训练集、验证集或测试集。研究表明，对于PPB数据集，GNNs和ChemBERTa模型的性能优于树模型。在均值基础上，融合模型的性能优于单独的GNNs或仅ChemBERTa模型。RF模型在随机划分下的R2分数优于支架划分数据集。由于在支架划分下，模型需对未见核心进行预测，该任务比常规随机划分更为困难。

papers.title: An MRI-Based Intratumoral and Peritumoral 2.5D Deep Learning Model for Predicting P53-Mutated Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Two-Center Study.
papers.authors: Weng, Jingfei; Li, Pinxiong; Yao, Dinghua; He, Yuqing; Yang, Chun; Yang, Bin
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文利用MRI影像深度学习模型预测肝癌P53突变状态，属于临床诊断应用，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或分子机制建模，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: IntroductionHepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is the most common primary liver cancer with high mortality. TP53 is the most frequently mutated tumor-suppressor gene in HCC, and P53 mutations are associated with poor differentiation, vascular invasion, and lower survival. Preoperative noninvasive detection of P53-mutated HCC is critical for treatment planning and prognostic assessment. This study aimed to develop and validate a deep learning (DL) model for predicting P53 mutation status in HCC.MethodsIn this retrospective two-center study, 373 patients with pathologically confirmed HCC were enrolled from two institutions (Center 1: n=320; Center 2: n=53). The Center 1 cohort was randomly partitioned into a training cohort (n=256) and an internal test cohort (n=64). Patients from Center 2 constituted an independent external test cohort (n=53). We employed a 2.5D ResNet34 architecture to process three-channel dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (DCE-MRI). Separate deep learning models were constructed for intratumoral and peritumoral regions using both single-phase and multiphase (arterial, portal venous, and delayed) fusion sequences. Significant clinical variables were selected to build a Clinical model, which was subsequently integrated with the optimal deep learning model to create a Combined model. Model performance was assessed by the area under the curve (AUC), calibration curves, and decision curve analysis (DCA).ResultsMultiphase fusion models consistently outperformed their single-phase models. The peritumoral (5mm) fusion model (IntraPeri5mm_Fusion) outperformed the intratumoral fusion model, achieving AUCs of 0.881 (95% CI: 0.836-0.926), 0.772 (95% CI: 0.651-0.893), and 0.757 (95% CI: 0.624-0.891) on the training cohort, internal test cohort, and external test cohort, respectively. The Combined model yielded further incremental improvement, with AUCs reaching 0.886 (95% CI: 0.842-0.930), 0.805 (95% CI: 0.691-0.918), and 0.793 (95% CI: 0.668-0.918) across the respective cohorts.ConclusionsThe proposed 2.5D DL model based on DCE-MRI effectively predicts P53-mutated HCC. Integrating peritumoral features with clinical variables yields the best performance, offering a promising noninvasive tool for prognostic stratification and individualized therapeutic planning.
papers.abstract_zh: 引言肝细胞癌（HCC）是最常见的原发性肝癌，死亡率高。TP53是HCC中最常突变的肿瘤抑制基因，P53突变与低分化、血管侵犯及较低生存率相关。术前无创检测P53突变型HCC对治疗规划和预后评估至关重要。本研究旨在开发并验证一种深度学习（DL）模型，用于预测HCC中的P53突变状态。方法在这项回顾性双中心研究中，共纳入来自两个机构的373例经病理确诊的HCC患者（中心1：n=320；中心2：n=53）。中心1队列被随机分为训练队列（n=256）和内部测试队列（n=64）。中心2的患者构成独立的外部测试队列（n=53）。我们采用2.5D ResNet34架构处理三通道动态对比增强磁共振成像（DCE-MRI）。分别针对瘤内和瘤周区域构建了使用单期和多期（动脉期、门静脉期和延迟期）融合序列的深度学习模型。选择显著的临床变量构建临床模型，随后将其与最优深度学习模型整合，形成联合模型。模型性能通过曲线下面积（AUC）、校准曲线和决策曲线分析（DCA）进行评估。结果多期融合模型始终优于其单期模型。瘤周（5mm）融合模型（IntraPeri5mm_Fusion）优于瘤内融合模型，在训练队列、内部测试队列和外部测试队列上的AUC分别为0.881（95% CI：0.836-0.926）、0.772（95% CI：0.651-0.893）和0.757（95% CI：0.624-0.891）。联合模型进一步带来增量改进，在相应队列中的AUC分别达到0.886（95% CI：0.842-0.930）、0.805（95% CI：0.691-0.918）和0.793（95% CI：0.668-0.918）。结论所提出的基于DCE-MRI的2.5D DL模型能有效预测P53突变型HCC。将瘤周特征与临床变量整合可获得最佳性能，为预后分层和个体化治疗规划提供了一种有前景的无创工具。

papers.title: Repurposing of lansoprazole and nitazoxanide as NR2F2 inhibitors in the gastric cancer cell line GCIY: computational insights and siRNA-mediated in vitro tests.
papers.authors: Culletta, Giulia; Roomi, Muhammad Sohaib; Caricasulo, Maria Azzurra; Zanetti, Adriana; Terao, Mineko; Paroni, Gabriela; Garattini, Enrico; Tutone, Marco
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过计算虚拟筛选和siRNA实验，研究药物分子与核受体NR2F2（转录因子）的配体结合及转录活性调控，涉及蛋白-配体互作而非直接蛋白-DNA结合建模，方法上以计算筛选和实验验证为主，对TF-DNA互作课题仅有间接启发。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Nuclear receptors (NRs) are a superfamily of ligand-activated transcription factors that mediate the cellular response to hormones, vitamins, and dietary lipids, thus orchestrating numerous physiological processes and influencing multiple disease states. Within this superfamily, NR2Fs, also known as Chicken Ovalbumin Upstream Promoter Transcription Factor (COUP-TF), are a family of nuclear orphan receptors, due to the lack of known endogenous ligands. Among them, NR2F2 transcription factor activities involve regulation of cell differentiation during organogenesis, maintenance of adult tissue homeostasis, and tumorigenesis. To date, only the CIA compounds have been identified as inhibitors of NR2F2 driven transcriptional activity in prostate cancer cell lines, with the IC50 of CIA1 falling in the lower muM range. METHODS: A comprehensive computational analysis has been conducted in order to gain insight into the inhibitory activity of the prototype CIA1 against NR2F2 at a molecular level. We leveraged the outputs of computational analysis to perform a virtual screening campaign to FDA compounds capable of binding to NR2F2. Luciferase reporter assay was used to functionally validate the interaction. RNA interference approaches were used to validate the specificity of NR2F2 activity on cell proliferation. RESULTS: We identified lapatinib, glyburide, nitazoxanide, and lansoprazole as modulators of NR2F2-dependent reporter activity. In the gastric cancer cell line GCIY, lansoprazole and nitazoxanide exert antiproliferative effects that are mitigated by NR2F2 silencing. The convergence between in silico predictions and LBD-dependent reporter modulation supports the interpretation that lapatinib, glyburide, nitazoxanide, and lansoprazole represent bona fide functional interactors of NR2F2. CONCLUSION: Taken together, our data extend current evidence that NR2F2 is a ligandable orphan receptor whose transcriptional output can be pharmacologically tuned. Moreover, our findings provide new chemical tools for probing NR2F2 biology and nominate clinically used molecules as starting points for therapeutic or repurposing strategies targeting NR2F2-dependent programs.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：核受体（Nuclear receptors, NRs）是一个配体激活的转录因子超家族，介导细胞对激素、维生素和膳食脂质的响应，从而协调众多生理过程并影响多种疾病状态。在该超家族中，NR2Fs，也称为鸡卵清蛋白上游启动子转录因子（COUP-TF），由于缺乏已知的内源性配体，属于核孤儿受体家族。其中，NR2F2转录因子活性涉及器官发生过程中的细胞分化调控、成体组织稳态维持以及肿瘤发生。迄今为止，仅CIA化合物被鉴定为前列腺癌细胞系中NR2F2驱动转录活性的抑制剂，其中CIA1的IC50处于低微摩尔范围。方法：为在分子水平上深入了解原型CIA1对NR2F2的抑制活性，我们进行了全面的计算分析。我们利用计算分析的输出结果，对FDA化合物进行了虚拟筛选，以识别能够结合NR2F2的候选物。使用荧光素酶报告基因实验进行功能验证相互作用。采用RNA干扰方法验证NR2F2活性对细胞增殖的特异性。结果：我们鉴定出拉帕替尼（lapatinib）、格列本脲（glyburide）、硝唑尼特（nitazoxanide）和兰索拉唑（lansoprazole）作为NR2F2依赖性报告基因活性的调节剂。在胃癌细胞系GCIY中，兰索拉唑和硝唑尼特发挥抗增殖作用，这些作用通过NR2F2沉默而减弱。计算机预测与LBD依赖性报告基因调节之间的趋同性支持了拉帕替尼、格列本脲、硝唑尼特和兰索拉唑代表NR2F2真正功能相互作用因子的解释。结论：综合来看，我们的数据扩展了现有证据，表明NR2F2是一个可配体的孤儿受体，其转录输出可通过药理学方式调节。此外，我们的发现为探究NR2F2生物学提供了新的化学工具，并提名临床使用的分子作为靶向NR2F2依赖性程序的治疗或再利用策略的起点。

papers.title: Multivalent cations stabilize DNA duplexes beyond charge neutralization.
papers.authors: Chen, Yun-Long; Zheng, Chen-Chen; Zhang, Yan; Tan, Zhi-Jie; Zhang, Xing-Hua
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过磁镊实验和全原子分子动力学模拟研究多价阳离子对DNA双链稳定性的影响，涉及DNA-离子互作机制，但非TF-DNA结合体系，方法包含MD模拟，对蛋白质-DNA互作建模有间接启发。
papers.abstract: Multivalent cations are abundant in cells and play essential roles in DNA duplex stability, genome packaging, and DNA-protein interactions. They can also condense DNA, making it challenging to determine their influence on DNA duplex stability. To overcome this challenge, we studied DNA unpeeling at equilibrium under high tension using magnetic tweezers, thereby preventing condensation. Experiments show that DNA duplex stability first increases and then decreases as cation concentration increases and the maximum DNA duplex stability increases with cation valence. The maximum free energy change of DNA was 3.33 k (B) T/bp for Na(+) and increased to 3.98 k (B) T/bp for protamine, which is a small arginine-rich protein with a highly positive charge ( approximately 21 for salmon sperm), corresponding to a relative increase of 19.5%. Consistently, all-atom molecular dynamics simulations show that higher-valent cations preferentially embed in the minor groove of DNA and clamp the minor groove, in contrast to the major-groove clamping reported for RNA, thereby stabilizing the helix more efficiently. These findings establish a single-molecule framework for quantifying DNA thermodynamics in complex ionic environments, which contributes to understanding ionic control of genome stability and to designing ion-tunable DNA-based nanostructures and delivery systems.
papers.abstract_zh: 多价阳离子在细胞中含量丰富，并在DNA双链稳定性、基因组包装及DNA-蛋白质相互作用中发挥关键作用。它们也能凝聚DNA，从而难以确定其对DNA双链稳定性的影响。为克服这一挑战，我们利用磁镊在高张力下研究DNA在平衡状态下的解链过程，从而避免凝聚。实验表明，随着阳离子浓度增加，DNA双链稳定性先升高后降低，且最大DNA双链稳定性随阳离子价态升高而增加。DNA的最大自由能变化对于Na(+)为3.33 k(B)T/bp，而对于鱼精蛋白（一种富含精氨酸的小蛋白，带高正电荷，鲑鱼精子中约为21）则增至3.98 k(B)T/bp，相对增加19.5%。一致地，全原子分子动力学 (all-atom molecular dynamics) 模拟显示，高价阳离子优先嵌入DNA的小沟并夹紧小沟，这与RNA中报道的大沟夹紧形成对比，从而更有效地稳定螺旋。这些发现建立了一个在复杂离子环境中量化DNA热力学的单分子框架，有助于理解离子对基因组稳定性的调控，并指导设计离子可调的DNA基纳米结构和递送系统。

papers.title: GSK3beta and Plk1 sequentially phosphorylate ATP-citrate lyase to promote homologous recombination.
papers.authors: Zhou, Shinan; Zhou, Xinyu; Chen, Qinfu; Yuan, Xueying; Zhu, Shukai; Huang, Jun; Wang, Fangwei; Yan, Haiyan
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究GSK3beta和Plk1磷酸化ACLY调控同源重组修复，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与课题无关。
papers.abstract: Accurate repair of DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs) by homologous recombination (HR) is essential for genome stability. Nuclear production of acetyl-coenzyme A (acetyl-CoA) by ATP-citrate lyase (ACLY) promotes HR, yet how ACLY is regulated during the DNA damage response (DDR) remains unclear. Here, we identify a phosphorylation-dependent signaling axis in which glycogen synthase kinase 3beta (GSK3beta) and Polo-like kinase 1 (Plk1) act sequentially on ACLY to facilitate HR-mediated repair of DSBs induced by ionizing radiation. Following AKT-dependent phosphorylation of ACLY at Ser(455), GSK3beta phosphorylates ACLY at Thr(447), generating a docking site for Plk1, which in turn phosphorylates ACLY at Ser(442). This phosphorylation cascade, enhanced by radiation, sustains histone acetylation, supports the accumulation of BRCA1 and RAD51 at DSBs, and confers cellular resistance to poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibition. Together, our findings define an AKT-GSK3beta-Plk1-ACLY signaling module that links the DDR to nuclear metabolism, revealing a critical mechanism by which kinase signaling facilitates acetyl-CoA-dependent chromatin remodeling to preserve genome integrity.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过同源重组（HR）精确修复DNA双链断裂（DSBs）对基因组稳定性至关重要。ATP-柠檬酸裂解酶（ACLY）在细胞核中产生的乙酰辅酶A（acetyl-CoA）可促进HR，然而在DNA损伤应答（DDR）过程中ACLY如何被调控仍不清楚。在此，我们鉴定了一个磷酸化依赖性信号轴，其中糖原合酶激酶3beta（GSK3beta）和Polo样激酶1（Plk1）依次作用于ACLY，以促进电离辐射诱导的DSBs的HR介导修复。在AKT依赖性磷酸化ACLY的Ser(455)位点后，GSK3beta磷酸化ACLY的Thr(447)位点，为Plk1生成一个对接位点，随后Plk1磷酸化ACLY的Ser(442)位点。这一受辐射增强的磷酸化级联反应维持了组蛋白乙酰化，支持BRCA1和RAD51在DSBs处的积累，并使细胞对聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶（PARP）抑制产生抗性。综上，我们的发现定义了一个AKT-GSK3beta-Plk1-ACLY信号模块，该模块将DDR与核代谢联系起来，揭示了激酶信号通过促进乙酰辅酶A依赖性染色质重塑以维持基因组完整性的关键机制。

papers.title: Balanced regulation of UvsX activity and thermostability based on active learning.
papers.authors: Li, Lingsong; Zhang, Lin; Li, Dongxiao; Zhang, Jiaxing; You, Shengping; Su, Rongxin; Qi, Wei
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过主动学习与蛋白语言模型工程化改造UvsX重组酶，结合分子动力学模拟研究其与DNA结合路径及ATP水解耦合机制，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但聚焦蛋白-DNA互作与动态机理，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
papers.abstract: Recombinase polymerase amplification (RPA) enables isothermal nucleic acid detection. However, the key enzyme UvsX of RPA exhibits suboptimal efficiency at low-temperature conditions and low template concentration. Here, we employed a directed engineering strategy combining energy-based screening and protein language models (PLMs). Through semi rational design and iterative optimization with EVOLVEpro, we obtained a triple mutant, TIG (S233T/A311I/A341G), which achieved 1.89-fold RPA relative activity of the wild-type (WT) at a template concentration of 1 x 10(5) copies reaction(-1), and showed higher amplification activity to WT across 37.5-44.3  degrees C at a template concentration of 1 x 10(4) copies reaction(-1). Molecular dynamics simulations revealed that TIG enhances residue flexibility and remodels the ATP-binding pocket, thereby improving DNA-binding pathway connectivity and strengthening the coupling between ATP hydrolysis and DNA strand exchange. Per-residue energy decomposition and protein structure network analyses further elucidate how key mutations modulate DNA-binding pathways. Finally, under optimized expression conditions (20  degrees C, 12 h, 0.1 mM IPTG), the yield reached 206.87 +/- 3.56 mg L(-1) of TIG. Collectively, this study provides a strategy for UvsX engineering and establishes a foundation for the development of more robust RPA assays.
papers.abstract_zh: 重组酶聚合酶扩增（recombinase polymerase amplification, RPA）可实现等温核酸检测。然而，RPA的关键酶UvsX在低温条件和低模板浓度下表现出次优效率。在此，我们采用了一种结合能量筛选和蛋白质语言模型（protein language models, PLMs）的定向工程策略。通过半理性设计和基于EVOLVEpro的迭代优化，我们获得了一个三重突变体TIG（S233T/A311I/A341G），其在模板浓度为1 x 10(5) copies reaction(-1)时，RPA相对活性达到野生型（wild-type, WT）的1.89倍，并且在模板浓度为1 x 10(4) copies reaction(-1)时，在37.5-44.3摄氏度范围内表现出比WT更高的扩增活性。分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟揭示，TIG增强了残基灵活性并重塑了ATP结合口袋，从而改善了DNA结合通路连接性，并加强了ATP水解与DNA链交换之间的耦合。每个残基的能量分解和蛋白质结构网络分析进一步阐明了关键突变如何调控DNA结合通路。最后，在优化表达条件（20摄氏度，12小时，0.1 mM IPTG）下，TIG的产量达到206.87 +/- 3.56 mg L(-1)。总体而言，本研究为UvsX工程化提供了一种策略，并为开发更稳健的RPA检测方法奠定了基础。

papers.title: Xiaobanxia decoction, a compound Chinese herbal medicine, attenuates chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting via restoring AMPK/TFEB-mediated BNIP3/NIX mitophagy.
papers.authors: Feng, Lei; Zhai, Ya-Rong; Liang, Wan; Kan, Shao-Jun; Nie, Ke
papers.one_liner_zh: 研究中药复方通过AMPK/TFEB通路调控线粒体自噬缓解化疗呕吐，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，且方法以实验为主，无AI/物理模拟建模。
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Xiaobanxia decoction (XBXD), a classical Chinese antiemetic formula, has potential benefits for treating chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting (CINV). The present study investigates its antiemetic effect and explores the possible mechanisms. METHODS: Network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to predict potential therapeutic targets and pathways. The efficacy and mechanism of XBXD were evaluated using a cisplatin-induced rat pica model and an intestinal epithelial cell line-6 (IEC-6) cell injury model. Antiemetic effects were assessed by measuring kaolin intake, food consumption, and body weight. Gastric antrum and ileum pathological changes were examined by hematoxylin and eosin staining. Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays were used to assess tissue levels of interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta), interleukin-18 (IL-18), and reactive oxygen species (ROS). Mitochondrial injury and mitochondrial ROS were evaluated using transmission electron microscopy and fluorescence microscopy. Mitophagy and adenosine monophosphate-activated protein kinase (AMPK)/transcription factor EB (TFEB) pathway activation were assessed using Western blotting and immunofluorescence. RESULTS: Compared with the model group, XBXD significantly reduced kaolin consumption, alleviated gastric antrum and ileum pathological damage, and decreased IL-1beta, IL-18 and ROS levels in both gastric antrum and ileum tissues. XBXD also improved mitochondrial ultrastructural morphology, reduced mitochondrial ROS, and restored mitochondrial membrane potential in vivo and in vitro. Furthermore, XBXD increased the microtubule-associated protein 1 light chain 3-II/-I (LC3-II/LC3-I) ratio, reduced sequestosome-1 (p62) accumulation, and upregulated BCL2/adenovirus E1B 19 kDa interacting protein 3 (BNIP3) and Nip3-like protein X (NIX) expression, indicating restoration of mitophagy. Mechanistically, the AMPK/TFEB signaling pathway was triggered by the XBXD treatment. CONCLUSION: XBXD ameliorates CINV in association with activation of the AMPK/TFEB pathway and the restoration of BNIP3/NIX-mediated mitophagy. Please cite this article as: Feng L, Zhai YR, Liang W, Kan SJ, Nie K. Xiaobanxia decoction, a compound Chinese herbal medicine, attenuates chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting via restoring AMPK/TFEB-mediated BNIP3/NIX mitophagy. J Integr Med. 2026; Epub ahead of print.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：小半夏汤（XBXD）是一种经典的中医止吐方剂，对治疗化疗引起的恶心呕吐（CINV）具有潜在益处。本研究探讨其止吐作用并探索可能的机制。方法：采用网络药理学和分子对接预测潜在的治疗靶点和通路。通过顺铂诱导的大鼠异食癖模型和肠上皮细胞系-6（IEC-6）细胞损伤模型评估XBXD的疗效和机制。通过测量高岭土摄入量、食物消耗量和体重来评估止吐效果。采用苏木精-伊红染色检查胃窦和回肠的病理变化。使用酶联免疫吸附试验评估组织中白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）、白细胞介素-18（IL-18）和活性氧（ROS）的水平。使用透射电子显微镜和荧光显微镜评估线粒体损伤和线粒体ROS。使用Western blotting和免疫荧光评估线粒体自噬和腺苷酸活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）/转录因子EB（TFEB）通路的激活。结果：与模型组相比，XBXD显著减少高岭土消耗，减轻胃窦和回肠的病理损伤，并降低胃窦和回肠组织中IL-1β、IL-18和ROS的水平。XBXD还改善了线粒体超微结构形态，减少了线粒体ROS，并在体内和体外恢复了线粒体膜电位。此外，XBXD增加了微管相关蛋白1轻链3-II/-I（LC3-II/LC3-I）的比值，减少了sequestosome-1（p62）的积累，并上调了BCL2/腺病毒E1B 19 kDa相互作用蛋白3（BNIP3）和Nip3样蛋白X（NIX）的表达，表明线粒体自噬得到恢复。机制上，XBXD处理触发了AMPK/TFEB信号通路。结论：XBXD通过激活AMPK/TFEB通路和恢复BNIP3/NIX介导的线粒体自噬来改善CINV。请引用本文为：Feng L, Zhai YR, Liang W, Kan SJ, Nie K. Xiaobanxia decoction, a compound Chinese herbal medicine, attenuates chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting via restoring AMPK/TFEB-mediated BNIP3/NIX mitophagy. J Integr Med. 2026; Epub ahead of print.

papers.title: A Unified Structure-based Deep Learning Framework for High-Throughput Screening of Protein-Binding RNAs
papers.authors: Yihao Zhao; Jing Han; Jike Wang; Jianfeng Chu; Yu Kang; Tingjun Hou
papers.one_liner_zh: 提出统一结构深度学习框架PRIS，结合图注意力网络与距离预测，用于高通量筛选蛋白结合RNA，虽聚焦蛋白-RNA互作而非TF-DNA，但其结构建模与结合偏好预测方法对TF-DNA互作研究具有直接借鉴意义。
papers.abstract: Protein-RNA interactions regulate diverse biological processes and are increasingly exploited in therapeutic RNA discovery, but accurate inferences of nucleotide preferences and reliable structure prediction remain challenging. Here, we present PRIS, a unified structure-based deep-learning framework that combines two complementary components: PRISeq for nucleotide probability estimation at each RNA position and PRIScore for residue-nucleotide distance prediction to discriminate native-like from incorrect poses. Both share a feature extractor that integrates an Anti-Symmetric Graph Attention Network (A-GAT) with sparse k-Maximum Inner Product (k-MPI) attention to capture long-range interactions across large graphs. PRIScore improves the selection of native-like protein-RNA predictions generated by AlphaFold3, achieving a top-1 success rate of 81.91% on a docking benchmark, compared to 79.26% for AlphaFold3. The selected structures are then fed into PRISeq, which infers position-specific binding preferences and screens RNA libraries. On a PWM benchmark, PRISeq achieved a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.75, outperforming FoldX, Rosetta-based scoring functions, and NA-MPNN. In virtual screening against MS2 protein, PRISeq screens 129,248 RNA hairpins within 11.95 seconds, achieving the highest EF 0.5% of 14.40, approximately double the best baseline. PRIS also effectively enriches active aptamers against NELF-E and GFP while preserving sequence diversity. By integrating structure selection with binding-preference inference, PRIS provides an efficient framework for large-scale RNA library screening and aptamer design.
papers.abstract_zh: 蛋白质-RNA相互作用调控多种生物过程，并越来越多地被用于治疗性RNA发现，但核苷酸偏好的准确推断和可靠的结构预测仍具挑战。在此，我们提出PRIS，一个统一的基于结构的深度学习框架，它结合了两个互补组件：用于在每个RNA位置进行核苷酸概率估计的PRISeq，以及用于预测残基-核苷酸距离以区分类天然构象与错误构象的PRIScore。两者共享一个特征提取器，该提取器将反对称图注意力网络（A-GAT）与稀疏k-最大内积（k-MPI）注意力相结合，以捕捉大图上的长程相互作用。PRIScore改进了由AlphaFold3生成的类天然蛋白质-RNA预测的选择，在对接基准测试中实现了81.91%的top-1成功率，而AlphaFold3为79.26%。所选结构随后被输入PRISeq，后者推断位置特异性结合偏好并筛选RNA文库。在PWM基准测试中，PRISeq实现了0.75的平均绝对误差（MAE），优于FoldX、基于Rosetta的评分函数和NA-MPNN。在对MS2蛋白的虚拟筛选中，PRISeq在11.95秒内筛选了129,248个RNA发夹，实现了最高的EF 0.5%为14.40，约为最佳基线的两倍。PRIS还能有效富集针对NELF-E和GFP的活性适配体，同时保持序列多样性。通过将结构选择与结合偏好推断相结合，PRIS为大规模RNA文库筛选和适配体设计提供了一个高效框架。

papers.title: Explainable ML force-field for evaluating protein–ligand binding energy using SO3LR
papers.authors: Hamza Agha; Sergio Suárez-Dou; Adil Kabylda; Alexandre Tkatchenko; Andrea Volkamer
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于SO3LR等变消息传递网络的机器学习力场评分函数SO3LR-SF，用于蛋白-配体结合能评估，虽非TF-DNA体系，但其物理建模与可解释性框架可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作研究。
papers.abstract: Accurate estimation of protein–ligand binding affinities remains central to structure-based drug design. Classical force fields neglect important quantum-mechanical effects, while quantum mechanical and semi-empirical methods remain impractical for large biomolecular systems. Machine-learned force fields (MLFFs) offer an alternative, but their performance may be inflated by training on protein–ligand complexes. Here, we introduce SO3LR-SF, a physics-based scoring function built on the pretrained SO3LR MLFF, combining an equivariant message-passing network for semi-local interactions with physically motivated terms for short-range repulsion, electrostatics, and long-range dispersion. Built on an MLFF that was not trained on protein–ligand complexes, SO3LR-SF provides a stringent test of transferability. On PLA15 (15 active-site models), SO3LR-SF attains a relative interaction error of 5.8% against DLPNO-CCSD(T) references, the lowest of all tested methods. On the FEP benchmark (8 targets, 264 ligands), SO3LR-SF achieves an average Spearman correlation of 0.51, on par with the best semi-empirical quantum-mechanical method tested (0.47, GFN-FF) and with MMGBSA (0.44), and surpassing Glide (0.27). On the Wang dataset (8 targets, 199 ligands), it reaches 0.51, approaching the 0.60 average of molecular dynamics-based free-energy methods at a fraction of their cost. Each complex is scored in 1–10 seconds on 12 CPU cores, an 80- to 300-fold speedup over comparable MLFFs. An 8 Å trimming protocol reduces runtime threefold without loss of accuracy, and a restrained geometry optimization recovers ranking accuracy for targets with strained input structures. A multi-level explainability framework adds energy decomposition, per-atom energy contributions reported either for ligand or as 2D protein–ligand interaction maps, and 3D binding site visualization. We identified two pocket descriptors that flag applicability before scoring, e.g. polar solvent accessible surface area (SASA) ratio correlating strongly (r = 0.81) with performance. Together, SO3LR-SF presents a fast, interpretable, and competitive scoring function for drug discovery that requires no domain-specific training data.
papers.abstract_zh: 准确估算蛋白质-配体结合亲和力仍是基于结构的药物设计的核心问题。经典力场忽略了重要的量子力学效应，而量子力学和半经验方法对于大型生物分子体系仍不实用。机器学习力场（MLFFs）提供了一种替代方案，但其性能可能因在蛋白质-配体复合物上训练而被高估。在此，我们提出SO3LR-SF，一种基于预训练SO3LR MLFF的物理评分函数，它将用于半局域相互作用的等变消息传递网络与短程排斥、静电和长程色散等物理动机项相结合。SO3LR-SF构建于未在蛋白质-配体复合物上训练的MLFF之上，提供了对可迁移性的严格测试。在PLA15（15个活性位点模型）上，SO3LR-SF相对于DLPNO-CCSD(T)参考值达到了5.8%的相对相互作用误差，是所有测试方法中最低的。在FEP基准测试（8个靶点，264个配体）上，SO3LR-SF实现了0.51的平均Spearman相关系数，与测试中最佳半经验量子力学方法（0.47，GFN-FF）和MMGBSA（0.44）相当，并优于Glide（0.27）。在Wang数据集（8个靶点，199个配体）上，它达到了0.51，接近基于分子动力学的自由能方法0.60的平均值，而成本仅为后者的极小部分。每个复合物在12个CPU核心上评分需1–10秒，比同类MLFFs快80至300倍。一个8 Å的修剪方案在不损失精度的情况下将运行时间减少三倍，而受约束的几何优化可恢复具有扭曲输入结构的靶点的排序准确性。一个多层级可解释性框架增加了能量分解、以配体或2D蛋白质-配体相互作用图形式报告的每原子能量贡献，以及3D结合位点可视化。我们识别出两个口袋描述符，可在评分前标记适用性，例如极性溶剂可及表面积（SASA）比率与性能强相关（r = 0.81）。总之，SO3LR-SF为药物发现提供了一种快速、可解释且具有竞争力的评分函数，且无需领域特定的训练数据。

papers.title: Integrated network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental validation to reveal the potential mechanism of Ginsenoside Rg1 on chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
papers.authors: Li, Xinpeng; Xiang, Dandan; Hu, Lingling; Lin, Lingdan; Wang, Guoqiang; Xu, Jing
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文利用网络药理学、分子对接和实验验证研究人参皂苷Rg1对COPD的作用机制，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未聚焦转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联度低。
papers.abstract: Ginsenoside Rg1 (GS Rg1), a natural flavonoid exhibiting anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, holds significant potential for treatment chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Nevertheless, the precise mechanisms underlying its therapeutic effects remain to be fully elucidated. This study aimed to explore the role and potential mechanism of GS Rg1 in the treatment of COPD using network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental validation.Targets related to GS Rg1 and COPD were screened from public databases, and the potential common targets were then imported into the STRING database to construct a protein-protein interaction (PPI) network. Gene ontology (GO) and Kyoto encyclopedia of genes and genomes (KEGG) enrichment analysis were performed to identify key signaling pathways. Molecular docking was employed to predict the binding interactions between GS Rg1 and core targets. A BEAS-2B cell model induced by lipopolysaccharide(LPS) and cigarette smoke extract(CSE) was used to explore the protective mechanisms of GS Rg1. Western blot analysis was conducted to validate the critical targets and pathways involved in the anti-COPD effects of GS Rg1. Network pharmacology analysis revealed 105 common targets between GS Rg1 and COPD. The EGFR/PI3K/AKT and EGFR/STAT3 signaling pathways were selected for further validation. GS Rg1 was demonstrated to effectively inhibit inflammation and mucus hypersecretion in vitro models of COPD. Western blot results showed that GS Rg1 treatment significantly downregulated the expression of proteins involved in the EGFR/PI3K/AKT and EGFR/STAT3 signaling pathway, consistent with the network pharmacology findings. CSE/LPS exposure induces inflammation and oxidative stress in COPD by disrupting the EGFR/PI3K/AKT and EGFR/STAT3 signaling pathways, and GS Rg1 significantly alleviates these effects, which may be partially through regulating the EGFR/PI3K/AKT and EGFR/STAT3 signaling pathway.
papers.abstract_zh: 人参皂苷Rg1 (GS Rg1)是一种具有抗炎和抗氧化特性的天然黄酮类化合物，在治疗慢性阻塞性肺疾病 (COPD) 方面具有显著潜力。然而，其治疗作用的确切机制仍有待完全阐明。本研究旨在通过网络药理学、分子对接 (molecular docking) 和实验验证，探讨GS Rg1在治疗COPD中的作用及潜在机制。从公共数据库中筛选出与GS Rg1和COPD相关的靶点，然后将潜在共同靶点导入STRING数据库，构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用 (PPI) 网络。进行基因本体论 (GO) 和京都基因与基因组百科全书 (KEGG) 富集分析，以识别关键信号通路。采用分子对接预测GS Rg1与核心靶点之间的结合相互作用。利用脂多糖 (LPS) 和香烟烟雾提取物 (CSE) 诱导的BEAS-2B细胞模型，探索GS Rg1的保护机制。通过Western blot分析验证GS Rg1抗COPD作用中涉及的关键靶点和通路。网络药理学分析显示，GS Rg1与COPD之间存在105个共同靶点。选择EGFR/PI3K/AKT和EGFR/STAT3信号通路进行进一步验证。GS Rg1被证明能有效抑制COPD体外模型中的炎症和黏液高分泌。Western blot结果显示，GS Rg1处理显著下调了EGFR/PI3K/AKT和EGFR/STAT3信号通路中相关蛋白的表达，这与网络药理学结果一致。CSE/LPS暴露通过破坏EGFR/PI3K/AKT和EGFR/STAT3信号通路诱导COPD中的炎症和氧化应激，而GS Rg1显著缓解这些效应，这可能部分通过调节EGFR/PI3K/AKT和EGFR/STAT3信号通路实现。

papers.title: Interpretable prediction of nucleic acid-binding proteins using a protein language model.
papers.authors: Kim, Hanjin; Lee, Sung-Gwon; Oh, Jooseong; Kim, Kee K; Kim, Eun-Mi; Park, Chungoo
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用ESM-2蛋白语言模型预测DNA/RNA结合蛋白，虽聚焦蛋白-核酸互作识别，但仅做序列级分类，未涉及TF-DNA结合位点或三维互作机制建模，方法可迁移但深度有限。
papers.abstract: MOTIVATION: Accurate identification of DNA-binding proteins (DBPs) and RNA-binding proteins (RBPs) is critical for elucidating transcriptional and post-transcriptional regulatory mechanisms. However, existing computational approaches often rely on inferred labels or domain-specific annotations, which limit the subsequent generalizability. RESULTS: This study aimed to introduce transformer-based classifiers for human DBPs and RBPs that rely solely on protein sequence information without engineered features or domain constraints. The models were implemented using ESM-2 with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning and trained on experimentally validated datasets, including chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing (ChIP-seq) annotations for DBPs and eCLIP annotations for RBPs. Next, to evaluate biological relevance, we computed value-aware attention (VAT) scores aggregated across transformer layers to interpret model focus. In 20-fold cross-validation, the DBP model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.84 with a Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) of 0.40, while the RBP model achieved an AUROC of 0.92 with an MCC of 0.46. Proteins predicted as nucleic acid-binding were enriched for known binding domains, and inspection of attention distributions revealed preferential focus on annotated functional regions rather than non-binding segments. These results demonstrate that attention-based protein language models can accurately identify nucleic acid-binding proteins directly from sequence data. Moreover, these models reveal biologically meaningful sequence determinants of binding, establishing an interpretable and scalable framework for proteome-wide characterization of protein-nucleic acid interactions. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Code is available on GitHub (https://github.com/CSB-hub/DRBP).
papers.abstract_zh: 动机：准确识别DNA结合蛋白（DBPs）和RNA结合蛋白（RBPs）对于阐明转录和转录后调控机制至关重要。然而，现有计算方法通常依赖推断标签或领域特异性注释，这限制了后续的泛化能力。结果：本研究旨在引入基于transformer的分类器，用于人类DBPs和RBPs，这些分类器仅依赖蛋白质序列信息，无需工程化特征或领域约束。模型使用ESM-2结合低秩适应（LoRA）微调实现，并在实验验证的数据集上训练，包括用于DBPs的染色质免疫沉淀测序（ChIP-seq）注释和用于RBPs的eCLIP注释。接下来，为评估生物学相关性，我们计算了跨transformer层聚合的值感知注意力（VAT）分数，以解释模型关注点。在20折交叉验证中，DBP模型实现了0.84的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）和0.40的马修斯相关系数（MCC），而RBP模型实现了0.92的AUROC和0.46的MCC。被预测为核酸结合的蛋白质富集了已知结合结构域，注意力分布检查显示，模型优先关注注释的功能区域而非非结合片段。这些结果表明，基于注意力的蛋白质语言模型能够直接从序列数据中准确识别核酸结合蛋白。此外，这些模型揭示了具有生物学意义的结合序列决定因素，为蛋白质-核酸相互作用的蛋白质组范围表征建立了一个可解释且可扩展的框架。可用性与实现：代码可在GitHub上获取（https://github.com/CSB-hub/DRBP）。

papers.title: Integrative Transcriptomic Analysis and Functional Validation Implicate GPT2 in Glycolytic Regulation in Polycystic Ovary Syndrome.
papers.authors: Xi, Meili; Luo, Rongkui; Zhang, Jiarong; Huang, Weihong; Ma, Li; Sun, Yunyan; Ren, Aimin
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究通过转录组整合与机器学习分析PCOS中糖酵解相关基因，虽涉及转录因子调控网络但核心为代谢表型与GPT2功能验证，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模与AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
papers.abstract: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a heterogeneous endocrine-metabolic disorder characterized by profound disturbances in energy metabolism, yet the molecular mechanisms underlying glycolytic dysfunction remain incompletely understood. Given the essential role of glycolysis in ovarian function and endocrine homeostasis, this study aimed to systematically characterize glycolysis-associated molecular alterations in PCOS and identify key metabolic regulators involved in disease pathogenesis. Transcriptomic datasets GSE34526 and GSE6798 were integrated to identify glycolysis-related differentially expressed genes (GRDEGs). Functional enrichment, immune infiltration, and regulatory network analyzes were performed to characterize the biological features associated with glycolytic dysregulation. Machine learning algorithms, including support vector machine, random forest, logistic regression, and LASSO regression, were applied to prioritize key glycolysis-associated regulators for downstream biological characterization. The functional role of GPT2 was further examined in KGN granulosa cells under PCOS-like conditions. Twelve GRDEGs were consistently dysregulated in PCOS and were predominantly enriched in glycolytic metabolism, ATP generation, and transcriptional regulatory processes. Integrative machine learning analyzes prioritized four key glycolysis-related genes (AMPD3, C5AR1, MLXIPL, and PDLIM7) associated with glycolytic remodeling in PCOS. Immune infiltration analyzes further revealed coordinated metabolic and immune remodeling, while regulatory network analyzes highlighted extensive interactions between hub genes and miRNA-, transcription factor-, and RNA-binding protein-mediated regulatory networks. Functional experiments demonstrated that GPT2 knockdown impaired glycolytic activity, reduced ATP production and aromatase activity, disrupted steroid hormone homeostasis, and exacerbated metabolic dysfunction in granulosa cells, whereas pharmacological activation of glycolysis partially reversed these alterations. Our findings provide a comprehensive characterization of glycolytic dysregulation in PCOS and identify GPT2 as a potential metabolic regulator linking altered energy metabolism to ovarian dysfunction. These findings provide a molecular framework for future studies investigating metabolism- and nutrition-based intervention strategies in PCOS.
papers.abstract_zh: 多囊卵巢综合征（PCOS）是一种以能量代谢严重紊乱为特征的异质性内分泌代谢疾病，然而糖酵解功能障碍的分子机制仍不完全清楚。鉴于糖酵解在卵巢功能和内分泌稳态中的关键作用，本研究旨在系统表征PCOS中糖酵解相关的分子改变，并识别参与疾病发病机制的关键代谢调控因子。整合转录组数据集GSE34526和GSE6798，以鉴定糖酵解相关差异表达基因（GRDEGs）。进行功能富集、免疫浸润和调控网络分析，以表征与糖酵解失调相关的生物学特征。应用机器学习算法，包括支持向量机、随机森林、逻辑回归和LASSO回归，以优先筛选关键糖酵解相关调控因子用于下游生物学表征。进一步在PCOS样条件下的KGN颗粒细胞中检测GPT2的功能作用。在PCOS中，12个GRDEGs持续失调，且主要富集于糖酵解代谢、ATP生成和转录调控过程。整合机器学习分析优先筛选出四个与PCOS中糖酵解重塑相关的关键糖酵解相关基因（AMPD3、C5AR1、MLXIPL和PDLIM7）。免疫浸润分析进一步揭示了代谢与免疫重塑的协同作用，而调控网络分析则强调了核心基因与miRNA、转录因子和RNA结合蛋白介导的调控网络之间的广泛相互作用。功能实验表明，GPT2敲低损害了糖酵解活性，降低了ATP生成和芳香化酶活性，破坏了类固醇激素稳态，并加剧了颗粒细胞的代谢功能障碍，而糖酵解的药理学激活则部分逆转了这些改变。我们的研究结果提供了PCOS中糖酵解失调的全面表征，并确定GPT2为连接能量代谢改变与卵巢功能障碍的潜在代谢调控因子。这些发现为未来研究PCOS中基于代谢和营养的干预策略提供了分子框架。

papers.title: Transcriptome Analysis and Experimental Validation of Palmitoylation- Related Biomarkers in Atherosclerosis.
papers.authors: Song, Zhijian; Ma, Yirong; Liu, Yanhong; Lai, Junyu; Sun, Liqiang; Li, Qiming; Fan, Yaguo; Huang, Yingying; Ding, Doukun; Wu, Jianguang
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过转录组分析鉴定动脉粥样硬化中棕榈酰化相关生物标志物，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Protein palmitoylation contributes to membrane localisation, signal transduction, and cell-fate regulation. It is closely associated with lipid metabolic dysfunction, immune inflammation, and vascular remodelling in atherosclerosis (AS). However, key palmitoylation-related transcriptomic markers and their potential causal associations with AS remain incompletely defined. METHODS: The Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) dataset GSE100927 was used as the training cohort, and GSE43292 was used as an external validation cohort. Differentially expressed genes were identified using limma and intersected with palmitoylation-related genes to obtain palmitoylation-related differentially expressed genes (PRDEGs). Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analyses were then performed using clusterProfiler. Two-sample Mendelian randomisation was used to evaluate potential causal relationships between characteristic genes and AS. Feature selection was conducted using random forest and support vector machine recursive feature elimination (SVM-RFE), and the overlapping genes selected by both methods were retained. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves were used to assess diagnostic performance. A five-gene nomogram was constructed, and its clinical utility was evaluated using calibration curves and decision curve analysis (DCA). Gene set variation analysis (GSVA) was applied to compare pathway activity between high- and low-expression groups for each core gene. Single-cell analysis using Seurat and expression-based cell-cell communication analysis using CellChat were conducted with GSE159677, and upstream transcription factors were predicted using NetworkAnalyst. For in vivo validation, an AS model was established in ApoE(8)/(8) mice fed a high-fat diet, and aortic gene and protein expression were assessed by RT-qPCR and western blotting. RESULTS: In GSE100927, 51 PRDEGs were identified. GO and KEGG enrichment analyses highlighted pathways associated with regulation of monoatomic ion transport, sarcomere and myofibril organisation, and immune inflammation. Mendelian randomisation suggested a potential protective causal association between SLC7A7 and AS. By integrating MR with random forest and SVM-RFE feature selection, we prioritised five core genes: PLCB2, GMIP, NEXN, PLN, and SLC7A7. These genes showed good diagnostic performance in GSE43292. The resulting nomogram was well calibrated and demonstrated stable net benefit in decision curve and clinical impact curve analyses. Single-gene GSVA identified consistently activated pathways across multiple genes, including innate and adaptive immune recognition, calcium signalling and myocardial contraction/cardiomyopathy, extracellular matrix-receptor interaction, cell junction pathways, autophagy-lysosome pathways, and several metabolic programmes. At the single-cell level, PLCB2 and GMIP were predominantly expressed in T cells and macrophages, NEXN and PLN were enriched in vascular smooth muscle cells, and SLC7A7 was mainly expressed in macrophages. CellChat analysis indicated increased signals for immune-related ligand-receptor interactions. In ApoE(8)/(8) mice fed a high-fat diet, PLCB2, GMIP, and SLC7A7 were upregulated, whereas NEXN and PLN were downregulated; protein-level changes were concordant with the transcriptomic trends. DISCUSSION: These findings indicate that palmitoylation-related dysregulation in AS converges on immune inflammation, calcium signalling/contractile programmes, ECM remodelling, and autophagy-linked metabolism. The five-gene panel is supported by external validation, single-cell localisation to immune and vascular compartments, and concordant results in ApoE(8)/(8) mice. CONCLUSION: This study identified and validated five palmitoylation-related genes associated with AS. SLC7A7 showed a potential protective causal signal in MR analysis. The enriched pathway patterns linked these genes to immune inflammation, calcium signalling-contraction coupling, ECM remodelling, cell adhesion, and autophagy- associated metabolic reprogramming. The five-gene nomogram showed potential utility for diagnostic classification and decision support, nominating candidate biomarkers and pathway targets for AS molecular subtyping, diagnosis, and mechanistic investigation.
