papers.abstract_zh: 引言：蛋白质棕榈酰化参与膜定位、信号转导和细胞命运调控，并与动脉粥样硬化（AS）中的脂质代谢功能障碍、免疫炎症和血管重塑密切相关。然而，关键的棕榈酰化相关转录组标志物及其与AS的潜在因果关联仍未完全明确。方法：采用Gene Expression Omnibus（GEO）数据集GSE100927作为训练队列，GSE43292作为外部验证队列。使用limma识别差异表达基因，并与棕榈酰化相关基因取交集，获得棕榈酰化相关差异表达基因（PRDEGs）。随后使用clusterProfiler进行Gene Ontology（GO）和Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes（KEGG）富集分析。采用两样本孟德尔随机化评估特征基因与AS之间的潜在因果关联。使用随机森林和支持向量机递归特征消除（SVM-RFE）进行特征选择，并保留两种方法选出的重叠基因。使用受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线评估诊断性能。构建五基因列线图，并使用校准曲线和决策曲线分析（DCA）评估其临床效用。应用基因集变异分析（GSVA）比较每个核心基因高、低表达组之间的通路活性。使用Seurat进行单细胞分析，使用CellChat进行基于表达量的细胞间通讯分析，数据来自GSE159677，并使用NetworkAnalyst预测上游转录因子。体内验证方面，在高脂饮食喂养的ApoE(8)/(8)小鼠中建立AS模型，并通过RT-qPCR和western blotting评估主动脉基因和蛋白表达。结果：在GSE100927中，鉴定出51个PRDEGs。GO和KEGG富集分析突出了与单原子离子转运调控、肌节和肌原纤维组织以及免疫炎症相关的通路。孟德尔随机化提示SLC7A7与AS之间存在潜在的保护性因果关联。通过整合MR与随机森林和SVM-RFE特征选择，我们优先确定了五个核心基因：PLCB2、GMIP、NEXN、PLN和SLC7A7。这些基因在GSE43292中表现出良好的诊断性能。所构建的列线图校准良好，并在决策曲线和临床影响曲线分析中显示出稳定的净获益。单基因GSVA识别出多个基因中一致激活的通路，包括先天性和适应性免疫识别、钙信号传导和心肌收缩/心肌病、细胞外基质-受体相互作用、细胞连接通路、自噬-溶酶体通路以及若干代谢程序。在单细胞水平上，PLCB2和GMIP主要在T细胞和巨噬细胞中表达，NEXN和PLN富集于血管平滑肌细胞，SLC7A7主要在巨噬细胞中表达。CellChat分析显示免疫相关配体-受体相互作用的信号增强。在高脂饮食喂养的ApoE(8)/(8)小鼠中，PLCB2、GMIP和SLC7A7上调，而NEXN和PLN下调；蛋白水平变化与转录组趋势一致。讨论：这些发现表明，AS中棕榈酰化相关失调汇聚于免疫炎症、钙信号传导/收缩程序、ECM重塑和自噬相关代谢。五基因组合得到外部验证、单细胞在免疫和血管区室的定位以及ApoE(8)/(8)小鼠中一致结果的支持。结论：本研究鉴定并验证了五个与AS相关的棕榈酰化相关基因。SLC7A7在MR分析中显示出潜在的保护性因果信号。富集的通路模式将这些基因与免疫炎症、钙信号传导-收缩偶联、ECM重塑、细胞粘附和自噬相关代谢重编程联系起来。五基因列线图显示出在诊断分类和决策支持方面的潜在效用，为AS分子分型、诊断和机制研究提名了候选生物标志物和通路靶点。

papers.title: Loss of SUMOylation drives aberrant PRC1 clustering and 3D genome rewiring independent of H3K27me3.
papers.authors: Akilli, Nazli; Puel, Paul-Swann; Stefano, Marco Di; Muzzopappa, Fernando; Fritsch, Lauriane; Erdel, Fabian; Jost, Daniel; Cheutin, Thierry; Cavalli, Giacomo
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究SUMO化修饰对PRC1凝聚体及3D基因组结构的影响，涉及蛋白质凝聚体建模，但核心体系为PRC1与染色质而非TF-DNA特异性结合，且方法以实验和生物物理建模为主，缺乏AI/深度学习或分子动力学模拟等本课题核心方法。
papers.abstract: Polycomb repressive complex 1 (PRC1) forms nuclear condensates that organize target chromatin domains. SUMOylation modulates PRC1 clustering, but its impact on condensate properties and 3D genome architecture remains unclear. Here, we show that depletion of small ubiquitin-like modifier (SUMO) in Drosophila wing imaginal discs transforms PRC1 condensates into large structures with reduced molecular dynamics. Biophysical modeling suggests that the changes in PRC1 self-interactions are responsible for the formation of large PRC1 condensates when SUMO is depleted. Interestingly, this biophysical reorganization occurs without global loss of the H3K27me3 mark. Instead, Hi-C reveals widespread rewiring of topologically associating domain (TAD) interactions. PRC1-bound TADs lose specific long-range contacts with each other while gaining ectopic interactions with active chromatin. These topological shifts correlate with gene misregulation independently of changes in Polycomb histone modifications. Our results establish SUMOylation as a critical regulator of PRC1 condensates, demonstrating that post-translational control of biomolecular condensation modulates 3D genome architecture and transcriptional output through mechanisms separable from histone mark deposition.
papers.abstract_zh: Polycomb repressive complex 1 (PRC1) 形成核凝聚体，组织靶染色质结构域。SUMOylation 调节 PRC1 的聚集，但其对凝聚体性质和 3D 基因组结构的影响仍不清楚。在此，我们展示在果蝇翅成虫盘中，小泛素样修饰因子 (SUMO) 的缺失将 PRC1 凝聚体转变为具有降低分子动力学的大结构。生物物理模型表明，当 SUMO 缺失时，PRC1 自相互作用的改变是形成大 PRC1 凝聚体的原因。有趣的是，这种生物物理重组发生在 H3K27me3 标记未全局丢失的情况下。相反，Hi-C 揭示了拓扑关联结构域 (TAD) 相互作用的广泛重连。PRC1 结合的 TAD 彼此失去特定的长程接触，同时获得与活跃染色质的异位相互作用。这些拓扑变化与基因失调相关，且独立于 Polycomb 组蛋白修饰的变化。我们的结果确立了 SUMOylation 作为 PRC1 凝聚体的关键调节因子，证明通过可分离于组蛋白标记沉积的机制，生物分子凝聚的翻译后控制调节 3D 基因组结构和转录输出。

papers.title: Regulatory Network Unveils the Molecular Architecture Governing Seed Vigor in Watermelon (Citrullus lanatus).
papers.authors: Wu, Xinyi; Cheng, Mengxue; Li, Xuyang; Zhang, Chunyu; Zhou, Yingying; Bai, Bing
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过多组学整合和机器学习构建西瓜种子活力调控网络，涉及转录因子DOF/ERF与DNA的cis-element互作及分子对接验证，但核心是种子生物学而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法上AI应用较浅，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作但非聚焦TF-DNA结合机制。
papers.abstract: Seed vigor, a determinant of agricultural productivity, diminishes during ageing but can be restored through priming. We integrated multi-omics approaches to dissect molecular mechanisms governing watermelon seed vigor under controlled deterioration and priming. Controlled deterioration (CD) progressively impaired germination speed (t50) and uniformity (AUC) before reducing maximum germination (Gmax), whereas priming reversed these effects even under ageing conditions. Transcriptome analyses revealed that ageing upregulated oxidative-stress genes (e.g., cytochrome c oxidase) and suppressed translation machinery. Priming activated stress-response pathways and ribosomal proteins through DOF/ERF-mediated transcriptional reprogramming via cis-element recognition, and molecular docking and yeast one-hybrid assays confirmed this interaction. Two biomarkers, Cla97C04G070560 (cytochrome c oxidase) and Cla97C03G062270 (ribosomal protein), were identified as quantitative predictors of germination decline. Machine-learning-based proteomic models and a regulatory network, SeedWatermelonNet (SWN), were constructed. These analyses uncovered hub genes (e.g., OHCU_decarbox, HSPs, LIM, NADPH-dependent aldehyde reductase 1, RPL32) coordinating uric acid metabolism, stress responses, energy metabolism, and translation. Experimental validation confirmed the regulatory roles of these candidates, including physical interactions mediating seed-vigor transduction cascades and their predicted function as direct regulators of seed vigor via SWN. Maternal alleles dominated transcriptional regulation of stored mRNAs, with ageing reducing maternal-specific gene expression. Promoter SNPs in these genes implicated BPC and DOF transcription factors in maternal bias. These findings establish molecular thresholds for vigor loss, validate priming as a resilience strategy, and provide biomarkers for seed quality assessment. Integrating transcriptomic, proteomic, and allele-specific insights advances precision breeding and storage practices, offering targets to enhance seed resilience against climate-driven agricultural challenges.
papers.abstract_zh: 种子活力是农业生产力的决定因素，在老化过程中会下降，但可通过引发处理得以恢复。我们整合了多组学方法，以解析控制西瓜种子在受控劣变和引发条件下活力的分子机制。受控劣变（CD）在降低最大发芽率（Gmax）之前，逐步损害了发芽速度（t50）和均匀性（AUC），而引发处理即使在老化条件下也逆转了这些效应。转录组分析揭示，老化上调了氧化应激基因（如细胞色素c氧化酶）并抑制了翻译机制。引发处理通过DOF/ERF介导的转录重编程（经由顺式元件识别）激活了应激响应通路和核糖体蛋白，分子对接和酵母单杂交实验证实了这一相互作用。两个生物标志物，Cla97C04G070560（细胞色素c氧化酶）和Cla97C03G062270（核糖体蛋白），被鉴定为发芽衰退的定量预测因子。构建了基于机器学习的蛋白质组模型和调控网络SeedWatermelonNet（SWN）。这些分析揭示了枢纽基因（如OHCU_decarbox、HSPs、LIM、NADPH依赖性醛还原酶1、RPL32）协调尿酸代谢、应激响应、能量代谢和翻译。实验验证确认了这些候选基因的调控作用，包括介导种子活力转导级联的物理相互作用及其通过SWN作为种子活力直接调控因子的预测功能。母本等位基因主导了储存mRNA的转录调控，老化降低了母本特异性基因表达。这些基因中的启动子SNP暗示BPC和DOF转录因子参与母本偏向性。这些发现确立了活力丧失的分子阈值，验证了引发作为恢复力策略的有效性，并为种子质量评估提供了生物标志物。整合转录组、蛋白质组和等位基因特异性见解推进了精准育种和储存实践，为增强种子应对气候驱动农业挑战的恢复力提供了靶点。

papers.title: transfactor: transcription factor activity estimation via probabilistic gene expression deconvolution.
papers.authors: Van den Berge, Koen; Bickel, Peter; Dudoit, Sandrine
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文提出一种基于概率基因表达解卷积的转录因子活性估计方法，虽涉及TF与基因调控，但核心是统计推断而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且未使用AI或物理模拟方法，与课题聚焦的TF-DNA结合机制研究关联较弱。
papers.abstract: Gene expression is a primary modality being studied to differentiate between biological cells. Contemporary single-cell studies simultaneously measure genome-wide transcription levels for thousands of individual cells in a single experiment. While the characterization of cell population differences has often occurred through differential gene expression analysis, tiny effect sizes become statistically significant when thousands of cells are available for each population, compromising biological interpretation. Moreover, these large studies have spurred the development of methods to infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) directly from the data, and GRN databases are becoming more comprehensive. In this work, we propose a statistical model for gene expression measures and an inference method that leverage GRNs to deconvolve transcription factor (TF) activity from gene expression, by probabilistically assigning mRNA molecules to TFs. This shifts the paradigm from investigating gene expression differences to regulatory differences at the level of TF activity, aiding interpretation and allowing prioritization of a limited number of TFs responsible for significant contributions to the observed gene expression differences. The inferred TF activities result in intuitive prioritization of TFs in terms of the (difference in) estimated number of molecules they produce, in contrast to other widely used methods relying on arbitrary enrichment scores. Our model allows the incorporation of prior information on the regulatory potential between each TF and target gene and is able to deal with both repressing and activating interactions. We compare our approach to other TF activity estimation methods using two simulation experiments and two case studies. Single-cell RNA-sequencing; TF activity; bioinformatics; GRN.
papers.abstract_zh: 基因表达是研究生物细胞差异的主要手段。当代单细胞研究在一次实验中同时测量数千个个体细胞的基因组-wide转录水平。虽然细胞群体差异的表征通常通过差异基因表达分析实现，但当每个群体有数千个细胞可用时，微小的效应量变得统计显著，从而影响生物学解释。此外，这些大规模研究推动了直接从数据中推断基因调控网络（GRN）的方法发展，且GRN数据库正变得更加全面。在本工作中，我们提出一个针对基因表达测量的统计模型及一种推断方法，利用GRN通过概率性地将mRNA分子分配给转录因子（TF），从基因表达中解卷积转录因子活性。这将研究范式从探究基因表达差异转向TF活性层面的调控差异，有助于解释，并允许优先考虑对观察到的基因表达差异有显著贡献的有限数量的TF。推断出的TF活性在估计产生的分子数量（差异）方面提供了直观的TF优先排序，这与依赖任意富集分数的其他广泛使用的方法形成对比。我们的模型允许纳入每个TF与靶基因之间调控潜力的先验信息，并能处理抑制性和激活性的相互作用。我们通过两个模拟实验和两个案例研究，将我们的方法与其他TF活性估计方法进行比较。单细胞RNA测序；TF活性；生物信息学；GRN。

papers.title: Structural basis for P-TEFb association with BRD4
papers.authors: Mohamed AA; Vos SM
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜和AlphaFold建模解析了BRD4与P-TEFb复合物的结构，揭示了转录延伸因子复合物的结合机制，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，方法涉及结构建模但非AI/物理模拟聚焦于DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合与互作机制建模关联度中等。
papers.abstract:
ABSTRACT

Cyclin-dependent kinases (CDK) dynamically regulate RNA Polymerase (Pol) II during each stage of transcription. Phosphorylation of RNA Pol II and associated transcription factors by CDKs enables stage-specific exchange of factors. CDK9 and a cyclin partner (CYCT1, T2 or K) comprise the Positive Transcription Elongation Factor-b (P-TEFb) complex, which is responsible for releasing RNA Pol II from promoter proximal pausing into processive elongation. P-TEFb activity is stimulated by bromodomain-containing Protein 4 (BRD4); however, the structural basis for BRD4 association with P-TEFb has remained unclear. Using cryogenic-electron microscopy, AlphaFold modeling, and biochemical probing, we show that the P-TEFb interacting domain of BRD4 (BRD4-PID) interacts with P-TEFb via the C-lobe of CDK9 and the second cyclin domain of CYCT1. The BRD4 binding surface on CDK9 is also used by super elongation complex component AFF4. Our analysis indicates that BRD4 may stimulate P-TEFb activity by remodeling the kinase αC helix relative to previous structures. Finally, P-TEFb activity is restricted when bound to the 7SK RNP complex. We show that in addition to BRD4-PID, the AFF4 N-terminus can release P-TEFb from the 7SK RNP complex. Together, these findings define how P-TEFb activity is regulated by its incorporation into distinct complexes.

SIGNIFICANCE STATEMENT

The exquisite control of gene expression is required for proper development and cellular response to environmental stress. Positive transcription elongation factor b (P-TEFb) is required for the phosphorylation of RNA Pol II and leads to the coordinated release of RNA Pol II from pause sites near the promoter. P-TEFb is bound to bromo-domain containing protein 4 (BRD4), which stimulates P-TEFb activity; however, it is unknown how BRD4 associates with P-TEFb. Here we report a cryo-EM structure of P-TEFb bound to BRD4, revealing how BRD4 interacts with P-TEFb. Comparison of our structure with previously reported P-TEFb structures shows how P-TEFb is regulated by different transcription factor binding partners.
papers.abstract_zh:
摘要

细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶 (cyclin-dependent kinases, CDK) 在转录的每个阶段动态调控RNA聚合酶 (RNA Polymerase, Pol) II。CDK对RNA Pol II及相关转录因子的磷酸化使得因子能够进行阶段特异性交换。CDK9与一个细胞周期蛋白伴侣 (CYCT1、T2或K) 构成正性转录延伸因子b (Positive Transcription Elongation Factor-b, P-TEFb) 复合物，该复合物负责将RNA Pol II从启动子近端暂停释放为持续性延伸。P-TEFb的活性由含溴结构域蛋白4 (bromodomain-containing Protein 4, BRD4) 刺激；然而，BRD4与P-TEFb结合的结构基础仍不清楚。利用冷冻电镜 (cryogenic-electron microscopy)、AlphaFold建模和生化探测，我们显示BRD4的P-TEFb相互作用结构域 (BRD4-PID) 通过CDK9的C-lobe和CYCT1的第二个细胞周期蛋白结构域与P-TEFb相互作用。CDK9上的BRD4结合表面也被超级延伸复合物组分AFF4所利用。我们的分析表明，与先前结构相比，BRD4可能通过重塑激酶αC螺旋来刺激P-TEFb活性。最后，当P-TEFb与7SK RNP复合物结合时，其活性受到限制。我们显示，除了BRD4-PID外，AFF4的N-末端也能将P-TEFb从7SK RNP复合物中释放出来。这些发现共同定义了P-TEFb活性如何通过其整合到不同复合物中而受到调控。

意义声明

基因表达的精细调控对于正常发育和细胞对环境胁迫的响应至关重要。正性转录延伸因子b (P-TEFb) 是RNA Pol II磷酸化所必需的，并导致RNA Pol II从启动子附近的暂停位点协调释放。P-TEFb与含溴结构域蛋白4 (BRD4) 结合，后者刺激P-TEFb活性；然而，BRD4如何与P-TEFb结合尚不清楚。在此我们报告了P-TEFb与BRD4结合的冷冻电镜结构，揭示了BRD4如何与P-TEFb相互作用。将我们的结构与先前报道的P-TEFb结构进行比较，显示了P-TEFb如何通过不同的转录因子结合伙伴受到调控。

papers.title: Immune-Like Malignant Epithelial Programs Shape Tumor-Immune Interactions and Inform Prognostic Stratification in Lung Adenocarcinoma.
papers.authors: Zhang, Wei; Sheng, Hongmei; Zhang, Yazheng; Yu, Qihong; Peng, Haiying
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过单细胞RNA-seq分析肺腺癌恶性上皮细胞状态，构建免疫样恶性上皮细胞预后签名，但核心是转录组与预后分析，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联度低。
papers.abstract: Lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) is characterized by marked cellular heterogeneity, yet how malignant epithelial states contribute to immune regulation and clinical outcomes remains incompletely defined. We integrated single-cell RNA-sequencing data to map the cellular landscape of LUAD and identify malignant epithelial cells based on inferred copy-number alterations. Epithelial states were further examined through trajectory inference, transcription factor analysis, and cell-cell communication profiling. Single-cell-derived genes were subsequently integrated with TCGA and independent GEO cohorts to construct and validate a machine learning-based prognostic signature. Malignant epithelial cells displayed distinct functional programs, including an immune-like state associated with genomic instability, immune-related transcriptional activity, tumor-immune communication, and patient outcomes. The resulting immune-like malignant epithelial cell signature (IMEC-Sig) consistently stratified survival across multiple cohorts. Low IMEC-Sig scores were accompanied by greater immune infiltration, higher immune checkpoint expression, and increased immunophenoscore, whereas high scores were linked to a comparatively immunosuppressive phenotype. Pan-cancer analyses further identified KRT8 as a gene associated with unfavorable prognosis, and functional experiments showed that KRT8 silencing suppressed proliferation, migration, invasion, and colony formation in LUAD cells. Together, these findings connect malignant epithelial heterogeneity with the immune context and clinical outcomes, support IMEC-Sig as a biologically informed prognostic tool, and nominate KRT8 as a potential therapeutic target in LUAD.
papers.abstract_zh: 肺腺癌 (lung adenocarcinoma, LUAD) 以显著的细胞异质性为特征，但恶性上皮状态如何影响免疫调控和临床结局仍不完全明确。我们整合了单细胞RNA测序数据，绘制LUAD的细胞图谱，并基于推断的拷贝数变异识别恶性上皮细胞。通过轨迹推断、转录因子分析和细胞-细胞通讯分析进一步研究了上皮状态。随后将单细胞衍生基因与TCGA及独立GEO队列整合，构建并验证了基于机器学习的预后特征。恶性上皮细胞表现出不同的功能程序，包括一种与基因组不稳定性、免疫相关转录活性、肿瘤-免疫通讯及患者结局相关的免疫样状态。由此产生的免疫样恶性上皮细胞特征 (IMEC-Sig) 在多个队列中一致地实现了生存分层。低IMEC-Sig评分伴随更高的免疫浸润、更高的免疫检查点表达和更高的免疫表型评分，而高评分则与相对免疫抑制的表型相关。泛癌分析进一步将KRT8鉴定为与不良预后相关的基因，功能实验表明，沉默KRT8抑制了LUAD细胞的增殖、迁移、侵袭和集落形成。总之，这些发现将恶性上皮异质性与免疫背景和临床结局联系起来，支持IMEC-Sig作为生物学信息丰富的预后工具，并提名KRT8作为LUAD的潜在治疗靶点。

papers.title: Structure-based design of peptide ligands targeting transcription in Helicobacter pylori.
papers.authors: Gracia, Judith; Nagarajan, Balaji; Manikam, Vyshnavi; Ragunathan, Preethi
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文基于结构建模设计靶向幽门螺杆菌RNA聚合酶与sigma因子互作界面的肽配体，属蛋白质-DNA互作相关转录机制研究，但核心为蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，方法为结构建模与对接，可借鉴至TF-DNA体系。
papers.abstract: Helicobacter pylori colonize the gastric epithelial cells and poses a strong risk factor for gastric complications like chronic gastritis, ulcer diseases, and gastric cancer. Despite the complex treatment regimens, antibiotic resistance is the primary cause of eradication failure and calls for alternate treatment strategy. This study aims to design peptide ligands that specifically target protein-protein interactions in the transcription machinery of H. pylori. The dissociable sigma-factor known as SigA, which binds with the RNA polymerase (RNAP) core beta-prime subunit (RpoC). This interacting region has been targeted to design specific peptide ligands using structure-based computational methods. The lack of experimental structures necessitated generating structural models for Hp RpoC, Hp SigA and Hp RpoC-SigA complex structure. The complex was built based on hybrid template-based modeling (TBM) techniques. The RpoC-SigA interface has been exploited to design five suitable peptides-three peptides from H. pylori SigA (P1, P2, and P3) and two peptides from the SigA-interacting regions of H. pylori RpoC (P4 and P5). Investigation of the binding affinity of all five peptides suggests that P1, P3, and P5 exhibit significant affinity, indicating a potential hindrance to RNAP interaction with transcription factors prior to holoenzyme formation. These peptides may serve as promising inhibitors against H. pylori infection. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s40203-026-00679-4.
papers.abstract_zh: 幽门螺杆菌（Helicobacter pylori）定植于胃上皮细胞，是慢性胃炎、溃疡病和胃癌等胃部并发症的强风险因素。尽管有复杂的治疗方案，抗生素耐药性仍是根除失败的主要原因，并需要替代治疗策略。本研究旨在设计特异性靶向幽门螺杆菌转录机制中蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的肽配体。可解离的sigma因子SigA与RNA聚合酶（RNAP）核心β'亚基（RpoC）结合。该相互作用区域已被靶向，通过基于结构的计算方法设计特异性肽配体。由于缺乏实验结构，需要生成Hp RpoC、Hp SigA及Hp RpoC-SigA复合物结构的结构模型。该复合物基于混合模板建模（TBM）技术构建。RpoC-SigA界面被利用来设计五种合适的肽——三种来自幽门螺杆菌SigA的肽（P1、P2和P3），以及两种来自幽门螺杆菌RpoC的SigA相互作用区域的肽（P4和P5）。对所有五种肽结合亲和力的研究表明，P1、P3和P5表现出显著亲和力，表明在holoenzyme形成前可能阻碍RNAP与转录因子的相互作用。这些肽可能作为针对幽门螺杆菌感染的有前景的抑制剂。补充信息：在线版本包含补充材料，可访问 https://doi.org/10.1007/s40203-026-00679-4。

papers.title: Identification of Integrated Stress Response-Related Biomarkers in Sepsis-Induced Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome.
papers.authors: Gao, Ye; Wang, Ni; Xiao, Zhaoyang
papers.one_liner_zh: 该研究通过转录组和机器学习筛选脓毒症相关ARDS的应激反应生物标志物，属于纯临床/免疫表达分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Sepsis-induced acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) is a fatal inflammatory lung injury. The integrated stress response (ISR) may play stage-dependent roles in lung injury, but its clinical relevance in sepsis-induced ARDS remains unclear. We aimed to identify ISR-related biomarkers and explore their potential mechanisms. METHODS: Public transcriptomic datasets of sepsis-induced ARDS were analyzed. Peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) was used to define key immune cell populations and intercellular communication. Differential expression analyses combined with machine learning were applied to screen ISR-associated biomarkers, and a nomogram was developed as an exploratory tool for ARDS risk stratification. Biomarker expression was validated in a cecal ligation and puncture (CLP)-based rat model representing early sepsis and ARDS-like lung injury. Lung injury was assessed by light and electron microscopy, histological scoring, lung wet/dry weight ratio, and BALF total protein measurement. Gene expression was quantified by qPCR and protein levels by Western blotting. Functional enrichment, immune infiltration, and trajectory analyses were performed to investigate underlying pathways and immune dynamics. The biomarkers were further validated in an independent external dataset. RESULTS: Nuclear factor erythroid 2-like 2 (NFE2L2) and ZFP36L1 were identified as potential ISR-associated biomarkers in sepsis-induced ARDS, and the two-gene nomogram showed good predictive performance. In vivo, peripheral blood Tnf and Il6 mRNA expression increased after CLP, while rats with ARDS-like lung injury exhibited marked lung injury and reduced tight junction markers. Nfe2l2 and Zfp36l1 mRNA levels were elevated in early sepsis but decreased in established ARDS-like lung injury, while their protein levels were generally reduced in established ARDS-like lung injury compared with early sepsis. Canonical ISR activation markers, including the p-eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2alpha (eIF2alpha)/total eIF2alpha ratio and Atf4, Ddit3/Chop, and Ppp1r15 a/Gadd34 expression, progressively increased from early sepsis to ARDS-like lung injury. Enrichment analyses implicated multiple ISR-related pathways. Immune infiltration analysis revealed altered immune cell composition, with NFE2L2 negatively correlated with activated B cell infiltration. Single-cell trajectory analysis demonstrated dynamic expression of these biomarkers during differentiation of key immune cell subsets. CONCLUSION: NFE2L2 and ZFP36L1 are potential ISR-associated biomarkers in sepsis-induced ARDS and may contribute to disease progression through stress-response regulation and immune modulation, supporting biomarker-driven risk stratification and providing a foundation for future mechanistic and interventional studies.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：脓毒症诱导的急性呼吸窘迫综合征（ARDS）是一种致死性炎症性肺损伤。整合应激反应（ISR）可能在肺损伤中发挥阶段依赖性作用，但其在脓毒症诱导的ARDS中的临床相关性仍不清楚。我们旨在识别ISR相关生物标志物并探索其潜在机制。方法：分析了脓毒症诱导的ARDS的公共转录组数据集。使用外周血单个核细胞（PBMC）单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）来定义关键免疫细胞群和细胞间通讯。结合机器学习的差异表达分析用于筛选ISR相关生物标志物，并开发了一个列线图作为ARDS风险分层的探索性工具。在基于盲肠结扎穿刺（CLP）的大鼠模型中验证了生物标志物的表达，该模型代表早期脓毒症和ARDS样肺损伤。通过光镜和电镜、组织学评分、肺湿/干重比以及BALF总蛋白测量评估肺损伤。通过qPCR定量基因表达，通过Western blotting定量蛋白水平。进行了功能富集、免疫浸润和轨迹分析以研究潜在通路和免疫动态。在独立的外部数据集中进一步验证了生物标志物。结果：核因子红细胞2相关因子2（NFE2L2）和ZFP36L1被确定为脓毒症诱导的ARDS中潜在的ISR相关生物标志物，双基因列线图显示出良好的预测性能。在体内，CLP后外周血Tnf和Il6 mRNA表达增加，而ARDS样肺损伤大鼠表现出明显的肺损伤和紧密连接标志物减少。Nfe2l2和Zfp36l1 mRNA水平在早期脓毒症中升高，但在已建立的ARDS样肺损伤中降低，而其蛋白水平在已建立的ARDS样肺损伤中与早期脓毒症相比普遍降低。经典的ISR激活标志物，包括磷酸化真核翻译起始因子2α（p-eIF2α）/总eIF2α比值以及Atf4、Ddit3/Chop和Ppp1r15a/Gadd34的表达，从早期脓毒症到ARDS样肺损伤逐渐增加。富集分析涉及多个ISR相关通路。免疫浸润分析显示免疫细胞组成改变，其中NFE2L2与活化B细胞浸润呈负相关。单细胞轨迹分析显示这些生物标志物在关键免疫细胞亚群分化过程中的动态表达。结论：NFE2L2和ZFP36L1是脓毒症诱导的ARDS中潜在的ISR相关生物标志物，可能通过应激反应调节和免疫调节促进疾病进展，支持生物标志物驱动的风险分层，并为未来的机制和干预研究提供基础。

papers.title: An antioxidant and hepatoprotective peptide derived from peony seed meal: Dual mechanisms through activation of the Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1 pathway and inhibition of mitochondrial apoptosis.
papers.authors: Wang, Bing; Fei, Bo; Yan, Xueshan; Xiao, Zhenxiang; Dong, Yingying; Jiang, Ting; Shao, Shuai; Yan, Mingming
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究牡丹籽粕抗氧化肽AT-8通过Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1通路保护肝细胞，属于纯蛋白-小分子肽功能研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
papers.abstract: Peony seed meal (PSM), a byproduct of peony seed oil processing, is rich in protein but is currently used primarily as animal feed in the livestock industry, leaving its protein resources largely underutilized. Herein, PSM was used as the raw material, and a combination of ultrasound-assisted enzymatic hydrolysis and ultrafiltration was employed to prepare a naturally active peptide fraction (PSMPH) from PSM protein (PSMP). Compared with PSMP, PSMPH demonstrated superior structural characteristics and antioxidant activity. Using liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry, bioactivity prediction, and molecular docking analyses, the peptide AT-8 (APGGYGGT) was identified as a potential antioxidant candidate from PSMPH and subsequently synthesized using solid-phase synthesis. Safety evaluation further confirmed that AT-8 produced no cytotoxic side effects in five normal somatic cell lines. In H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative damage in LO2 hepatocytes, AT-8 significantly reduced alanine aminotransferase, aspartate aminotransferase, and malondialdehyde levels while upregulating the activities of superoxide dismutase, catalase, and glutathione peroxidase compared with PSMPH. Pathway-specific validation further demonstrated that AT-8 exerts hepatoprotective effects through a cascade mechanism involving Nrf2-HO-1 activation, enhanced antioxidant defense, and indirect inhibition of Bax/caspase-3. This study identified AT-8 as an antioxidant hepatoprotective peptide derived from PSM and systematically elucidated its molecular mechanism of action, thereby providing a scientific basis for the high-value utilization of PSM.
papers.abstract_zh: 牡丹籽粕（PSM）是牡丹籽油加工的副产物，富含蛋白质，但目前主要用作畜牧业的动物饲料，其蛋白质资源未得到充分利用。本研究以PSM为原料，采用超声辅助酶解与超滤相结合的方法，从PSM蛋白（PSMP）中制备了天然活性肽组分（PSMPH）。与PSMP相比，PSMPH表现出更优的结构特性和抗氧化活性。通过液相色谱-串联质谱、生物活性预测和分子对接分析，从PSMPH中鉴定出肽AT-8（APGGYGGT）作为潜在的抗氧化候选物，并随后采用固相合成法进行合成。安全性评价进一步证实，AT-8在五种正常体细胞系中未产生细胞毒性副作用。在H(2)O(2)诱导的LO2肝细胞氧化损伤中，与PSMPH相比，AT-8显著降低了丙氨酸氨基转移酶、天冬氨酸氨基转移酶和丙二醛水平，同时上调了超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶的活性。通路特异性验证进一步表明，AT-8通过涉及Nrf2-HO-1激活、增强抗氧化防御以及间接抑制Bax/caspase-3的级联机制发挥肝保护作用。本研究鉴定出AT-8为源自PSM的抗氧化肝保护肽，并系统阐明了其分子作用机制，从而为PSM的高值化利用提供了科学依据。

papers.title: Single cell transcriptomic analysis by deep learning identifies novel microglial transcription regulations in Alzheimer's Disease.
papers.authors: Trivedi, Maitry Ronakbhai; Shah, Jay; Su, Yi; Reiman, Eric M; Wu, Teresa; Wang, Qi
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习分析单细胞转录组数据构建AD疾病轨迹，并基于SHAP识别关键基因构建转录调控网络，但核心是转录组分类与基因调控网络推断，而非直接研究TF-DNA结合与互作机制，且缺乏三维结构建模或物理模拟方法。
papers.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has been increasingly applied to investigate genetic irregularities associated with Alzheimer's Disease (AD). However, its potential to uncover deeper, more detailed molecular and cellular mechanisms remains underexplored, primarily due to limitations in integrating large-scale data and capturing the complex, cell-type-specific dynamics involved in AD pathology. Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) has emerged as a powerful tool in transcriptomics, offering high-resolution, cell-specific insights into complex biological systems. Despite this advancement, a significant gap remains in identifying both common and cell-type-specific transcriptomic signatures that define AD-related cellular and molecular processes. To address this, we propose a deep learning framework leveraging a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) to classify AD versus control nuclei using scRNA-seq data from the Religious Orders Study/Memory and Aging Project (ROSMAP). We focus on microglial subclusters, particularly those representing homeostatic and activated states, to train the MLP model for optimal classification performance. We utilize the predicted embeddings from the MLP to model a disease progression trajectory for each of the datasets. Our model demonstrates strong performance in both classification and disease trajectory inference. To enhance interpretability, SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) are applied to identify key AD-associated genes. Based on the most salient genes implicated in AD, we built transcription gene regulatory networks, revealing novel transcription factors and regulons for AD pathogenesis. These regulons highlight profound impacts of dysregulations of proteostasis, endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress responses, and circadian rhythm on synaptic plasticity and neuronal survival in AD, offering a more holistic approach to drug target discovery compared to conventional single-target strategies, potentially leading to greater efficacy in slowing or reversing disease progression. This work demonstrates the transformative potential of AI in elucidating the molecular mechanisms of AD, offering improvements over traditional methods and uncovering novel insights into disease pathogenesis and potential therapeutic targets.
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）已被越来越多地应用于研究阿尔茨海默病（AD）相关的遗传异常。然而，其在揭示更深层、更详细的分子和细胞机制方面的潜力仍未得到充分探索，这主要受限于整合大规模数据以及捕捉AD病理中涉及的复杂、细胞类型特异性动态的局限性。单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）已成为转录组学中的强大工具，为复杂生物系统提供高分辨率、细胞特异性的见解。尽管有这一进展，但在识别定义AD相关细胞和分子过程的常见及细胞类型特异性转录组特征方面，仍存在显著空白。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种深度学习框架，利用多层感知器（MLP）对来自宗教秩序研究/记忆与衰老项目（ROSMAP）的scRNA-seq数据进行AD与对照细胞核的分类。我们聚焦于小胶质细胞亚群，特别是代表稳态和激活状态的亚群，以训练MLP模型实现最佳分类性能。我们利用MLP预测的嵌入来为每个数据集建模疾病进展轨迹。我们的模型在分类和疾病轨迹推断方面均表现出强劲性能。为增强可解释性，应用SHapley加性解释（SHAP）来识别关键的AD相关基因。基于与AD相关的最显著基因，我们构建了转录基因调控网络，揭示了AD发病机制中的新型转录因子和调控子。这些调控子凸显了蛋白质稳态失调、内质网（ER）应激反应和昼夜节律对AD中突触可塑性和神经元存活的深远影响，与传统单靶点策略相比，为药物靶点发现提供了更全面的方法，可能在减缓或逆转疾病进展方面具有更高疗效。这项工作展示了AI在阐明AD分子机制方面的变革潜力，提供了优于传统方法的改进，并揭示了疾病发病机制和潜在治疗靶点的新见解。

papers.title: Binding analysis of the response regulator NarL protein to the promoter of the O(6)-methylguanine-DNA methyltransferase (ogt) gene in Salmonella Typhimurium.
papers.authors: Sahoo, Pravas Ranjan; Kumar, Ajay; Pashupathi, M; Sahoo, Jyochhna Rani
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过EMSA、ITC和分子对接研究NarL转录因子与ogt启动子的结合，属TF-DNA互作体系，但方法以实验为主、分子对接较简单，AI/物理模拟深度不足。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Salmonella Typhimurium (STM) is a gram-negative bacterium that causes severe gastrointestinal disorders in both animals and humans. The regulation of DNA repair genes is critical for maintaining genomic stability of the bacteria. O(6)-methylguanine DNA methyltransferase (Ogt), plays a vital role in repairing alkylated DNA in STM; however, the transcriptional regulation of ogt gene remains poorly characterized. Furthermore, NarL is a transcriptional regulator, involved in the pathogenesis of STM under anaerobic condition. Therefore, this study investigated the interaction between NarL protein and the promoter region of the ogt gene. METHODS: In this study, narl gene was cloned in pET32a vector and NarL protein was expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3). Subsequently, the ogt gene promoter (pogt) was selected, amplified, cloned and its activity was evaluated. Electrophoretic mobility shift assay (EMSA), isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC), molecular docking were employed to elucidate the interaction between NarL protein and ogt promoter. Furthermore, the regulatory role of NarL in ogt gene expression was validated in vivo using RT-qPCR and beta-galactosidase assay. RESULTS: This study resulted that NarL protein interacts specifically with the ogt promoter, as confirmed by EMSA and ITC, with DeltaG of - 9.42 kcal mol(-)(1). Furthermore, RT-qPCR and beta-galactosidase assays demonstrated that deletion of narl significantly (P </= 0.01) decreased ogt transcript levels and promoter activity than wild Salmonella Typhimurium, whereas exogenous supplementation of recombinant NarL protein restored the expression. These findings suggest that NarL plays a potential regulatory role in ogt gene expression in response to environmental signals. CONCLUSION: These findings highlight an interaction between NarL protein and the promoter region of ogt gene in Salmonella Typhimurium, linking nitrogen metabolism with the DNA repair pathway in STM, which may contribute to the bacterial survival under nitrosative stress.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：鼠伤寒沙门氏菌（Salmonella Typhimurium, STM）是一种革兰氏阴性细菌，可引起动物和人类的严重胃肠道疾病。DNA修复基因的调控对于维持细菌的基因组稳定性至关重要。O(6)-甲基鸟嘌呤DNA甲基转移酶（Ogt）在STM中修复烷基化DNA中发挥关键作用；然而，ogt基因的转录调控机制仍鲜有表征。此外，NarL是一种转录调控因子，参与STM在厌氧条件下的致病性。因此，本研究探讨了NarL蛋白与ogt基因启动子区域之间的相互作用。方法：在本研究中，将narl基因克隆至pET32a载体中，并在大肠杆菌BL21 (DE3)中表达NarL蛋白。随后，选择、扩增并克隆ogt基因启动子（pogt），并评估其活性。采用电泳迁移率变动分析（EMSA）、等温滴定量热法（ITC）和分子对接来阐明NarL蛋白与ogt启动子之间的相互作用。此外，通过RT-qPCR和β-半乳糖苷酶测定法在体内验证了NarL在ogt基因表达中的调控作用。结果：本研究结果表明，NarL蛋白与ogt启动子特异性相互作用，经EMSA和ITC确认，ΔG为-9.42 kcal mol⁻¹。此外，RT-qPCR和β-半乳糖苷酶测定表明，与野生型鼠伤寒沙门氏菌相比，narl缺失显著（P ≤ 0.01）降低了ogt转录水平和启动子活性，而外源补充重组NarL蛋白则恢复了表达。这些发现表明，NarL在响应环境信号时对ogt基因表达具有潜在调控作用。结论：这些发现强调了鼠伤寒沙门氏菌中NarL蛋白与ogt基因启动子区域之间的相互作用，将氮代谢与STM中的DNA修复途径联系起来，这可能有助于细菌在亚硝化应激下的生存。

papers.title: BpCYCD3;1 regulates organ growth by activating the cell cycle module in white birch.
papers.authors: Yue, Linan; Wang, Xinyu; Zheng, Zhimin
papers.journal: Plant science : an international journal of experimental plant biology
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文研究白桦中BpCYCD3;1通过激活CDKA-RBR-E2F模块调控器官生长，涉及E2F转录因子与下游启动子结合，但核心是细胞周期调控而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，且方法以实验为主，仅含简单对接分析，与课题聚焦的AI/物理模拟方法不匹配。
papers.abstract: Cyclin D proteins are key regulators of cell cycle progression and plant growth. Here, we identified BpCYCD3;1, a CYCD3 family member in birch, and investigated its function. Phylogenetic and sequence analyses showed that BpCYCD3;1 is evolutionarily conserved and contains canonical cell cycle-related domains. Promoter and expression analyses suggested responsiveness to environmental and hormonal signals, with preferential expression in leaves. BpCYCD3;1 overexpression promoted leaf expansion and biomass accumulation, whereas CRISPR/Cas9 knockout reduced vegetative growth. Cytological analyses revealed increased cell density and epidermal cell number in overexpression lines, indicating enhanced cell proliferation. At the molecular level, BpCYCD3;1 upregulated G1/S transition regulators and DNA replication-related genes. Yeast two-hybrid and docking analyses suggested interaction between BpCYCD3;1 and CDKA;1, as well as the interaction between RBR and E2F transcription factors, and binding of E2FA/E2FB to downstream promoters. Together, these results indicate that BpCYCD3;1 promotes vegetative growth by activating the CDKA-RBR-E2F regulatory module, providing a potential target for improving tree growth and biomass production.
papers.abstract_zh: Cyclin D蛋白是细胞周期进程和植物生长的关键调控因子。本研究鉴定了桦树中CYCD3家族成员BpCYCD3;1，并探究了其功能。系统发育和序列分析表明，BpCYCD3;1在进化上保守，并包含典型的细胞周期相关结构域。启动子和表达分析提示其对环境和激素信号具有响应性，且在叶片中优先表达。BpCYCD3;1过表达促进了叶片扩展和生物量积累，而CRISPR/Cas9敲除则减少了营养生长。细胞学分析显示，过表达株系中细胞密度和表皮细胞数量增加，表明细胞增殖增强。在分子水平上，BpCYCD3;1上调了G1/S期转换调控因子和DNA复制相关基因。酵母双杂交和对接分析提示BpCYCD3;1与CDKA;1之间存在相互作用，以及RBR与E2F转录因子之间的相互作用，并且E2FA/E2FB与下游启动子结合。综上，这些结果表明BpCYCD3;1通过激活CDKA-RBR-E2F调控模块促进营养生长，为改善树木生长和生物量生产提供了潜在靶点。

papers.title: Bioinformatics Screening and Preliminary Experimental Verification of Integrated Stress Response-Associated MYC and BAG3 in Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease.
papers.authors: Liu, Xueping; Wang, Lu; Tang, Ting; Qian, Hang; He, Binfeng; Xu, Zhi; Wang, Guansong; Zhang, Mingzhou
papers.journal: International journal of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
papers.one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学筛选COPD中ISR相关生物标志物MYC和BAG3，虽涉及转录因子（如SNAI2）的关联分析，但核心是表达差异和诊断模型，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作机制、结合位点预测或三维结构建模，且方法以统计和机器学习为主，无AI/物理模拟聚焦于TF-DNA互作，与本课题关联度低。
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) has high morbidity and mortality, and integrated stress response (ISR) participates in its progression. Traditional COPD diagnosis relies mainly on GOLD criteria, while ISR-based auxiliary molecular markers are still lacking. This study aimed to comprehensively analyze and identify ISR-related biomarkers in COPD, and to uncover their underlying molecular mechanisms. METHODS: COPD data were obtained from the GEO database. Biomarkers were identified and validated through a comprehensive approach, including differential expression analysis, machine learning algorithms, expression level verification, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis. Moreover, a nomogram was applied to construct an ISR-related predictive model for COPD. Enrichment analysis, immune infiltration analysis, molecular regulatory network, and drug prediction were performed to further confirm the regulatory roles of biomarkers. Furthermore, the expression patterns of biomarkers in core cells were investigated using dataset GSE173896. Furthermore, Western blotting was employed to detect the protein expression levels of biomarkers in clinical samples. RESULTS: Overall, 2 biomarkers (MYC and BAG3) were identified as significantly associated with ISR in COPD. A predictive nomogram constructed based on MYC and BAG3 demonstrated excellent diagnostic performance, with an area under the curve (AUC) value of 0.799. The biomarkers were significantly enriched in the MAPK signaling pathway and cell cycle. Notably, biomarkers were positively correlated with effector memory CD4 T cells and eosinophils. Subsequently, 36 microRNAs (miRNAs) (like hsa-miR-4699-3p), 260 transcription factors (TFs) (like SNAI2, ZBTB43, and ZNF395) and 9 drugs (like staurosporine and N-acetyl-L-cysteine) were associated with the biomarkers. Moreover, significant changes in MYC and BAG3 expression were observed during T cell differentiation. Clinically, MYC and BAG3 were significantly upregulated in COPD tissues, with protein levels increased by 58.4% and 252.2% respectively. CONCLUSION: This study identified and preliminarily verified ISR-associated MYC and BAG3, offering novel molecular references to complement conventional COPD clinical assessment.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）具有高发病率和死亡率，整合应激反应（ISR）参与其进展。传统COPD诊断主要依赖GOLD标准，而基于ISR的辅助分子标志物仍缺乏。本研究旨在全面分析并识别COPD中与ISR相关的生物标志物，并揭示其潜在分子机制。方法：COPD数据来自GEO数据库。通过综合方法（包括差异表达分析、机器学习算法、表达水平验证和受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线分析）识别并验证生物标志物。此外，应用列线图构建COPD的ISR相关预测模型。通过富集分析、免疫浸润分析、分子调控网络和药物预测进一步确认生物标志物的调控作用。进一步利用数据集GSE173896研究生物标志物在核心细胞中的表达模式。此外，采用Western blotting检测临床样本中生物标志物的蛋白表达水平。结果：总体而言，2个生物标志物（MYC和BAG3）被识别为与COPD中ISR显著相关。基于MYC和BAG3构建的预测列线图表现出优异的诊断性能，曲线下面积（AUC）值为0.799。生物标志物显著富集于MAPK信号通路和细胞周期。值得注意的是，生物标志物与效应记忆CD4 T细胞和嗜酸性粒细胞呈正相关。随后，36个微小RNA（miRNA）（如hsa-miR-4699-3p）、260个转录因子（TF）（如SNAI2、ZBTB43和ZNF395）和9种药物（如星形孢菌素和N-乙酰-L-半胱氨酸）与生物标志物相关。此外，在T细胞分化过程中观察到MYC和BAG3表达的显著变化。临床上，MYC和BAG3在COPD组织中显著上调，蛋白水平分别增加58.4%和252.2%。结论：本研究识别并初步验证了ISR相关的MYC和BAG3，为补充传统COPD临床评估提供了新的分子参考。
